documents.title: Does interproximal reduction during clear aligner treatment increase the risk of caries? A retrospective cohort study.
documents.abstract:
AIM: This study aimed to evaluate the potential risk of caries in patients who underwent interproximal enamel reduction (IPER) in the maxillary and mandibular teeth during clear aligner orthodontic treatment.
METHODS: A total of 344 patients treated with clear aligners were included. Samples were categorised into four groups based on IPER site: maxillary posterior (MxP), maxillary anterior (MxA), mandibular posterior (MdP) and mandibular anterior (MdA). The amount of IPER was classified according to the total reduction performed at each interproximal contact area involving two adjacent tooth surfaces, rather than per individual tooth surface, into four subgroups: (1) 0.1-0.3 mm, (2) 0.4-0.5 mm, (3) 0.6-0.8 mm and (4) 0.9-1.0 mm. Clinical and radiographic caries assessments were performed, and longitudinal data were analysed using Generalised Estimating Equations (GEE) models at the proximal tooth-surface level, with clustering of surfaces within patients taken into account.
RESULTS: A total of 4800 proximal surfaces were evaluated, with caries detected on 66 surfaces in 36 patients. Overall incidence remained low across all groups. Site- and amount-related differences were observed in the GEE analysis; however, these findings should be interpreted cautiously because of the low absolute event rate and limited number of carious surfaces.
CONCLUSION: Within this low-risk, highly compliant cohort, IPER up to 1.0 mm (0.5 mm per tooth surface) was associated with a very low observed incidence of caries when combined with proper polishing, oral hygiene and follow-up care. However, this study does not show that IPER increases caries compared with untreated teeth.
documents.authors: Chou Alex Hung Kuo, Lee You-Sun, Vaiid Nikhillesh, Shoaib Ahmed, Kook Yoon-Ah, Nicolay Olivier
documents.summary_ja: クリアアライナー治療中に近心・遠心エナメル質削減（IPER）を受けた患者のう蝕リスクを評価した後ろ向きコホート研究。344例をIPER部位（上顎後歯・上顎前歯・下顎後歯・下顎前歯）と削減量（0.1-0.3 mm、0.4-0.5 mm、0.6-0.8 mm、0.9-1.0 mm）で分類し、4800の近心面を臨床的・X線的にう蝕評価した。縦断データはGEEモデルで解析。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 適切な研磨・口腔衛生管理・フォローアップケアを組み合わせる条件下で、IPER 1.0 mm以下（歯面あたり0.5 mm以下）はう蝕の観察発生率が非常に低かった。IPERが未処置歯と比較してう蝕を増加させることを示す結果ではなかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：IPER 1.0 mm以下（歯面あたり0.5 mm以下）が適切なプロトコル下でう蝕リスクを有意に増加させないことを示唆し、治療計画におけるIPER量の設定根拠となる。ワークフロー：研磨・口腔衛生管理・フォローアップケアの組み合わせが安全なIPER実施の前提条件として明示されている。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向きコホート研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 近心歯面のう蝕発生（臨床的・X線的評価）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 4800の近心面を評価し、36例の66面でう蝕を検出。全グループで全体的な発生率は低かった。GEE解析で部位・量に関連する差が観察されたが、絶対イベント率が低くう蝕面の数が限られているため解釈には注意が必要。

documents.title: Effects of clear aligner attachment template sectioning on bonding accuracy and anterior retraction biomechanics: A finite element study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effects of attachment template sectioning on bonding accuracy and the initial biomechanical response during en-masse anterior retraction with clear aligners.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Thirty three-dimensional printed maxillary extraction models were assigned to full-arch, single-tooth, or sectional template groups. Attachment deviations were assessed using digital scanning, model registration, and three-dimensional measurements. Representative bonded attachments from each group were incorporated into finite element models to simulate anterior retraction after maxillary first-premolar extraction.
RESULTS: Mean attachment deviations were 0.041mm, 0.080mm, and 0.056mm in the full-arch, single-tooth, and sectional groups, respectively. The full-arch and sectional templates showed greater bonding accuracy than the single-tooth templates. Deviations generally increased toward the posterior region. Finite element analysis demonstrated tooth- and direction-specific changes in buccolingual, mesiodistal, and vertical displacement, with the most pronounced alterations in the single-tooth-template model.
CONCLUSIONS: Template sectioning affected attachment bonding accuracy and initial displacement patterns during anterior retraction. Full-arch and sectional templates may be preferable for simultaneous bonding of multiple attachments, whereas the lower positioning stability of single-tooth templates should be considered during localized rebonding.
documents.authors: Su Qi, Yang Lijia, Wu Lingyue, Huang Fengqiong, Zhang Xiao, Pan Yuyan, Zhou Zhiying
documents.summary_ja: アタッチメントテンプレートの分割方式（フルアーチ、単歯、セクション）がクリアアライナーによる前歯部一括後退時のボンディング精度と初期バイオメカニカル応答に与える影響を、有限要素法（FEA）を用いて評価した研究。33本の3Dプリント上顎抜歯モデルを3群に割り付け、デジタルスキャンとモデルレジストレーションによりアタッチメント偏差を測定し、各群の代表アタッチメントをFEAモデルに組み込んで前歯部後退をシミュレーションした。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: フルアーチ型とセクション型テンプレートは単歯型テンプレートよりボンディング精度が優れていた。FEAでは単歯型テンプレートモデルで最も顕著な歯位・方向特異的な変位変化が認められた。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: テンプレート設計の選択がアタッチメントの計画位置に対する実際のボンディング精度（偏差）に直接影響し、治療計画の達成度に関わる。refinement: 単歯型テンプレートの位置安定性の低さは、局所的なリボンディング時の判断材料となる。
documents.study_type_ja: 有限要素法（FEA）を用いた計算機シミュレーション研究（in silico study）
documents.endpoints_ja: アタッチメントボンディング精度（偏差mm）、前歯部後退時の初期変位パターン（頬舌方向・近遠心方向・垂直方向の変位）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 平均アタッチメント偏差：フルアーチ群 0.041mm、単歯群 0.080mm、セクション群 0.056mm。フルアーチ型とセクション型テンプレートは単歯型テンプレートよりボンディング精度が優れていた。偏差は後方領域に向かって増加する傾向。FEAでは頬舌方向・近遠心方向・垂直方向の変位に歯位・方向特異的な変化が認められ、単歯型テンプレートモデルで最も顕著な変化を示した。

documents.title: Adherence rate and predictors of clear aligner wear in Canadian university and private practice settings: a survey development protocol.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Clear aligners (CAs) are a popular orthodontic treatment due to their aesthetic appeal and perceived convenience; however, patient adherence remains a challenge. This study protocol aims to assess distal and proximal determinants of intended and actual CAs wear among adolescents currently undergoing treatment or who completed treatment within the past 3 months at the University of Alberta’s Graduate Orthodontics Program and private clinics in Edmonton, Alberta.
METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This study follows AMEE Guide No. 87 for survey development and is grounded in the Integrative Model of Behavioral Prediction (IMBP). The study includes six steps. Step 1 involves a scoping review to summarise the literature on adherence to removable appliances, including CAs, identify research gaps and inform survey development on behavioural determinants such as barriers, facilitators and perceived costs and benefits. Step 2 includes semistructured interviews with current and former adolescent patients to explore attitudes, subjective norms and perceived barriers, analysed using inductive manifest content analysis. Step 3 synthesises findings from the scoping review and interviews to guide survey development. Step 4 focuses on survey item development, incorporating direct and indirect questions to assess IMBP constructs. Step 5 establishes survey validity and reliability through expert review, adolescent cognitive interviews and internal consistency assessment using Cronbach’s alpha. Step 6 includes survey administration and analysis. The validated survey will be administered via a web-based platform to adolescents in university and private practice settings. Descriptive statistics will summarise determinants, while multiple regression and path modelling will examine associations with intended and actual CAs wear.
ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: This study was approved by the Health Research Ethics Board of the Mike Petryk School of Dentistry, University of Alberta (Study ID: Pro00154830). Findings will be disseminated through infographics, digital platforms, in-person displays, professional reports, conference presentations and peer-reviewed dental journals.
documents.authors: Tiwari Akriti, Ng Enoch, Perez-Garcia Arnaldo, Flores-Mir Carlos
documents.summary_ja: カナダ・エドモントのアルバータ大学大学院矯正プログラムおよび民間クリニックにおいて、現在治療中または過去3ヶ月以内に治療を完了した青少年の透明マウスピース（CA）装着遵守率の遠因・近因を評価するための調査開発プロトコル。AMEEガイドNo.87に従い、行動予測統合モデル（IMBP）に基づき、スコーピングレビュー、半構造化インタビュー、調査項目開発、妥当性・信頼性検証、調査実施・分析の6段階で構成される。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 本論文は調査開発プロトコルであり、透明マウスピース装着遵守の行動決定要因（障壁・促進要因・認知コスト・ベネフィット）を評価するための検証済み調査の開発手法を記述している。結果は報告されていない。
documents.why_matters_ja: 透明マウスピースの装着遵守（planned-vs-achieved）は治療計画の達成に直結する重要な要素であり、本プロトコルは遵守の行動決定要因を体系的に評価する調査開発を目的としている。患者教育（barriers, facilitators, perceived costs and benefits）の観点から、遵守率向上に向けた介入の根拠となる知見が期待される。
documents.study_type_ja: 調査開発プロトコル（survey development protocol）
documents.endpoints_ja: 意図的CA装着（intended CA wear）および実際のCA装着（actual CA wear）

documents.title: Trueness and precision of 5 intraoral scanners under different conditions in arches: A 3D comparative in vitro analysis.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The accuracy of intraoral scanners (IOSs) has been widely reported. However, studies comparing their performance under different clinical conditions are lacking.
OBJECTIVES: The aim of the present study was to compare the trueness and precision of 5 IOSs across 4 anatomically distinct models simulating common clinical conditions: edentulous; abutment; orthodontic (fully dentate); and scanbody scenarios.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: An in vitro study was conducted using 4 maxillary models representing different clinical configurations. Five IOSs (AORALSCAN 3, TRIOS 5, ViSIOScan WL, iTero Element 5D Plus, and DEXIS IS 3800) were evaluated. Each model was scanned 10 times with each scanner, and a laboratory desktop scanner was used as the reference for trueness. Accuracy was quantified using the root mean square (RMS) deviation values, with a clinical acceptability threshold of 0.25 mm. Superimposition and deviation analyses were performed using three-dimensional (3D) software, and statistical comparisons were conducted using ANOVA and Scheffé's post hoc test.
RESULTS: Except for ViSIOScan WL in the scanbody model, all tested scanners demonstrated accuracy values below 0.1 mm. Significant differences in trueness and precision were observed both between the scanners and across the clinical scenarios (p < 0.05). Overall, AORALSCAN 3 and iTero Element 5D Plus consistently demonstrated the best performance. The abutment and fully dentate models showed the highest accuracy, whereas the edentulous and scanbody models exhibited greater deviations, particularly for ViSIOScan WL and DEXIS IS 3800.
CONCLUSIONS: Despite most IOSs achieving accuracy below 0.1 mm, substantial variability was observed depending on the scanner type and the anatomical context. AORALSCAN 3 and iTero Element 5D Plus consistently demonstrated superior trueness and precision across most models. While the fully dentate model showed no significant differences in trueness among the scanners, it, along with the abutment model, yielded the highest overall accuracy. The edentulous and scanbody models posed greater challenges.
documents.authors: Polizzi Alessandro, Venezia Pietro, Serra Sara, Pizzo Giuseppe, Blasi Andrea, Pihut Małgorzata, Isola Gaetano
documents.summary_ja: 本研究は、5種類の口腔内スキャナー（AORALSCAN 3、TRIOS 5、ViSIOScan WL、iTero Element 5D Plus、DEXIS IS 3800）の真度（trueness）と精度（precision）を、4種類の解剖学的に異なる上顎モデル（無歯顎、アバットメント、矯正（全歯列）、スキャンボディ）を用いたin vitro比較分析である。各モデルを各スキャナーで10回スキャンし、ラボデスクトップスキャナーを基準としてRMS偏差値で精度を定量化した。臨床許容閾値は0.25 mmとした。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: ViSIOScan WLのスキャンボディモデルを除き、全スキャナーの精度は0.1 mm未満であったが、スキャナー間および臨床シナリオ間で真度・精度に有意な差が認められた（p < 0.05）。AORALSCAN 3とiTero Element 5D Plusが最も一貫して優れた性能を示した。無歯顎モデルとスキャンボディモデルは特に大きな偏差を示した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：口腔内スキャナーの真度・精度はデジタル印象の品質に直接影響し、治療計画の正確性を左右する。特に無歯顎やスキャンボディのような臨床的に困難な条件下では、スキャナー選択が計画品質に大きく影響することが示された。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro比較分析（3D比較in vitro研究）
documents.endpoints_ja: 真度（trueness）と精度（precision）をRMS偏差値で定量化（臨床許容閾値0.25 mm）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: ViSIOScan WLのスキャンボディモデルを除き、全スキャナーの精度値は0.1 mm未満。スキャナー間および臨床シナリオ間で真度・精度に有意差（p < 0.05）。AORALSCAN 3とiTero Element 5D Plusが最も優れた性能。アバットメントモデルと全歯列モデルが最も高い精度、無歯顎モデルとスキャンボディモデルが特にViSIOScan WLとDEXIS IS 3800で大きな偏差を示した。

documents.title: Sustainable orthodontics: direct environmental, material, and implementation evidence from a systematic review.
documents.abstract: Orthodontic care generates environmental burdens through polymer and metal consumption, single-use products, manufacturing, transport, energy use, and end-of-life disposal. This systematic review evaluated primary orthodontic evidence that directly measured environmental outcomes or examined implementation behavior explicitly related to environmental sustainability. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library were searched from January 2010 through October 2025, with supplementary Google Scholar and reference-list screening. The corrected search used two reproducible concept blocks-orthodontics and environmental sustainability-without a human-subject filter so that laboratory and life-cycle studies remained eligible. Five primary studies met the revised PICOS criteria: two laboratory/material studies, one comparative life-cycle assessment, and two cross-sectional surveys. Incineration of used clear-aligner polymers produced measurable hazardous emissions; a comparative life-cycle assessment indicated that retainer selection was sensitive to product lifespan and system-boundary assumptions; and a shape-memory aligner material showed potential to reduce the number of appliances, although a complete life-cycle assessment was not performed. Survey evidence showed inadequate disposal knowledge and a persistent gap between favorable attitudes and routine sustainable practice. The evidence remains sparse, heterogeneous, and at some risk of selection, modeling, and self-report bias. Current findings support targeted action on aligner and retainer life cycles, disposal guidance, and implementation barriers, but stronger orthodontic-specific life-cycle studies and standardized environmental outcomes are required. Because eligibility was intentionally restricted to primary orthodontic studies with direct environmental outcomes or explicit sustainability-related implementation outcomes, the five included studies represent a highly selected evidence base rather than a comprehensive survey of all sustainability-related orthodontic literature. The 4D-printing finding is interpreted only as a potential appliance/material-reduction pathway; no net environmental benefit has yet been demonstrated. Systematic Review Registration: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251250285, identifier CRD420251250285.
documents.authors: Alam Mohammad Khursheed, Alsaeed Suliman, Hajeer Mohammad Younis, Abutayyem Huda, Alayyash Afnan, Alhajeri Khulood
documents.summary_ja: 2010年1月から2025年10月までのPubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science Core Collection、EMBASE、Cochrane Libraryを検索し、環境的持続可能性に関連する環境アウトカムを直接測定した、または明示的な持続可能性関連の実装行動を調査した一次正畸学証拠を評価した系統的レビュー。修正されたPICOS基準を満たした一次研究は5本（実験/材料研究2本、比較的生命周期評価1本、横断調査2本）であった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 透明マウスピースポリマーの焼却により測定可能な有害排出物が生成され、リテイナー選択は製品寿命とシステム境界の仮定に敏感であることが示された。形状記憶マウスピース材料は装置数の削減の可能性を示したが、完全な生命周期評価は実施されていない。調査では廃棄知識の不足と、好意的態度と日常的な持続可能な実践の間の持続的なギャップが確認された。証拠は依然として希少で異質であり、選択バイアス、モデリングバイアス、自己報告バイアスのリスクがある。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：透明マウスピースポリマーの焼却による有害排出物の生成が報告されており、廃棄プロセスの安全性に関わる。ワークフロー：廃棄知識の不足と態度・実践のギャップが示され、持続可能な廃棄ガイダンスと実装障壁への対応が臨床ワークフローに求められる。
documents.study_type_ja: 系統的レビュー
documents.endpoints_ja: 環境的持続可能性に関連する環境アウトカム（焼却による有害排出物、生命周期評価結果、廃棄知識、態度と実践のギャップ）および明示的な持続可能性関連の実装行動

documents.title: Thermomechanical Comparison of PET-G and TC-85 Orthodontic Aligner Materials.
documents.abstract: This study combined thermomechanical characterisation with finite element analysis to compare polyethylene terephthalate glycol (PET-G) and Tera Harz TC-85 orthodontic aligner materials. Tensile properties were evaluated at 23, 37, 55 and 80 °C, with five observations per material and temperature. Identical full-arch geometries with a nominal thickness of 0.75 mm were subjected to 600 N compression at 300 K, heating under maintained load to 352 K and cooling to 310 K. At 23 °C, tensile moduli were 1396.4 ± 44.9 MPa for PET-G and 675.4 ± 21.2 MPa for TC-85. Dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA) loss-tangent maxima occurred at sampled temperatures of 80 and 45 °C. Tensile and DMA moduli diverged at elevated temperatures. Initial maximum effective strains were 0.165 and 0.196, and medium-to-fine mesh changes were 1.78% and 2.61%. TC-85 showed a greater reduction in maximum strain following heating to 78.85 °C. Recovery benchmark values at 60 min were 63.3% for PET-G and 92.5% for TC-85; paired-series metrics quantified curve agreement. PET-G exhibited higher tensile stiffness, whereas TC-85 exhibited greater benchmark recovery and a larger thermal-stage strain reduction. The high-temperature endpoint represents ex vivo activation. Constitutive and experimental limitations constrain extrapolation to clinical appliance performance.
documents.authors: Aşkın Melis Büşra, Görgülü Serkan, Duran Gökhan Serhat
documents.summary_ja: PET-GとTC-85の2種類の矯正アライナー材料について、熱機械的特性評価（23/37/55/80℃での引張試験、DMA）と有限要素解析（0.75mm厚のフルアーチジオメトリに600N圧縮荷重を300Kで施加し、352Kまで加熱後310Kまで冷却）を組み合わせ、材料特性を比較した研究。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: PET-Gは引張剛性が高い一方、TC-85は60分回復ベンチマーク値が92.5%（PET-Gは63.3%）と大きく、加熱段階での最大ひずみ減少も大きい。高温エンドポイントはex vivo活性化を代表する。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：回復ベンチマーク値（PET-G 63.3% vs TC-85 92.5%）は、熱活性化後にアライナーが設計形状へどれだけ回復するかを示し、計画された歯移動量と実際の力伝達に直接関連する。安全性の観点：最大有効ひずみ（0.165/0.196）と加熱後のひずみ減少は、材料の破損リスクや患者への力学的安全性の評価に寄与する。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro（熱機械的特性評価）＋計算解析（有限要素解析）
documents.endpoints_ja: 引張弾性率（23/37/55/80℃）、DMA損失タンジェント最大値、初期最大有効ひずみ、メッシュ収束率（medium-to-fine）、60分回復ベンチマーク値
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 23℃引張弾性率：PET-G 1396.4 ± 44.9 MPa、TC-85 675.4 ± 21.2 MPa。DMA損失タンジェント最大値：80℃と45℃で観測。初期最大有効ひずみ：0.165と0.196。medium-to-fineメッシュ変化率：1.78%と2.61%。60分回復ベンチマーク値：PET-G 63.3%、TC-85 92.5%。

documents.title: The Use of Clear Aligner Therapy for Orthognathic Surgery Patients: A Cross-Sectional Survey Among Saudi Orthodontists and Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Orthognathic surgery corrects severe skeletal discrepancies that cannot be addressed by orthodontics alone. With advancements in digital workflows and CAD/CAM technologies, clear aligner therapy (CAT) has emerged as a potential adjunct in surgical cases. However, its clinical application remains under-researched. This study aimed to exploratorily assess the knowledge, clinical experience, and attitudes of orthodontists and oral and maxillofacial surgeons in Saudi Arabia regarding CAT in orthognathic surgery patients.
METHODS: A cross-sectional survey was conducted from April 1 to May 31, 2023, using a closed-ended online questionnaire distributed to specialists across Saudi Arabia. The survey gathered demographic and clinical data. Statistical analysis included descriptive methods, chi-square testing, and univariate regression. Given the limited sample size, inferential analyses were performed for exploratory purposes and interpreted cautiously.
RESULTS: Out of 278 invited participants, 46 complete responses (16.5%) were received, which was substantially lower than the calculated minimum sample size. Most participants were aged 31-40 years and had 6-10 years of experience. Orthodontists accounted for 65.2% of the respondents, with oral and maxillofacial surgeons at 34.8%. While most treated 1-4 orthognathic patients monthly, 80% had no experience using CAT in these cases Although CAT was commonly used in routine orthodontic practice, its application in orthognathic surgery cases was limited. Exploratory regression analysis suggested a possible association between clinician age and CAT usage (R 2 = 0.38), whereas gender and years of experience did not show clear associations.
CONCLUSION: This exploratory survey provides preliminary insight into current clinician experience and perceptions regarding the use of clear aligner therapy in orthognathic surgery in Saudi Arabia. Given the low response rate and limited sample size, the findings should be interpreted cautiously as descriptive and hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory, and larger multicenter studies are needed before any definitive conclusions can be drawn.
documents.authors: Salem Assari Ahmad, A Bin Rubaia'an Muslat, Taisir Al-Marhoun Diaa, Arafah Hayat, N Bin Saedan AlAnood, Dar Salamah Hajar, Mohammed Aljomiey Raneem
documents.summary_ja: サウジアラビアの矯正歯科医と口腔顎顔面外科医を対象に、顎顔面外科手術患者におけるクリアアライナーセラピー（CAT）の知識・臨床経験・態度を評価した横断的調査。2023年4月1日〜5月31日にオンライン質問票を配布し、278名中46名（16.5%）から回答を得た。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: CATは通常の矯正治療では広く使用されているものの、顎顔面外科手術症例では80%の回答者が使用経験がなく、外科症例へのCAT導入は限定的である。
documents.why_matters_ja: ワークフロー：デジタルワークフローやCAD/CAM技術の進歩にもかかわらず、外科症例へのCAT適用が限定的であることが示された。教育：外科症例におけるCATの臨床経験の不足が明らかになり、教育・研修の必要性が示唆される。

documents.endpoints_ja: 顎顔面外科手術患者におけるCATの臨床経験・使用状況、臨床医の年齢とCAT使用との関連

documents.title: Per-Layer UV Exposure-Dependent Cytotoxicity of 3D-Printed Aligner Resins and Estrogen-like Activity Screening.
documents.abstract: Per-layer UV exposure during 3D printing may influence polymerization and the biological response of photocurable aligner resins. This study evaluated exposure-dependent cytotoxicity of Tera Harz TC-85 and NextDent Ortho Flex and performed an exploratory screening of selected resin-specific printing conditions for ER-selective estrogen-like responses. TC-85 was printed at 2.0, 2.4, 3.0, and 4.0 s per layer, and Ortho Flex at 5.0, 6.0, 7.0, and 8.0 s per layer. The resin-specific per-layer UV exposure ranges were selected based on our previous physicochemical characterization of the same materials and printing system. Extracts were prepared according to ISO 10993-12. Cytotoxicity was assessed in human gingival fibroblasts using the MTT assay, while selected conditions (TC-85, 2.4 s; Ortho Flex, 7.0 s) were evaluated in estrogen receptor (ER)-positive MCF-7 and ER-negative MDA-MB-231 cells as an exploratory screening assay rather than a direct test of ER activation. For both resins, per-layer exposure condition, extract concentration, and their interaction significantly affected the normalized MTT response. At 50% extract concentration, normalized MTT responses ranged from 89.2% to 111.3%, whereas Ortho Flex ranged from 8.8% to 76.8%, with the 8.0 s condition being the only Ortho Flex condition above the 70% cytotoxicity threshold. Ortho Flex showed pronounced cytotoxicity in concentrated extracts, particularly at shorter exposure times, whereas TC-85 showed a less monotonic exposure-dependent pattern. In the exploratory screening, the 6.25% Ortho Flex extract produced a normalized MCF-7 MTT response of 129.1%, but this was comparable with the corresponding saline vehicle response of 137.0% and was not statistically greater than the response in ER-negative MDA-MB-231 cells. No statistically supported ER-selective response was detected for either tested resin under the specific screening conditions; however, exposure-time dependence of this response was not evaluated. Per-layer UV exposure therefore influenced the HGF-1 MTT response in a resin- and concentration-dependent manner. For dental laboratory practice, these findings support the use of resin-specific, validated printing parameters rather than transferring exposure settings between materials; deviations from manufacturer-specified processing conditions should be independently validated before clinical use.

documents.summary_ja: 3Dプリントにおける層あたりUV露光時間が光硬化型アライナーレジン（Tera Harz TC-85とNextDent Ortho Flex）の細胞毒性に与える影響を評価し、選択された条件についてエストロゲン受容体（ER）選択的なエストロゲン様応答の探索的スクリーニングを行った。TC-85は2.0、2.4、3.0、4.0 s/層、Ortho Flexは5.0、6.0、7.0、8.0 s/層でプリントされた。抽出液はISO 10993-12に準拠して調製され、ヒト歯肉線維芽細胞におけるMTT法で細胞毒性を評価した。選択条件（TC-85 2.4 s、Ortho Flex 7.0 s）については、ER陽性MCF-7細胞とER陰性MDA-MB-231細胞を用いた探索的スクリーニングとして評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 層あたりUV露光時間はレジン種および抽出液濃度に依存してMTT応答に有意に影響した。Ortho Flexは短時間露光条件で高濃度抽出液中に顕著な細胞毒性を示し、TC-85は露光時間依存性が単調ではなかった。いずれのレジンについても統計的に支持されるER選択的応答は検出されなかった。レジン固有の検証済みプリントパラメータの使用を支持する結果であり、材料間の露光設定の転用は避けるべきである。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：アライナー用レジンにおける層あたりUV露光時間と細胞毒性の関連が示され、臨床使用における材料安全性評価の観点で重要。ワークフロー：レジン固有の検証済みプリントパラメータの使用が推奨され、材料間で露光設定を転用すべきでないという知見は、アライナー製造工程の品質管理に直接関連する。

documents.endpoints_ja: ヒト歯肉線維芽細胞における正規化MTT応答（細胞毒性）；ER陽性MCF-7細胞およびER陰性MDA-MB-231細胞における正規化MTT応答（ER選択的エストロゲン様応答の探索的スクリーニング）

documents.title: Salivary parameters in individuals undergoing orthodontic treatment with clear aligners: a scoping review.
documents.abstract:
AIMS: This scoping review aimed to map the salivary parameters investigated in children, adolescents, young adults, and adults undergoing orthodontic treatment with clear aligners, describe saliva collection and analytical assessment methods, and identify methodological gaps in the literature.
METHODS: The review was reported according to PRISMA-ScR and had its protocol registered in the Open Science Framework. Searches were conducted in MEDLINE/PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and ProQuest, without restrictions on year or language. The initial search was performed on June 12, 2024, and updated on September 9, 2025. Two independent reviewers screened records in Rayyan, assessed full texts, and extracted data using a standardized form. Eligible studies were primary clinical investigations assessing salivary parameters in individuals undergoing clear aligner therapy. Data were synthesized descriptively, without a formal risk-of-bias appraisal.
RESULTS: From 3225 records, 1917 references were screened, 28 full texts were assessed, and 22 studies from 11 countries were included. The included reports comprised 880 participants across all groups (494 clear aligner and 386 comparator participants), although potential overlap between reports cannot be excluded. Most studies were prospective observational investigations, and pediatric participants were underrepresented. Invisalign™ was the most frequently investigated aligner system, although several studies used other thermoformed appliances or did not specify the brand. The included studies varied substantially in follow-up schedules, pre-sampling instructions, saliva type, collection procedures, sample processing, storage conditions, and analytical platforms. Salivary outcomes were mapped into four domains: microbiological parameters, biochemical and immunological markers, physicochemical properties, and material-related chemical eluents. Microbiological outcomes were the most frequently mapped domain, followed by inflammatory, oxidative stress, hormonal, enzymatic, physicochemical, BPA, monomer, and metabolite-related outcomes.
CONCLUSION: This scoping review provides a descriptive map of salivary parameters investigated during clear aligner therapy and the methods used for their collection and assessment. Methodological variability limits comparability across studies. Future research should prioritize standardized saliva collection, processing, storage, analytical reporting, age-stratified sampling, and transparent reporting of aligner materials and clinical context.

documents.title: Why does digitally predicted tooth movement fail? the biology-digital mismatch in orthodontics: a critical narrative review.
documents.abstract: Digital orthodontics has advanced through intraoral scanning, CAD/CAM, virtual planning, and clear aligners; however, discrepancies remain between predicted and actual tooth movements. This narrative review critically examined the biological and biomechanical factors underlying the limited predictability of digitally planned orthodontic treatment. A structured literature search of PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar was conducted and peer-reviewed articles were critically analyzed. Current digital systems primarily operate on geometric and algorithm-based models that assume linear and standardized tooth movements, whereas actual orthodontic tooth movements are governed by nonlinear biological processes, including periodontal ligament remodeling, bone turnover, mechanotransduction pathways, and substantial patient-specific variability. Clinical evidence shows a lower predictability for torque, extrusion, intrusion, and rotation than for tipping and expansion. The limitations of biomechanical models, force decay, and tracking loss are discussed along with AI applications in treatment planning. Future progress will require the integration of biological profiling, adaptive biomechanics, and AI-driven systems to enhance precision and manage patient expectations.
documents.authors: Alsulaiman Ahmed A
documents.summary_ja: デジタル矯正治療における予測歯移動と実際歯移動の不一致（biology-digital mismatch）を批判的に検討したナラティブレビュー。PubMed、Scopus、Google Scholarで構造化文献検索を行い、デジタル計画の予測可能性を制限する生物学的・生力学的要因を分析した。現在のデジタルシステムは線形かつ標準化された歯移動を仮定する幾何学的・アルゴリズムベースのモデルで動作するが、実際の歯移動は歯槽骨のリモデリング、骨代謝、機械伝達経路、患者固有の変動性など非線形な生物学的過程に支配される。臨床証拠として、トルク、抜歯、圧入、回転はチッピングや拡大よりも予測可能性が低いことが示されている。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: デジタル矯正計画の予測可能性の限界は、システムが線形・標準化された歯移動を仮定する一方、実際の歯移動が非線形な生物学的過程に支配されるという根本的なミスマッチに起因する。トルク、抜歯、圧入、回転はチッピングや拡大よりも予測困難である。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 予測歯移動と実際歯移動の不一致が明確に指摘され、特にトルク・抜歯・圧入・回転で予測可能性が低いことが臨床証拠として示されている。planning quality: 現在の幾何学的・アルゴリズムベースモデルの限界（線形仮定、力減衰、トラッキング喪失）が計画品質のボトルネックとして議論されている。refinement: 将来の改善には生物学的プロファイリング、適応的生力学、AI駆動システムの統合が必要と提言されている。教育: 患者の期待管理（manage patient expectations）が将来の課題として言及されている。

documents.title: Torque expression in directly printed and thermoformed clear aligners: a controlled in vitro biomechanical comparison of power ridge effects.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Torque control of anterior teeth remains a major challenge in clear aligner therapy. Power ridges have been introduced to improve buccolingual root control; however, their biomechanical performance in directly printed aligners remains insufficiently investigated. The aim of this study was to compare the torque efficiency of power ridges in thermoformed and directly printed aligners.
METHODOLOGY: A controlled in-vitro study was conducted using a standardised maxillary model requiring incisor torque correction. Four aligner groups were evaluated: Zendura Flex thermoformed aligners (Bay Materials LLC, USA) with (ZF-PR) and without (ZF-C) power ridges, and two directly printed aligners with power ridges fabricated from TA-28 (Graphy Inc., Seoul, South Korea) and DCA (LuxCreo Inc., Bellevue, WA, USA) resin materials. Power ridges were digitally positioned on the labial gingival third of the maxillary central incisors. Biomechanical testing was performed using the Orthodontic Measurement and Simulation System (OMSS) to assess torque expression, root displacement, and force-moment systems under controlled temperatures (25 °C and 37 °C).
RESULTS: Torque expression demonstrated a clear material-dependent pattern. ZF-C, used as the baseline, showed moderate and consistent torque expression (38-39% of the programmed torque) across temperatures, with no significant temperature-dependent differences. DCA exhibited the highest torque expression, reaching 62% at 25 °C and 47% at 37 °C. ZF-PR showed intermediate performance (32-42%) with moderate temperature-related variation. TA-28 demonstrated the lowest torque expression (10-17%) with no significant temperature effect. Secondary outcomes supported these findings, with moment generation and displacement patterns correlating with torque expression, whereas force magnitude did not.
CONCLUSIONS: Torque expression in clear aligner systems is primarily governed by material properties and thermomechanical behaviour. Design features alone cannot fully compensate for limitations in material performance. Effective torque delivery depends on the generation and transmission of an appropriate force-moment system rather than on force magnitude alone.

documents.summary_ja: 熱成形型と直接印刷型のクリアアライナーにおけるパワーリッジのトルク効率を比較した管理下インビトロ生体力学的研究。上顎標準モデルを用い、切歯のトルク矯正を必要とする4群（Zendura Flex熱成形型：パワーリッジ有/無、直接印刷型：TA-28樹脂、DCA樹脂）をOMSS（Orthodontic Measurement and Simulation System）で25°Cおよび37°C条件下にて評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナーのトルク発現は主に材料特性と熱力学的挙動によって支配される。設計要素（パワーリッジ）のみでは材料性能の限界を完全に補償できない。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: プログラムされたトルクに対する実際のトルク発現率（38-39%、62%、32-42%、10-17%）を材料別に定量化しており、治療計画時のトルク補正量の過小評価リスクを材料選択の観点から示唆する。planning quality: 材料特性がトルク発現の主要因であるという知見は、トルク矯正を伴う症例におけるアライナー材料選定と計画精度の関連に直接関連する。
documents.study_type_ja: 管理下インビトロ生体力学的比較研究（Comparative Study）
documents.endpoints_ja: トルク発現率（プログラムトルクに対する割合）、根尖部変位、モーメント発生、力-モーメントシステム、力的大小
documents.endpoint_results_ja: ZF-C（熱成形型・パワーリッジ無）: 38-39%（温度依存性有意差なし）。DCA（直接印刷型）: 25°Cで62%、37°Cで47%。ZF-PR（熱成形型・パワーリッジ有）: 32-42%（温度関連の中等度変動）。TA-28（直接印刷型）: 10-17%（温度効果有意差なし）。モーメント発生と変位パターンはトルク発現と相関、力的大小は相関なし。

documents.title: Hygroscopic behaviour and colour stability of 3D-printed and thermoformed aligner materials: an in vitro study.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Directly 3D-printed aligner materials have recently emerged as an alternative to established thermoformed clear aligners. The aim of this in vitro study was to investigate the colour stability, water sorption, and water solubility of directly 3D-printed aligner materials in comparison with an established thermoformed reference, as these properties are essential for clinical performance but currently insufficiently investigated for directly 3D-printed aligners.
METHODS: Tera Harz TC-85DAC, Freeprint Aligner, Freeprint Aligner with digital polishing, Dental LT Clear V2 and one thermoformed polyethylene terephthalate glycol material (Biolon) were examined. Water sorption and solubility were determined after seven days in distilled water at 37 °C. Colour stability was assessed after 12 h of immersion at 37 °C in turmeric, coffee, black tea, orange juice and distilled water. Total colour differences (ΔE*) were calculated spectrophotometrically using the Commission Internationale de l'Éclairage L*a*b* system and converted into National Bureau of Standards units. Data were analysed by one-way ANOVA with Games-Howell post hoc test and by Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn's test and Bonferroni correction (p < 0.05).
RESULTS: Biolon exhibited the lowest water sorption (mean 10.70 µg/mm³) and negligible solubility (median 0.00 µg/mm³). Among the printed resins, Tera Harz TC-85DAC showed the lowest water sorption (mean 17.28 µg/mm³) and solubility (median 2.50 µg/mm³), whereas Dental LT Clear V2 displayed the highest sorption (mean 29.53 µg/mm³) and Freeprint Aligner with digital polishing the highest solubility (median 17.38 µg/mm³). Turmeric caused the most pronounced discolouration, followed by coffee and black tea, while orange juice and water produced minimal changes. The thermoformed material remained most colour-stable (mean of the median ΔE* values across all immersion media = 4.21), whereas Dental LT Clear V2 showed the greatest discolouration (mean of the median ΔE* values = 27.35). Among the printed resins, Tera Harz TC-85DAC displayed the lowest staining susceptibility.
CONCLUSIONS: The tested aligner materials differed markedly in water sorption, solubility, and colour stability. The thermoformed polyethylene terephthalate glycol material consistently showed the most favourable profile. Among the printed resins, Tera Harz TC-85DAC exhibited the most favourable combination of the investigated properties, supporting its potential for clinical application.

documents.summary_ja: 直接3Dプリント型アライナー材料（Tera Harz TC-85DAC、Freeprint Aligner、Freeprint Aligner with digital polishing、Dental LT Clear V2）と熱成形PETG材料（Biolon）の吸水率、水溶性、色安定性をin vitro条件下で比較した研究。37°Cで7日間の水浸漬による吸水・溶解、12時間の各種浸漬液（ターメリック、コーヒー、紅茶、オレンジジュース、蒸留水）による色変化（ΔE*）を評価した。

documents.title: Effects of cleaning protocols on the material properties of clear aligners and retainers: A systematic review.
documents.abstract: Clear aligners and retainers are widely used in contemporary orthodontics because of their esthetic appearance, removability, and patient-centered advantages. However, repeated exposure to dietary pigments and cleaning procedures may alter their optical, surface, mechanical, and chemical properties, potentially affecting appliance appearance, hygiene, and performance. This systematic review evaluated changes in the material properties of clear aligners and retainers following different cleaning protocols. Electronic searches were performed in PubMed, Scopus, LILACS, and the Cochrane Library from inception to February 28, 2026. Twenty studies were included, comprising 18 in vitro studies and 2 randomized clinical crossover studies. Cleaning protocols were categorized as mechanical, chemical, sonic or ultrasonic, and combined approaches. Optical and surface properties were the most frequently assessed outcomes, whereas evidence regarding mechanical properties, water absorption or mass change, and chemical composition remained limited. Across studies, the magnitude and direction of material changes varied according to appliance material, manufacturing method, cleaning modality, exposure duration, and outcome measurement. Mechanical brushing, particularly with toothpaste, was frequently associated with surface alteration, whereas chemical cleaning produced material- and exposure-dependent effects. Evidence regarding sonic or ultrasonic cleaning and directly printed aligners remained limited. Because most available evidence was derived from heterogeneous in vitro studies, no specific cleaning protocol can currently be considered universally optimal or supported by sufficient clinical evidence for routine recommendation. Future studies should adopt standardized designs, incorporate clinically relevant intraoral simulations, integrate biological and material outcomes, and further investigate additive manufacturing-related factors, particularly through adequately powered prospective clinical studies with standardized outcome measures.

documents.title: Determinants of public preference for orthodontic appliances and treatment providers: a scoping review.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Laypeople can choose from a variety of orthodontic care pathways. It is in the clinician's best interest to understand their preferences in order to tailor consumer engagement. This scoping review maps the evidence concerning laypeople's preferences for orthodontic providers and appliances.
METHODS: The review follows Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews guidelines. Two reviewers conducted a systematic search and an independent screening process across five electronic databases until December 2025.
RESULTS: A total of 56 studies (48 cross-sectional questionnaires; seven qualitative; one mixed methods) comprising 16,271 laypeople across 17 countries were included. Forty-two studies examined perspectives for orthodontic appliances, and 20 studies investigated providers. Specialist orthodontists were consistently the most preferred treatment providers, primarily associated with perceived higher quality and expertise. Direct-to-consumer (DTC) treatment appealed to a minority and was associated with lower cost, self-perceived easier-to-treat malocclusion and convenience. Adults preferred and were willing to pay more for aesthetic appliances, whereas children and adolescents perceived metallic braces as more aesthetic. Pragmatic appliance features such as effectiveness, comfort, and treatment outcomes often outweighed appearance, especially among informed or experienced patients. Common public misperceptions included confusion between general dentists and orthodontists, and overestimation of DTC safety and effectiveness.
CONCLUSION: While DTC and aligners appeal to the public demand for aesthetics and convenience, preference for orthodontists and fixed appliances remains strong, driven by perceived quality and the social acceptability of metal braces in children and adolescents. Better public and in-chair education is recommended to address misperceptions and guide better-informed decision-making.

documents.summary_ja: 一般市民の矯正装置および治療提供者への選好に関するエビデンスをマッピングするスコーピングレビュー。5つの電子データベースから2025年12月まで検索し、17カ国・56研究（横断的アンケート48、定性研究7、混合手法1）・16,271名の一般市民を対象に包含した。専門矯正歯科医が最も選好される治療提供者であり、DTC治療は少数派に支持された。成人は審美的装置を好む一方、小児・思春期は金属ブラケットをより審美的と認識した。実用的な装置特性（効果、快適性、治療結果）は、特に情報のある患者において外観を上回った。

documents.title: Enhancing the predictability of tooth movements with clear aligners-Part 2: Clinical strategies.
documents.abstract: Despite rapid advances in clear aligner therapy, the low predictability of aligner tooth movements remains a clinical challenge. This article (part 2) translates the conceptual biomechanical triad of anchorage, stress continuity, and aligner-tooth contact, along with the related determinant factors, described in part 1 into practical strategies to enhance the predictability of tooth movements with clear aligners. This paper features 3 interrelated strategic domains: patient-centered, aligner-mediated, and practitioner-directed strategies. Patient-centered strategies emphasize appropriate aligner case selection, aligner-favored treatment planning, and difficulty-based patient management. Aligner-mediated strategies focus on choosing optimal aligner materials, reducing aligner stress concentration, and optimizing aligner designs. Furthermore, practitioner-directed strategies highlight the practitioner's active role in managing the fundamental prerequisites of tooth movements (ie, force, space, and time). This is achieved through deliberate overtreatment with aligners, biomechanical augmentation with attachments and auxiliaries, judicious staging sequences that prioritize predictable movements, and dynamic monitoring and troubleshooting protocols. Collectively, in clinical practice, the 3 strategic domains should not be isolated but rather be integrated to achieve predictable tooth movements with clear aligners.

documents.summary_ja: 本論文は、クリアアライナーによる歯移動の予測可能性を向上させるための臨床戦略をPart 1で述べられた生体力学的三要素（アンカレッジ、応力連続性、アライナー-歯接触）から実践的な戦略へ転換するPart 2である。患者中心戦略（適切な症例選択、アライナーに有利な治療計画、難易度に基づく患者管理）、アライナー媒介戦略（最適な材料選択、応力集中の低減、アライナー設計の最適化）、臨床医主導戦略（過剰治療、アタッチメント・補助装置による生体力学的増強、予測可能な移動を優先した段階的シーケンス、動的モニタリング・トラブルシューティングプロトコル）の3つの相互関連する戦略領域を提示している。

documents.title: Quality and reliability of clear aligner information on Brazilian orthodontists' websites: a DISCERN-based evaluation.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate, using the DISCERN questionnaire, the quality, reliability, and decision-support capacity of aligner-related information published on orthodontists' websites.
METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted in July 2024. Google (www.google.com.br) was searched using Portuguese-language keywords ("tratamento ortodôntico", "alinhadores", and "ortodontia") in incognito mode from a Brazilian IP address. The first 130 non-sponsored websites were screened; 113 met the inclusion criteria. Two calibrated orthodontists independently evaluated each website using the validated Brazilian Portuguese version of the DISCERN instrument. Inter-rater reliability was assessed using the Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC). Descriptive statistics and Spearman rank-order correlations were calculated using SPSS v.25.
RESULTS: The mean overall DISCERN score was 26.3 (SD = 5.8; range 15-52) out of a maximum of 75. The ICC was 0.87 (95% CI = 0.82-0.91), indicating good-to-excellent inter-rater reliability. Among the 113 websites, 54.3% were rated as very poor, 30.7% as poor, 11.5% as fair, 3.5% as good, and none as excellent. The lowest-scoring items were Q4 (sources of information, 99.1% very poor or poor), Q5 (publication date, 87.6%), Q8 (areas of uncertainty, 95.6%), Q11 (treatment risks, 98.2%), and Q12 (consequences of no treatment, 100%).
CONCLUSIONS: The quality of clear aligner information on Brazilian orthodontists' websites is critically poor. Orthodontists should provide evidence-based, transparent, and balanced content - including treatment risks, alternatives, and references - to support informed patient decision-making.

documents.key_takeaway_ja: ブラジル矯正歯科医のウェブサイト上のクリアアライナー情報の品質は極めて低く、54.3%が「非常に不良」、30.7%が「不良」と評価された。治療リスク（Q11: 98.2%）、治療しない場合の帰結（Q12: 100%）、不確実性の領域（Q8: 95.6%）が最も低得点であった。

documents.title: Conversational artificial intelligence compared with orthodontic reference standards for orthodontic information: A systematic review of accuracy, readability, safety, and certainty of evidence.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Conversational artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to obtain orthodontic information, but its reliability, completeness, readability, agreement with specialist judgment, and safety remain uncertain.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate AI chatbots for delivering orthodontic information and clinical guidance, focusing on accuracy/reliability, completeness, readability, specialist agreement, and misleading information.
METHODS: This systematic review followed PRISMA 2020 and Cochrane guidance. Embase, PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, ClinicalTrials.gov, Open Science Framework, and Google Scholar were searched. Eligible studies assessed AI-generated orthodontic responses against specialists, reference answers, or structured assessment tools. Risk of bias was evaluated using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist. Meta-analysis was not performed because of substantial heterogeneity in chatbot systems, prompts, comparators, scoring instruments, and outcome definitions. Certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.
RESULTS: Sixteen analytical cross-sectional studies were included. Chatbots generated coherent and accessible answers to routine orthodontic questions, especially foundational concepts and patient frequently asked questions. However, performance varied by model version, prompt design, and clinical complexity. Important limitations were identified in treatment planning, individualized recommendations, contextual risk framing, and information completeness. Some studies reported incomplete or false claims regarding clear aligners, airway effects, stability, and surgery. Readability was generally favorable but did not ensure clinical adequacy. Risk of bias ranged from low to moderate, and certainty of evidence was very low.
CONCLUSIONS: AI chatbots may support routine orthodontic education under professional supervision, but current evidence does not support autonomous use. Standardized prompts, validated scoring tools, calibrated evaluators, and real-world outcome studies are needed.

documents.title: Effectiveness of Contemporary Invisalign® Clear Aligners for Derotation and Deep Bite Correction of Different Degrees of Severity in Adolescents and Adults: A Retrospective Clinical Study.
documents.abstract: Introduction Clear aligners have evolved substantially with improvements in aligner materials, digital treatment planning, and optimized attachments. However, the predictability of complex movements such as tooth derotation and deep bite correction remains variable. This study evaluated the effectiveness of contemporary Invisalign® clear aligners (Align Technology, Inc., Tempe, AZ) for these movements and examined factors associated with treatment accuracy. Materials and methods This retrospective clinical study included 50 patients treated with contemporary Invisalign® clear aligners. Twenty-five patients were classified as growing and 25 as non-growing. Treatment accuracy was determined by comparing the predicted and achieved tooth movements using a digital model assessment. Derotation accuracy was evaluated according to the growth status, rotational severity, tooth type, and dental arch. Deep bite correction accuracy was assessed according to growth status, severity, anterior and posterior attachments, incisor proclination, and posterior extrusion. Non-parametric statistical tests were used, with statistical significance set at p < 0.05. Results Derotation accuracy did not differ significantly between growing and non-growing patients (82.61% vs. 83.59%; p = 0.218). Accuracy differed significantly according to rotational severity (p < 0.001), with median values of 88.83%, 78.61%, and 61.77% for mild, moderate, and severe rotation, respectively. The difference in tooth type was also significant (p = 0.005). Deep bite correction accuracy did not differ according to growth status (69.0% vs. 61.5%; p = 0.633) but differed significantly according to severity (p = 0.026), with median accuracies of 100.0%, 66.7%, and 57.5% for mild, moderate, and severe cases, respectively. For deep bite correction, the severity of the initial deep bite and mandibular incisor proclination was significantly associated with treatment accuracy. Conclusion Contemporary Invisalign® clear aligners were effective for derotation and deep bite correction, although their accuracy decreased with increasing treatment severity.
documents.authors: Chhaya Shweta, Sharma Tanvi, Palande Supriya, Pakolu Swati, Agawane Pranali, Vandekar Meghna
documents.summary_ja: 現代のInvisalign®クリアアライナーによる歯の回転矯正（derotation）と深覆蓋（deep bite）矯正の有効性を、成長期と非成長期の患者で比較検討した後ろ向き臨床研究。50例を対象に、デジタルモデル評価により予測された歯の移動と実際に達成された移動を比較し、治療精度を評価した。回転矯正の精度は成長状態間で有意差はなかったが、回転の重症度により有意に異なり（軽度88.83%、中等度78.61%、重度61.77%）、歯の種類によっても有意差があった（p=0.005）。深覆蓋矯正の精度は成長状態間で有意差はなかったが、重症度により有意に異なり（軽度100.0%、中等度66.7%、重度57.5%）、初期深覆蓋の重症度と下顎切歯の唇側傾斜が治療精度と有意に関連した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 現代のInvisalign®クリアアライナーは回転矯正と深覆蓋矯正に有効であるが、治療の重症度が増すにつれて精度が低下する。

documents.title: Dentoalveolar Transverse Changes in Adolescents Treated with Fixed Appliances or Clear Aligners: A Retrospective Comparative Study.
documents.abstract: Background: Dentoalveolar transverse constriction is frequently encountered during orthodontic treatment in adolescents. Although both fixed appliances and clear aligners can produce transverse dental arch changes, comparative evidence regarding their expansion patterns in growing patients remains limited. This study aimed to compare dentoalveolar transverse changes associated with two fixed treatment groups and two clear aligner systems in an adolescent population. Methods: This retrospective, non-randomized comparative study included 85 adolescents treated without extractions using conventional MBT fixed appliances (n = 22), Damon Q passive self-ligating appliances (n = 19), Invisalign (n = 21), or ClearCorrect (n = 23). Pretreatment (T0) and post-treatment (T1) digital dental models obtained using a 3Shape TRIOS intraoral scanner were evaluated for maxillary and mandibular transverse arch dimensions, projected palatal area, and maxillary first-molar crown inclination. Intergroup differences in treatment-related changes were compared among the four treatment groups. Results: Significant increases in maxillary transverse dimensions were observed after treatment in all four groups. The greatest mean increases at several maxillary levels were observed in the Damon Q group, including intercanine width (3.66 ± 1.34 mm) and first-molar width (3.69 ± 1.70 mm). In the ClearCorrect group, the mean increases were 3.12 ± 1.90 mm for intercanine width and 2.46 ± 1.42 mm for first-molar width. Projected palatal area increased in all groups, with the greatest mean increase observed with Damon Q (115.16 ± 29.70 mm2). Exploratory assessment of maxillary first-molar clinical crown inclination showed comparatively smaller changes in the ClearCorrect group than in the other treatment groups. Conclusions: All four treatment groups demonstrated increases in dentoalveolar transverse dimensions in this adolescent sample, although the magnitude and pattern of the observed changes differed among groups. Greater transverse increases at several maxillary levels were observed in the Damon Q group, whereas comparatively smaller changes in posterior crown inclination were observed in the ClearCorrect group. Because skeletal maturation was not directly assessed and an untreated control group was unavailable, these findings represent comparative changes observed during treatment and cannot distinguish appliance-related effects from physiological growth or other treatment-related factors.
documents.authors: Sari Ömer Faruk, Buyukcavus Muhammed Hilmi
documents.summary_ja: 思春期患者85名を対象に、MBT固定装置、Damon Qパッシブセルフリゲイティング装置、Invisalign、ClearCorrectの4群で、治療前後の歯槽骨横径変化（上顎・下顎横径、投影口蓋面積、上顎第一大臼歯冠傾斜）を比較した後ろ向き非ランダム比較研究。

documents.title: Feasibility of Non-surgical Orthodontic Management in Syndromic Skeletal Class III - A Case Report.
documents.abstract: Skeletal Class III malocclusions are frequently associated with craniosynostosis syndromes, resulting in distinctive facial and dental anomalies. Among these, Crouzon syndrome is characterised by mutations in the FGFR2 gene, leading to premature fusion of the cranial vault, cranial base, orbital and maxillary sutures. The phenotypic expression of this congenital condition varies according to the timing and pattern of sutural fusion. This report details the clinical features and management of a 16-year-old male patient presenting with moderate skeletal Class III malocclusion as a manifestation of Crouzon syndrome. The present case fell within the spectrum of conventional non-surgical management. Adjunctive chin cup therapy initiated after rapid maxillary expansion aided in controlling residual mandibular growth, contributing to a favourable outcome in a hypodivergent pattern. Functional and aesthetic outcomes were markedly enhanced, and the results remained stable at the one-year follow-up assessment. Excellent compliance over 36 months contributed to treatment success and stability.
documents.journal: Indian journal of dental research : official publication of Indian Society for Dental Research
documents.authors: Kumar Snigdha, Shastri Dipti, Singh Gulshan K
documents.summary_ja: Crouzon症候群を伴う16歳男性の中等度骨格性Class III不正咬合に対し、急速上顎拡大（RME）後に補助的下顎前方牽引装置（chin cup）を併用した非外科的矯正治療の症例報告。1年フォローアップで結果は安定し、36ヶ月にわたり良好なコンプライアンスが得られた。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: Crouzon症候群に伴う中等度骨格性Class III不正咬合は、非外科的治療のスペクトラム内にある場合、RMEとchin cupの併用により機能的・審美的に良好な結果が得られ、1年時点で安定性を示しうる。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：症候群に伴う骨格性Class IIIに対し非外科的アプローチを選択し、1年フォローアップで安定を確認した。計画品質の観点：症候群由来の骨格性不正咬合において、非外科的治療の適応範囲（spectrum of conventional non-surgical management）を判断した治療計画の意思決定が示されている。

documents.title: Comparison of different clear aligner systems with fixed orthodontic treatment in terms of endocrine-disrupting monomer release, treatment effectiveness and efficiency : An in vivo randomized clinical trial.
documents.abstract:
PURPOSE: The aim of this four-arm parallel trial was to evaluate and compare directly and indirectly produced clear aligners with fixed orthodontic treatment in terms of bisphenol A (BPA) release, as well as treatment effectiveness and efficiency.
METHODS: In all, 52 patients were randomly allocated to four treatment groups according to the appliance system used: direct three-dimensionally (3D)-printed aligners (group A), Invisalign aligners (Align Technology, Santa Clara, CA, USA; group B), ClearCorrect aligners (Round Rock, TX, USA; group C), and fixed orthodontic appliances (group D). Saliva samples were collected at baseline and at multiple time points during the first and final weeks of treatment to evaluate salivary BPA levels. Intraoral scan records were obtained at the beginning and end of treatment. High-performance liquid chromatography was used to analyze the saliva samples, and the Peer Assessment Rating (PAR) index was employed to evaluate treatment effectiveness. In addition, total treatment duration was assessed.
RESULTS: No statistically significant difference was observed between the groups regarding the BPA values measured in saliva at different time points, nor in the percentage reduction of PAR score values (p > 0.05). Total treatment duration was 6.59 ± 1.42 months in group A, 5.36 ± 1.63 months in group B, 5.72 ± 1.88 months in group C, and 10.16 ± 2.28 months in group D. The fixed orthodontic treatment group (group D) had a longer treatment duration than the other groups (p < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: No differences in BPA release were observed among the different treatment modalities. Additional long-term studies are needed to clarify the biological relevance of these findings. In terms of treatment effectiveness, no significant difference was observed between direct and indirect clear aligner techniques and fixed orthodontic treatment. The overall duration of fixed orthodontic treatment was longer than that of clear aligner therapies.
documents.journal: Journal of orofacial orthopedics = Fortschritte der Kieferorthopadie : Organ/official journal Deutsche Gesellschaft fur Kieferorthopadie
documents.authors: Hashimli Nizami, Yagci Ahmet, Cadir Mehmet
documents.summary_ja: 直接3Dプリント型マウスピース（Group A）、Invisalign（Group B）、ClearCorrect（Group C）、固定式矯正装置（Group D）の4群に52例を無作為割り付けし、唾液中ビスフェノールA（BPA）濃度、PARスコア減少率、総治療期間を比較した4群並行型ランダム化臨床試験。BPA濃度およびPARスコア減少率には群間差は認められなかった（p > 0.05）。総治療期間は固定式矯正装置群（10.16 ± 2.28ヶ月）がマウスピース群より有意に長かった（p < 0.001）。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 直接3Dプリント型・間接型マウスピースおよび固定式矯正装置間でBPA放出量や治療効果（PARスコア減少率）に有意差は認められず、総治療期間はマウスピース群が固定式矯正装置群より有意に短かった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：BPA放出量についてマウスピース各システムと固定式装置間で有意差がなかったことは、マウスピース材料の安全性に関する臨床的エビデンスとして位置づけられる。治療効果の観点：PARスコア減少率に群間差がなかったことは、Invisalignを含むマウスピース治療が固定式装置と同等の整列精度を達成できることを示唆する。ワークフロー効率の観点：Invisalign群の総治療期間（5.36 ± 1.63ヶ月）が固定式装置群（10.16 ± 2.28ヶ月）より有意に短かったことは、治療効率の面でマウスピース治療の優位性を示す。

documents.endpoint_results_ja: 唾液中BPA濃度：各時点において群間に統計的に有意な差は認められなかった（p > 0.05）。PARスコア減少率：群間に有意差は認められなかった（p > 0.05）。総治療期間：Group A 6.59 ± 1.42ヶ月、Group B 5.36 ± 1.63ヶ月、Group C 5.72 ± 1.88ヶ月、Group D 10.16 ± 2.28ヶ月。Group Dが他の群より有意に長かった（p < 0.001）。

documents.title: Biomechanical analysis of maxillary incisor intrusion with clear aligners under different periodontal conditions: a finite element analysis.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To investigate the biomechanical effects and determine the optimal increment for maxillary incisor intrusion using clear aligners across three periodontal conditions via finite element analysis (FEA).
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Nine FE models were created in a 3 × 3 design simulating three periodontal states (M1: normal bone level; M2: one-third alveolar bone loss; M3: one-half alveolar bone loss) combined with three intrusion increments (0.10, 0.15, and 0.20 mm). Anterior tooth displacement, root von Mises stress, and periodontal ligament (PDL) maximum compressive stress were analyzed.
RESULTS: Tooth displacement and mechanical stresses escalated with greater bone loss and larger increments. Central incisors experienced more pronounced tipping, whereas lateral incisors achieved greater vertical intrusion. Consequently, lateral incisors endured higher stresses; their PDL stress was approximately double that of central incisors. While central incisor intrusion efficiency increased proportionally with increment, lateral incisors in M2 and M3 states demonstrated higher efficiency at the 0.15-mm increment (peaking at 92.0%) than at 0.20 mm. In the M3 state, increasing the increment from 0.10 to 0.20 mm sharply amplified lateral incisor root stress (2.96-8.18 MPa) and PDL stress (0.056-0.114 MPa).
CONCLUSION: Clear aligners produce maxillary incisor intrusion with concurrent tipping. Lateral incisors show higher intrusion efficiency but endure greater mechanical stress than central incisors. Alveolar bone loss exacerbates both tipping tendency and stress. For patients with alveolar bone loss exceeding one-third, the intrusion increment is recommended to be limited to 0.15 mm.
documents.authors: Li Qiuying, Zhang Yidan, Xu Bowen, Bai Linna, Yang Kai
documents.summary_ja: 上顎前歯のクリアアライナーによる圧入において、3つの歯周状態（M1: 正常骨レベル、M2: 1/3歯槽骨吸収、M3: 1/2歯槽骨吸収）と3つの圧入量（0.10、0.15、0.20 mm）の3×3デザインで9つの有限要素モデルを作成し、前歯の歯移動、歯根von Mises応力、歯槽骨膜（PDL）最大圧縮応力を解析した計算力学研究。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 歯槽骨吸収が1/3を超える患者では、圧入量を0.15 mmに制限することが推奨される。側切歯は中切歯より圧入効率が高いが、より大きな機械的応力を承受する。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療計画品質の観点：側切歯の圧入効率はM2・M3状態で0.15 mm圧入時に92.0%でピークに達し、0.20 mmでは低下するため、planned-vs-achievedの予測に直接関連。安全性の観点：M3状態で圧入量を0.10→0.20 mmに増加させると側切歯の歯根応力（2.96-8.18 MPa）とPDL応力（0.056-0.114 MPa）が急激に増大し、歯周条件に応じた圧入量のrefinementが治療安全性に寄与する。

documents.title: Effect of power arm length and attachment configuration on maxillary molar mesialization with clear aligners: a finite element analysis.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Maxillary molar mesialization with clear aligners is challenging because achieving controlled root movement without excessive mesial tipping remains difficult. Although power arms can modify the force system, the combined effects of power-arm length and attachment configuration on molar displacement and tipping remain insufficiently characterized. This study evaluated the effects of 6-, 8-, and 10-mm power arms combined with two attachment configurations during maxillary first molar mesialization using three-dimensional finite element analysis.
METHODS: The attachment configurations were selected to represent two clinically distinct approaches to integrating a vertical attachment with a power arm: a palatal vertical attachment combined with a buccal cut-out and a buccal vertical attachment with direct power-arm integration. Six three-dimensional finite element models were constructed by combining three power arm lengths (6, 8, and 10 mm) with two attachment configurations: a palatal vertical attachment with a buccal cut-out, and a buccal vertical attachment without a cut-out. A mesial force of 200 g was applied from a temporary anchorage device (TAD) to the power arm. Displacements were measured along the X (bucco-palatal), Y (mesio-distal), and Z (occluso-gingival) axes. Peak von Mises stress values in the periodontal ligament and aligner deformation were evaluated.
RESULTS: In all models, maxillary first molar displacement occurred predominantly in the mesial and gingival directions. Mesial crown displacement ranged from 0.068 to 0.074 mm, while distal displacement at the root apex ranged from 0.011 to 0.012 mm. Mesial tipping angles ranged from 0.155° to 0.170°, with higher tipping observed in models with shorter power arms. Increasing power arm length was consistently associated with reduced mesial tipping and lower periodontal ligament stress, but with reduced mesial crown displacement. Shorter power arms generated higher periodontal ligament stress, whereas longer power arms were associated with greater aligner deformation.
CONCLUSIONS: Power arm length and attachment configuration were associated with differences in initial tooth displacement patterns, periodontal ligament stress distribution, and aligner deformation during maxillary first molar mesialization with clear aligners. Longer power arms were associated with reduced mesial tipping and lower periodontal ligament stress, but also with reduced mesial crown displacement. The buccal vertical attachment configuration consistently produced lower mesial rotation than the palatal vertical attachment with buccal cut-out configuration at each corresponding power-arm length; this difference should be interpreted as a configuration-dependent finding within the initial biomechanical response.
documents.authors: Cavusoglu Ahmet, Erdem Buket
documents.summary_ja: 上顎第一大臼歯の近心移動において、パワーアームの長さ（6mm、8mm、10mm）とアタッチメント構成（腭側垂直アタッチメント＋頬側カットアウト、頬側垂直アタッチメント＋直接パワーアーム統合）の組み合わせが歯の移動・チッピング・歯槽靱帯応力・アライナー変形に与える影響を、3次元有限要素解析で評価した研究。200gの近心力をTADからパワーアームに施加し、X（頬舌側）、Y（近遠心）、Z（咬合歯頸側）軸方向の変位、歯槽靱帯のピークvon Mises応力、アライナー変形を測定した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: パワーアームを長くするほど近心チッピングと歯槽靱帯応力は低減するが、近心冠変位は減少する。頬側垂直アタッチメント構成は、対応するパワーアーム長において腭側垂直アタッチメント＋頬側カットアウト構成よりも常に低い近心回転を示した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：パワーアーム長とアタッチメント構成の組み合わせによる初期歯移動パターンの違いが定量的に示され、治療計画時の力系設計の根拠となる。安全性：パワーアーム長と歯槽靱帯応力の関係が明確化され、過大なPDL応力を回避するための設計指針が得られる。

documents.title: The impact of clear aligners therapy on dental caries: a systematic review.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Dental caries is one of the most prevalent chronic conditions worldwide, significantly affecting public health and individual quality of life. Orthodontic treatments, particularly fixed appliances, may increase caries risk due to plaque retention and changes in the oral microbiota. Clear aligners, such as Invisalign®, represent a removable alternative that may facilitate oral hygiene and oral health. however, their impact on caries development remains a question to be investigate to understand the real opportunity in treating patients reducing the risk of caries.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate the effect of clear aligner therapy on dental caries risk and cariological outcomes compared with fixed or traditional removable orthodontic appliances.
METHODS: A systematic literature search was conducted up to June 2025 in PubMed/MEDLINE and Web of Science. Original clinical studies comparing clear aligners with fixed or traditional removable appliances were included according to predefined PICOS criteria. Outcomes of interest included DMFT scores, caries incidence, white spot lesions, enamel demineralization, and cariogenic bacterial profiles. Study selection and data extraction were performed independently by two reviewers, with disagreements resolved by a third reviewer. Risk of bias was assessed using ROBINS-I.
RESULTS: Three studies met the inclusion criteria (two case-control studies and one prospective cohort study). Two case-control studies reported a significantly greater increase in DMFT scores in patients treated with fixed appliances compared with clear aligners, while no significant differences in proximal caries incidence were observed. The cohort study found no significant differences in salivary levels of Streptococcus mutans and Lactobacilli between treatment modalities. Overall, no evidence of an increased caries risk associated with clear aligners was identified; however, the certainty of evidence was low.
CONCLUSION: Clear aligner therapy does not appear to be associated with a higher risk of dental caries compared with fixed or traditional removable appliances. Nevertheless, the limited number of studies and their methodological limitations highlight the need for well-designed prospective investigations with standardized caries outcomes.
documents.authors: Caruso Silvia, Viarchi Arianna, Ciavarella Domenico, Tepedino Michele, Caruso Sara, Gatto Roberto, Truppa Claudia T, Mattei Antonella
documents.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正が齲蝕リスクに与える影響を、固定式または従来型可撤式矯正装置と比較して体系的に評価したシステマティックレビュー。PubMed/MEDLINEおよびWeb of Scienceを2025年6月まで検索し、PICOS基準に基づき3研究（2件のケースコントロール研究、1件の前向きコホート研究）が包含基準を満たした。DMFTスコア、齲蝕発生率、白斑病変、エナメル質脱灰、う蝕性細菌プロファイルが主要アウトカムとして評価された。

documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：透明マウスピース矯正が固定式装置と比較して齲蝕リスクを増加させないことを示唆しており、治療計画における患者の口腔健康リスク評価に参考となる。ただしエビデンス確実性は低く、臨床判断への反映には注意が必要。

documents.title: Clinical Outcomes of Sequential Distalization with Clear Aligners: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
documents.abstract: Background/Objectives: Sequential distalization with clear aligners is increasingly used as a non-extraction approach for correcting Class II and selected Class III malocclusions. However, evidence remains heterogeneous regarding treatment protocols, anchorage strategies, and clinical outcomes. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the clinical outcomes of sequential distalization with clear aligners, including achieved posterior tooth movement, predictability, biomechanical effects, and other clinically relevant outcomes. Methods: This systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, and the protocol was prospectively registered in the Open Science Framework. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception through 1 July 2026. Eligible clinical studies evaluating sequential distalization with clear aligners were included. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed for sufficiently comparable outcomes, and certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE. Results: Twenty-eight studies met the inclusion criteria. Pooled mean achieved distalization was 1.72 mm (95% CI, 1.02-2.42) for the maxillary first molar and 1.76 mm (95% CI, 1.12-2.40) for the maxillary second molar. Pooled distal tipping was 5.33° (95% CI, 1.37-9.30) for first molars and 5.77° (95% CI, -6.84-18.38) for second molars. First-molar intrusion was 0.58 mm (95% CI, 0.05-1.10). Movement predictability varied substantially across studies. Certainty of evidence was very low across clinically important domains. Conclusions: Sequential distalization with clear aligners may achieve moderate maxillary molar distalization but is accompanied by variable movement expression and biomechanical effects. Heterogeneous protocols and limited study quality restrict the certainty and generalizability of current estimates.
documents.authors: Baxmann Martin, Zsoldos Márton, Kárpáti Krisztina
documents.summary_ja: クリアラライナーによるsequential distalizationの臨床アウトカムを評価したシステマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス。PRISMA 2020ガイドラインに従い、PubMed、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science Core Collection、Cochrane Libraryを検索し、28件の研究が包含基準を満たした。上顎第一大臼歯の平均達成遠心移動量は1.72 mm（95% CI, 1.02-2.42）、上顎第二大臼歯は1.76 mm（95% CI, 1.12-2.40）であった。第一大臼歯の遠心チッピングは5.33°（95% CI, 1.37-9.30）、第二大臼歯は5.77°（95% CI, -6.84-18.38）、第一大臼歯の圧入は0.58 mm（95% CI, 0.05-1.10）であった。移動の予測可能性は研究間で大きく異なり、臨床的に重要な領域におけるエビデンスの確実性は非常に低かった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナーによるsequential distalizationは上顎臼歯の中等度の遠心移動を達成し得るが、移動表現の変動性と生物力学的影響を伴う。プロトコルの異質性と研究品質の限界により、現在の推定値の確実性と一般化可能性が制限される。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 移動の予測可能性（movement predictability）が研究間で大きく異なり、計画値と達成値の乖離が臨床的に重要な問題として示唆されている。planning quality: 治療プロトコルやアンカレッジ戦略の異質性がエビデンスの確実性を制限しており、治療計画の標準化が課題である。

documents.title: Effects of clear aligner cleaning agents on Streptococcus mutans biofilms and thermoplastic surface integrity: an in vitro study.
documents.abstract: Clear aligners are increasingly used in paediatric and adolescent orthodontics, but prolonged wear and suboptimal hygiene may promote cariogenic biofilm accumulation. This study aimed to compare the antibacterial efficacy of commonly used commercial and household clear aligner cleaning agents against Streptococcus mutans biofilms and to examine their effects on aligner surface integrity. Biofilms were grown on 48 clear aligner discs; 42 (n = 7 per group across four experimental and two control groups) were used for biofilm quantification, and 6 (n = 1 per group) for SEM analysis. After biofilm formation, discs were treated with Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals, Corega® Proguard and Retainer tablets, Invisalign® Aligner Cleaning Spray, or white vinegar diluted to a final acetic acid concentration of 0.5%. Viable bacteria were quantified as colony-forming units per millilitre (CFU/mL), and surface morphology was assessed by SEM. Data were analysed using the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn-Holm post hoc comparisons (p < 0.05). Commercial agents significantly reduced CFU counts compared with the negative control, whereas white vinegar did not. Median CFU values were lowest for the commercial agents (1.2-2.5 × 10³ CFU/mL), with no significant difference among them, and Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals and Corega® tablets were more effective than white vinegar (p ≤ 0.04). SEM corroborated the microbiological findings, showing substantial biofilm removal without apparent surface deterioration after commercial treatment. These findings support the use of commercial products in evidence-based clear aligner hygiene protocols because of their greater antibiofilm efficacy and preservation of thermoplastic surface integrity.
documents.authors: Nalbantoglu Eser Rengin, Harzivartyan Sevan, Topcuoglu Nursen, Yilmaz Hanife Nuray, Cimilli Zuhre Hale
documents.summary_ja: 本in vitro研究は、市販および家庭用のマウスピース洗浄剤のStreptococcus mutansバイオフィルムに対する抗菌効果と、マウスピース表面への影響を比較した。48枚のマウスピースディスクにバイオフィルムを形成し、Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals、Corega® Proguard and Retainer tablets、Invisalign® Aligner Cleaning Spray、および酢酸0.5%希釈液で処理した。CFU/mLで生菌数を定量し、SEMで表面形態を評価した。市販洗浄剤は陰性対照群と比較してCFU数を有意に減少させたが、酢は有意な減少を示さなかった。SEMでは市販剤処理後に顕著なバイオフィルム除去が確認され、表面劣化は認められなかった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 市販マウスピース洗浄剤（Invisalign® Cleaning Crystals、Corega® tablets、Invisalign® Cleaning Spray）はS. mutansバイオフィルムのCFU数を有意に減少させ（中央値1.2-2.5 × 10³ CFU/mL）、熱可塑性表面の劣化を伴わずにバイオフィルムを除去した。一方、酢（酢酸0.5%）は有意な抗菌効果を示さなかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：市販洗浄剤が熱可塑性マウスピース表面の劣化を伴わずにバイオフィルムを除去することをSEMで確認し、患者の装着安全性に寄与する。教育：エビデンスに基づくマウスピース衛生プロトコルとして市販製品の使用を支持し、患者指導の根拠となる。

documents.endpoints_ja: 1) Streptococcus mutansバイオフィルムの生菌数（CFU/mL）2) SEMによるマウスピース表面形態

documents.title: Analysis of the efficacy of AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancer and Twin Block in the treatment of class II malocclusion in growing patients: a prospective clinical study.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Although the twin block is the most commonly used appliance for the treatment of Class II malocclusion, the clear aligner industry has developed systems with integrated mandibular advancement. The purpose of this study was to evaluate and compare the effects of Twin block appliances, standard AngelAligner clear aligners and AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancement clear aligners as early orthodontic interventions for patients who develop Class II division 1 malocclusion.
METHODS: The study sample comprised 60 patients with a mean age of 12.4 ± 1.3 years, who were divided into three homogeneous groups of 20 patients each and received different treatments: Twin Block (GTB), AngelAligner aligners (GAA) and AngelAligner A6 for mandibular advancement (GA6). Clinical and radiographic assessments were performed at baseline (T0), immediately prior to appliance placement, and repeated after the completion of treatment objectives (T1).
RESULTS: Class II malocclusion was corrected with all three appliances. The GA6 and GTB groups showed similar mandibular advancement, with an increase in the SNB angle of 2.1° and 2.3° respectively, and correction to Class I in 85-90% of cases, outperforming the GAA group, which showed an increase in the SNB angle of 1.2° and correction to Class I in 70% of cases. The duration of treatment was shorter in the GA6 group (15.2 months).
CONCLUSION: These findings suggest that the AngelAligner A6 MA and Twin Block are superior for skeletal correction, whereas the standard AngelAligner is effective for milder cases with aesthetic priorities.
CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT07591025. Registered 6 May 2026. Retrospectively registered.
documents.authors: Scuzzo Giacomo, Scuzzo Giuseppe, Calzadilla-Suárez Elena, Alvarado-Lorenzo Mario, Criado-Pérez Laura, Curto Adrián, Alvarado-Lorenzo Alfonso
documents.summary_ja: 成長期患者のClass II division 1不正咬合に対して、Twin Block、標準AngelAligner、AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancement alignerの3群（各20例、計60例、平均年齢12.4±1.3歳）で前向き比較した臨床試験。3群いずれでもClass II不正咬合は修正されたが、GA6群とGTB群はSNB角の増加が2.1°と2.3°で類似し、Class Iへの修正率は85-90%であった。一方、GAA群はSNB角の増加1.2°、Class I修正率70%で劣っていた。治療期間はGA6群が15.2ヶ月で最も短かった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: AngelAligner A6 mandibular advancement alignerはTwin Blockと同等の骨格修正効果（SNB角増加2.1° vs 2.3°、Class I修正率85-90%）を示し、標準AngelAligner（SNB角増加1.2°、Class I修正率70%）を上回った。治療期間はGA6群が15.2ヶ月で短縮された。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 骨格修正の達成度（SNB角変化、Class I修正率）をアプライアンス間で比較しており、Class II症例で標準alignerのみでは計画された骨格修正が達成されない可能性（70% vs 85-90%）が示唆される。workflow: GA6群の治療期間が15.2ヶ月と短縮されており、治療計画の期間設定や患者スケジュールに直接関連する。
