documents.title: Effects of Printing Layer Thickness and Thermocycling on the Mechanical, Morphological, Optical, and Dimensional Properties of Directly Printed Clear Aligners.
documents.abstract: Directly printed clear aligners may streamline orthodontic workflows but must withstand intraoral aging. This in vitro study evaluated the effects of layer thickness (50, 100, and 150 µm) and thermocycling on mechanical, morphological, optical, and dimensional properties of Graphy Tera Harz TA-28 material. Specimens underwent standardized centrifugation and nitrogen post-curing, followed by tensile and flexural testing, Vickers microhardness, normalized light transmittance, dimensional analysis, and field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM). Thermocycling comprised 250 cycles between 5 and 55 °C. Layer thickness significantly affected strain at break, flexural force, bending strength, bending modulus, microhardness, and normalized light transmittance. The 50 µm group showed the highest strain at break and greater flexural performance than the 100 and 150 µm groups. Thermocycling reduced Young's modulus and flexural outcomes. Significant layer thickness × thermocycling interactions occurred for stress at peak, deflection at peak, microhardness, normalized light transmittance, trueness (p = 0.008), and precision (p = 0.034). FESEM showed visible layer boundaries and surface heterogeneity with thicker layers, particularly in thermocycled 150 µm specimens. Overall, 50 µm provided favorable mechanical and dimensional performance after thermocycling, but produced the greatest reduction in light transmittance. Selection requires balancing mechanical and dimensional performance against optical stability after aging.
documents.authors: Rostum Isra Dilshad, Ali Omar Sabah Mohammed Jamil
documents.summary_ja: 直接印刷型クリアアライナーの材料（Graphy Tera Harz TA-28）について、印刷レイヤー厚（50、100、150 µm）とサーモサイクリング（5〜55 °C、250サイクル）が機械的・形態的・光学的・寸法的特性に与える影響をin vitroで評価した研究。標準的な遠心成形と窒素ポストキュアリング後、引張・曲げ試験、ビッカース硬さ、正規化光透過率、寸法分析、FESEMを実施した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 50 µmのレイヤー厚はサーモサイクリング後も機械的・寸法的性能に有利であったが、光透過率の低下が最も大きかった。材料選択には、老化後の機械的・寸法的性能と光学的安定性のバランスが求められる。
documents.why_matters_ja: ワークフロー：直接印刷型アライナーは矯正ワークフローの簡素化に寄与し得る。安全性：intraoral aging（サーモサイクリング）に対する耐性を評価しており、臨床使用時の耐久性に関わる。planned-vs-achieved：寸法精度（trueness, p=0.008; precision, p=0.034）にレイヤー厚×サーモサイクリングの有意な交互作用が認められ、治療計画の精度達成に直接関連する。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro 材料試験
documents.endpoints_ja: 機械的特性（引張、曲げ）、形態的特性（FESEM）、光学的特性（正規化光透過率）、寸法的特性（trueness、precision）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 50 µm群が100 µm・150 µm群より高い破断時ひずみと曲げ性能を示した。サーモサイクリングによりヤング率と曲げ成績が低下した。レイヤー厚×サーモサイクリングの交互作用がstress at peak、deflection at peak、microhardness、normalized light transmittance、trueness（p = 0.008）、precision（p = 0.034）で有意であった。50 µmはサーモサイクリング後も機械的・寸法的性能に有利であったが、光透過率の低下が最大であった。

documents.title: In Vitro Comparison of Initial and 7-Day System-Level Resultant Forces in Clear Aligners with Different Layer Structures.
documents.abstract: Time-dependent force reduction may affect the biomechanical performance of thermoformed clear aligners. This proof-of-concept in vitro study compared initial and 7-day system-level 3D resultant forces of DURAN, ZENDURA FLX, and MESHEET under attachment-free and attachment-integrated conditions. Thirty independently fabricated aligners (n = 5 per condition) were tested on a rigid resin model with FDI tooth 11 positioned at 5° of labioversion. Forces were recorded at 1 Hz for 168 h under dry room conditions and summarized at 12 h intervals. Temporal series and group-level normalized decay were evaluated descriptively; no longitudinal inferential analysis was performed. Separate 3 × 2 two-way ANOVAs assessed absolute resultant force at 0 and 168 h. Higher endpoint forces were observed under the attachment-integrated condition in this experimental setup at 0 h [F(1,24) = 24.510, p < 0.001, partial η2 = 0.505] and 168 h [F(1,24) = 7.175, p = 0.013, partial η2 = 0.230]. However, because testing followed a fixed, nonrandomized sequence, the observed difference cannot be attributed exclusively to attachment condition. Material and interaction effects were not significant at either endpoint. Under the attachment-integrated condition, normalized decay was 51.4%, 48.2%, and 44.5%, while 168 h mean forces were 1.415, 1.664, and 1.558 N, respectively. These findings do not establish decay-rate differences, material superiority, equivalence, or clinical efficacy.
documents.authors: Seo Jeong-Hee, Park Eun-Yeong, Lee Jeong-Hyeon, Kim Won-Gi, Lee Sung-Jae, Kim Bongju
documents.summary_ja: 熱成形型クリアアライナーの3材料（DURAN、ZENDURA FLX、MESHEET）について、アタッチメントなし条件とアタッチメント統合条件における初期（0h）および7日（168h）のシステムレベル3D合成力を比較したin vitroのproof-of-concept研究。FDI歯11を5°の唇側傾斜に配置した硬質レジンモデル上で、30本（各条件n=5）の独立製造アライナーを乾燥室内で1Hz、168時間記録し、12時間間隔で要約した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: アタッチメント統合条件では0hおよび168hともにアタッチメントなし条件より高い合成力が観察されたが、固定・非ランダム化された試験順序のため、この差をアタッチメント条件にのみ帰因できない。材料効果および交互作用は両endpointで有意でなかった。著者は本結果が減衰率の差、材料優越性、同等性、臨床的有効性を確立しないことを明示している。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：7日間の力減衰（normalized decay 44.5〜51.4%）は、計画された初期力が1つのウェアカイクル内でどの程度維持されるかを示唆する。ただし、in vitro・小サンプル・非ランダム化であり、臨床的なplanned-vs-achievedの結論は導出できない。
documents.study_type_ja: In vitro proof-of-concept研究（比較試験）
documents.endpoints_ja: システムレベル3D合成力（0h、168h）、正規化減衰率（%）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 0h: アタッチメント統合条件で有意に高い合成力 [F(1,24)=24.510, p<0.001, partial η²=0.505]。168h: アタッチメント統合条件で有意に高い合成力 [F(1,24)=7.175, p=0.013, partial η²=0.230]。材料効果および交互作用は両endpointで非有意。アタッチメント統合条件における正規化減衰率: DURAN 51.4%、ZENDURA FLX 48.2%、MESHEET 44.5%。168h平均力: DURAN 1.415 N、ZENDURA FLX 1.664 N、MESHEET 1.558 N。

documents.title: Predictability of Sequential Distalization of the Upper Arch Using Invisalign®: A 3D Superimposition Study.
documents.abstract: Background: Sequential distalization of the upper arch with clear aligners is widely used to correct Class II malocclusion, but its predictability across molars, canines, and incisors is unclear. This study compared virtual planning with intraoral outcomes and identified the associated side effects. Methods: A retrospective study analyzed 80 maxillary quadrants from 40 patients with dental Class II malocclusion treated with Invisalign® (Smart Track® material) using a sequential V-pattern distalization protocol with Class II elastics and vertical rectangular/optimized attachments. Predicted movements were extracted from ClinCheck Pro®. Scans at baseline and after the first approved aligner stage were superimposed on the palatal rugae using Geomagic Control X®. Extrusion/intrusion, buccolingual movement, mesiodistal translation, rotation, angulation, and torque were measured for molars, canines, and incisors. Results: Molar distalization reached 1.80 of the 2.60 mm planned (69.2%), and canines 1.12 of 2.45 mm (45.7%) and incisor intrusion reached only 0.03 of the 1.45 mm planned (2.1%). Buccolingual molar movement was most predictable (97.4%), and molar rotation showed moderate-to-good predictability (88.4%); incisor rotation, angulation and torque accuracy were 62.2%, 53.8% and 23.2%, respectively. Molar angulation and torque were markedly overexpressed, with unplanned intrusion of 0.80 mm; canine angulation/torque were similarly overexpressed. Incisor intrusion/torque movements were least predictable. Conclusions: Predictability of sequential upper-arch distalization varied widely across tooth groups and movement types. Linear distalization was moderately to poorly predictable and rotational movements were well reproduced, but angulation/torque control were the least predictable, especially for molars and canines, with unintended molar intrusion and buccal torque. Incisor torque, intrusion, and retrusion were most underexpressed. Vertical rectangular attachments improved molar tipping control, while absent attachments and Power Ridges worsened incisor torque/translation. Clinicians should anticipate overcorrection and refinement stages to avoid false expectations based on the initial ClinCheck outcome.
documents.authors: López-Mateos Cristina Menéndez, López-Mateos Mª Luisa Menéndez, Alarcón José Antonio, Menéndez-Núñez Mario, Martin Conchita
documents.summary_ja: Invisalign（Smart Track®素材）を用いた上顎アーチのsequential V-pattern遠心移動プロトコル（Class IIエラстик＋垂直長方形/最適化アタッチメント）の予測可能性を評価した後ろ向き研究。40例の歯性Class II不正咬合患者の上顎80象限を対象に、ClinCheck Pro®の予測移動量と、口蓋乳頭上で3D重ね合わせ（Geomagic Control X®）を行った初回承認アライナー段階後の実際の移動量を比較し、臼歯・犬歯・切歯の遠心移動、抜歯方向移動、回転、傾斜、トルクを測定した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 上顎sequential遠心移動の予測可能性は歯群と移動タイプにより大きく異なり、直線遠心移動は中等度〜低予測性、回転は良好に再現されたが、傾斜・トルク制御は最も予測困難であった。臼歯では計画外の0.80mmの圧入と頬側トルクが過剰に生じ、切歯のトルク・圧入・後退は最も低予測性であった。臨床医は初期ClinCheck結果に基づく過剰な期待を避け、過矯正とリファインメント段階を予期すべきである。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの乖離を定量的に示しており、治療計画品質の向上とリファインメント計画の必要性に直接関連する。特に臼歯の傾斜・トルク制御の低予測性と計画外圧入は、初期計画段階での補正戦略やアタッチメント設計（垂直長方形アタッチメントが臼歯チッピング制御を改善、アタッチメント欠如とPower Ridgeが切歯トルク/移動を悪化）の根拠となる。また、ClinCheck Proの予測値と実際の乖離を認識した上で患者説明を行うワークフロー改善にも寄与する。

documents.endpoints_ja: 臼歯遠心移動の予測可能性、犬歯遠心移動の予測可能性、切歯圧入の予測可能性、臼歯抜歯方向移動の予測可能性、臼歯回転の予測可能性、切歯回転・傾斜・トルクの予測可能性、計画外圧入量、計画外頬側トルク
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 臼歯遠心移動：計画2.60mmに対し1.80mm達成（69.2%）。犬歯遠心移動：計画2.45mmに対し1.12mm達成（45.7%）。切歯圧入：計画1.45mmに対し0.03mm達成（2.1%）。臼歯抜歯方向移動：97.4%。臼歯回転：88.4%。切歯回転：62.2%。切歯傾斜：53.8%。切歯トルク：23.2%。計画外臼歯圧入：0.80mm。

documents.title: Association between overjet reduction and wear time of a New-T-activator: a retrospective cohort study.
documents.abstract:
AIM: The aim of this retrospective cohort study was to investigate the association between New-T-appliance activator wear time, as measured by a Theramon microsensor, and overjet reduction in patients with a Class II Division 1 malocclusion and to determine whether this association is related to age or sex.
METHODS: This study included patients with a Class II Division 1 malocclusion treated with a New-T-appliance activator equipped with a Theramon microsensor in a private orthodontic practice between 2011 and 2023. Mean daily wear time was recorded using the temperature-sensitive microsensor, while overjet was measured at baseline and during treatment. Multivariable linear regression analysis was performed to evaluate the association between wear time and overjet reduction, with age and sex included as covariates.
RESULTS: In total, 705 patients were included. The daily mean wear time was 8.3 h/day. Statistically significant associations were found between overjet reduction and mean wear time (p < 0.001). Patients younger than 12 years showed significantly greater overjet reduction than older patients. However, no significant sex-related associations were found.
CONCLUSIONS: Higher functional appliance wear time was associated with greater overjet reduction. Patients who start orthodontic treatment at a younger age have a higher appliance wear time and greater overjet reduction. These findings suggest that starting orthodontic treatment with functional appliances before the age of 12 could be beneficial. The patient's sex has not been identified as an influencing factor.
documents.authors: Sala Graziana M, Aydin Burcu, van der Kaaij Nicoline C W
documents.summary_ja: Class II Division 1不正咬合患者において、Theramonマイクロセンサーで計測したNew-Tアプライアンスアクティベーターの装着時間とオーバージェット減少量との関連、および年齢・性別との関連を調査した後ろ向きコホート研究。2011年から2023年の個人開業医務所で治療を受けた705例を対象に、多変量線形回帰分析を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 装着時間が長いほどオーバージェット減少量が大きく、12歳未満の患者は12歳以上より有意に大きなオーバージェット減少を示した。性別による有意な関連は認められなかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 装着時間（コンプライアンス）と治療アウトカム（オーバージェット減少）の有意な関連が示され、コンプライアンスモニタリングが治療計画の達成度評価に寄与し得ることを示唆。workflow: 温度感受性マイクロセンサーによる装着時間の客観的計測が、治療経過の定量的モニタリングに活用可能である点でワークフロー改善の参考となる。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向きコホート研究
documents.endpoints_ja: オーバージェット減少量（ベースラインおよび治療中に計測）、1日平均装着時間
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 1日平均装着時間は8.3 h/day。オーバージェット減少量と平均装着時間の間に統計的に有意な関連が認められた（p < 0.001）。12歳未満の患者は12歳以上より有意に大きなオーバージェット減少を示した。性別による有意な関連は認められなかった。

documents.title: Anaerobic stress index to predict microbial ecological shifts in clear aligners.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Clear aligners are clinically perceived as periodontally 'friendlier' than fixed appliances (FA), yet localized gingivitis persists. Salivary diagnostics often mask site-specific dysbiosis through a 'dilution effect'. This study aimed to characterize distinct ecological pressures and propose a novel anaerobic stress index (ASI) to quantify localized microbial burden.
METHODS: A computational meta-analysis was conducted using longitudinal 16S rRNA sequencing datasets (n = 976 samples from 10 distinct studies). Data was processed through a standardized Kraken2/Bracken pipeline. The ASI was calculated as the ratio of key anaerobic pathobionts (Fusobacterium, Prevotella) to facultative commensals (Streptococcus, Rothia).
RESULTS: Saliva acts as a 'dilution filter,' failing to capture sessile biofilm dynamics (AUC = 0.51 in FA). Fixed appliances exhibited mechanical dysbiosis with a 2.64-fold increase in Actinomyces (p < 0.0001) within the first month. Clear aligners induced a 'silent hypoxia'. The supragingival biofilm showed a progressive shift toward anaerobiosis. The ASI in aligner patients quadrupled by month 6 (from 0.58 to 2.52; p = 0.002), a shift not detectable in matched saliva samples.
CONCLUSIONS: Physical entrapment in fixed appliances versus micro-environmental hypoxia under clear aligners drives divergent dysbiotic pathways. The ASI serves as a robust biomarker for subclinical dysbiosis, suggesting periodic re-oxygenation therapeutics are necessary to restore host-microbe homeostasis.
documents.authors: Demirci Mehmet, Unlu Ozge, Kantarci Alpdogan
documents.summary_ja: 10研究由来の縦断的16S rRNAシーケンシングデータ（n=976サンプル）を用いた計算的メタアナリシス。唾液診断が希釈効果により局所的なディスバイオシスを検出できない問題を指摘し、嫌気性病原共生菌（Fusobacterium, Prevotella）と通性共生菌（Streptococcus, Rothia）の比として定義される新たな「嫌気性ストレス指数（ASI）」を提案した。クリアアライナーは「サイレントな低酸素状態」を誘発し、歯肉上バイオフィルムが嫌気性方向へ進行性シフトすることを示した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナー下では歯肉上バイオフィルムが進行性的に嫌気性方向へシフトし、ASIは6ヶ月で0.58から2.52へ4倍に増加（p=0.002）したが、対応する唾液サンプルではこの変化は検出されなかった。唾液は「希釈フィルター」として機能し、定着性バイオフィルムの動態を捉えられない（FAでAUC=0.51）。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：クリアアライナー治療中に「サイレントな低酸素状態」による亜臨床的ディスバイオシスが進行し、唾液検査では検出されないことが示された。これは治療中の歯周モニタリング戦略や、定期的な再酸素化療法の必要性に直結する。
documents.study_type_ja: 計算的メタアナリシス
documents.endpoints_ja: 嫌気性ストレス指数（ASI）：主要嫌気性病原共生菌（Fusobacterium, Prevotella）と通性共生菌（Streptococcus, Rothia）の比。唾液による検出性能（AUC）。
documents.endpoint_results_ja: FAにおける唾液のAUC=0.51。FAでは初月内にActinomycesが2.64倍増加（p<0.0001）。クリアアライナー群のASIは6ヶ月で0.58から2.52へ増加（p=0.002）。対応する唾液サンプルではこの変化は検出されなかった。

documents.title: Comparative analysis of experimental torque behavior and physicochemical properties of commercial and in‑house orthodontic aligners.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: Clear aligner performance depends on the magnitude and time-dependent behavior of experimentally generated moments. This study compared polymer identity, local post-thermoforming thickness, and experimental torque behavior of a commercial multilayer aligner (Invisalign) and two in-house thermoformed PETG aligners.
METHODS: Ethical approval and consent were obtained. A digital scan from one patient was used to fabricate a standardized 3D-printed maxillary model. Three systems were evaluated: Invisalign (thermoplastic polyurethane [TPU]-based) and two vacuum-formed PETG systems (BioArt and Forestadent). Polymer identity was determined by ATR-FTIR. SEM assessed local thickness and morphology after thermoforming. Experimental torque, defined as mechanical moment (N·mm), was quantified using a setup programmed to produce a 0.3 mm displacement of the maxillary right central incisor. Short-term torque was recorded from 0 to 3 minutes (n = 5 per group) and analyzed using two-way repeated-measures ANOVA. Seven-day torque decay was monitored under dry, room-temperature conditions (n = 2 per group) and interpreted descriptively.
RESULTS: ATR-FTIR confirmed PETG signatures for BioArt and Forestadent and TPU signatures for Invisalign. Thermoforming reduced local PETG thickness at tooth 11 by 58.6% for BioArt and 45.8% for Forestadent. At baseline and 3 minutes, Invisalign and Forestadent generated higher experimental torque than BioArt. Significant short-term torque reduction occurred for Invisalign and Forestadent, but not for BioArt. In the exploratory 7-day assessment, torque loss was 12.3%, 13.6%, and 20.2%, respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: Material chemistry and local geometry influenced experimental torque magnitude and relaxation under in vitro conditions. Long-term findings were exploratory and require confirmation under clinically relevant conditions.
documents.journal: Journal of the World federation of orthodontists
documents.authors: Holderbaum Gustavo, Beatrici Anderson, Takamori Esther Rieko, Granjeiro José Mauro
documents.summary_ja: Invisalign（TPU系）と2種の院内製PETGアライナー（BioArt、Forestadent）のポリマー同一性、熱成形後の局所厚さ、および実験的トルク挙動を比較したin vitro研究。ATR-FTIRでポリマー同一性を確認し、SEMで局所厚さを評価した。上顎右側中切歯に0.3 mm変位を発生させる装置を用いて実験的トルク（N·mm）を定量し、短期トルク（0〜3分、n=5/群）と7日間のトルク減衰（n=2/群）を評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 材料化学（TPU vs PETG）と局所幾何学（熱成形後の厚さ減少）が実験的トルクの大きさおよび緩和に影響を与える。ベースラインおよび3分時点でInvisalignとForestadentはBioArtより高いトルクを発生させた。
documents.why_matters_ja: 材料特性が歯に伝達されるトルク量と時間依存性に関与するため、planned-vs-achievedの観点で、計画された力系が実際にどの程度伝達されるかの理解に寄与する可能性がある。ただしin vitro条件・極小サンプルであり、臨床的関連性は未確認。
documents.study_type_ja: 比較研究（in vitro実験）
documents.endpoints_ja: 実験的トルク（N·mm）：ベースラインおよび3分時点の値、7日間のトルク減衰率、熱成形後の局所厚さ減少率、ポリマー同一性
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 熱成形により歯11のPETG局所厚さはBioArtで58.6%、Forestadentで45.8%減少。ベースラインおよび3分時点でInvisalignとForestadentはBioArtより高い実験的トルクを発生。InvisalignとForestadentでは有意な短期トルク減少が認められたが、BioArtでは認められなかった。7日間のトルク損失はInvisalign 12.3%、BioArt 13.6%、Forestadent 20.2%。

documents.title: Wear-time monitoring in functional orthodontic appliances does not enhance patient satisfaction and is not associated with improved treatment duration or occlusal outcomes: A randomized controlled trial.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Thermosensitive microsensors help assess removable appliance wear-time compliance and thereby provide objective feedback to the patient.
METHODS: This single-center, two-parallel-arm randomized controlled trial assessed the impact of wear-time monitoring in removable functional appliances on patients' subjective experience, treatment duration, and outcome. In total, 58 patients aged between 10 and 15 years were treated with either a twin-block appliance or headgear activator. The patients were randomly allocated to two groups, one of which received wear-time monitoring while the other did not. Data were analyzed on an intention-to-treat and per-protocol basis using parametric and nonparametric statistics to assess associations between the outcome variables. No blinding of the patient or orthodontist was carried out. No harms were detected.
RESULTS: Adolescents reported wear comfort ranging from poor to excellent, significantly correlating with wear time and malocclusion correction success, but not with treatment duration. The twin-block appliance was worn for an average of 10 hours a day, while the headgear activator was worn for 4 hours a day. For those 39 adolescents with successful occlusal outcomes, mean wear time was 10 hours and 9 hours, respectively, and the average treatment duration was 13 months. The dropout rate was 21%.
CONCLUSIONS: Wear-time monitoring in twin-block appliance and headgear activator did not significantly increase subjective satisfaction, shorten the treatment time, or increase the frequency of successful occlusal outcomes.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05213338.
documents.journal: Journal of the World federation of orthodontists
documents.authors: Arponen Heidi, Åberg Thomas
documents.summary_ja: 単一施設、2平行群ランダム化比較試験。熱感知マイクロセンサーによる装着時間モニタリングが、取り外し可能な機能的矯正装置（twin-blockおよびheadgear activator）の患者の主観的体験、治療期間、咬合結果に与える影響を評価した。10〜15歳の58名がtwin-blockまたはheadgear activatorで治療され、装着時間モニタリング群と非モニタリング群にランダムに割り付けられた。患者および矯正医のブラインディングは行われなかった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: twin-block装置およびheadgear activatorにおける装着時間モニタリングは、主観的満足度の向上、治療期間の短縮、咬合結果の成功率の向上に有意な効果を示さなかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：有害事象は検出されなかった。ワークフロー：装着時間モニタリングという追加ステップを導入しても患者満足度・治療期間・咬合結果に有意な改善が得られず、モニタリング介入のワークフロー上の付加価値が限定的であることを示唆する。
documents.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（単一施設、2平行群）
documents.endpoints_ja: 患者の主観的体験（装着快適性・満足度）、治療期間、咬合結果（成功/不成功）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に記載なし

documents.title: Short-Term Changes in the Occlusal Contacts During Anterior Segmental Orthodontic Treatment With Clear Aligners in Adult Patients.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To compare ClinCheck-predicted and achieved maxillary occlusal contact areas immediately after an initial 14-aligner anterior segmental sequence without programmed posterior movement.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective study included 31 adult women treated with 14 maxillary and mandibular clear aligners. Bilateral first premolars through second molars were digitally locked. Predicted stage-14 models and intraoral scans obtained immediately after aligner 14 and before refinement were assessed at maximum intercuspation. Contact regions at 0.00-mm clearance were quantified with ImageJ. The primary outcome was the patient-level total posterior achieved-minus-predicted difference. Tooth-type differences were analysed using patient-clustered generalized estimating equations with Holm adjustment; bite-ramp comparisons were exploratory.
RESULTS: Predicted and achieved total posterior areas were 63.71 ± 36.56 and 30.30 ± 18.26 mm2, respectively (mean difference, -33.41 mm2; 95% CI, -44.42 to -22.40; p < 0.001). After Holm adjustment, the achieved central-incisor area was 0.49 mm2 greater than predicted (p = 0.003), whereas areas were smaller at the first premolars, second premolars, first molars, and second molars by 3.09, 5.44, 11.46, and 13.42 mm2, respectively (adjusted p ≤ 0.016). Lateral-incisor and canine differences were not significant. Bite-ramp groups did not differ significantly.
CONCLUSION: After 14 aligners, the achieved posterior contact area was substantially smaller than predicted despite no programmed posterior movement. This early discrepancy supports direct evaluation of posterior contacts before refinement.
documents.authors: Song Ji-Hye, Lee Ji-Hyun, Lee Sanghee, Lee Kee-Joon, Cha Jung-Yul, Chung Chooryung J, Kim Kyung-Ho
documents.summary_ja: 後方セグメントをデジタルロックした14枚の上下顎クリアアライナーによる前歯部セグメンタル治療後、ClinCheck予測モデルと実測イントラオラルスキャン（アライナー14枚後・リファインメント前）の最大咬合位における上顎咬合接触面積を比較した後ろ向き研究。0.00 mmクリアランスでの接触領域をImageJで定量化し、患者レベルの後方総接触面積の達成値-予測値差を主評価項目とした。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 後方移動をプログラムしていない前歯部セグメンタルシーケンス14枚後でも、後方咬合接触面積はClinCheck予測値を大きく下回った（平均差 -33.41 mm², p < 0.001）。この早期のplanned-vs-achieved乖離は、リファインメント判断前に後方接触を直接評価すべきことを支持する。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved乖離：後方移動を意図していない前歯部セグメンタル治療でも、ClinCheckが後方接触面積を過大予測する傾向が示された。これはリファインメントのタイミング判断や、治療計画段階での後方接触予測の信頼性評価に直接関連する。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き研究（retrospective study）
documents.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：患者レベルの後方総咬合接触面積の達成値-予測値差（0.00 mmクリアランス）。副次的・探索的評価項目：歯種別の接触面積差、バイトランプ群間比較。
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 予測後方総接触面積 63.71 ± 36.56 mm²、達成後方総接触面積 30.30 ± 18.26 mm²（平均差 -33.41 mm²; 95% CI -44.42〜-22.40; p < 0.001）。歯種別（Holm調整後）：中切歯 +0.49 mm²（p = 0.003）、第一大臼歯 -3.09 mm²、第二大臼歯 -5.44 mm²、第一大臼歯 -11.46 mm²、第二大臼歯 -13.42 mm²（調整p ≤ 0.016）。側切歯・犬歯は有意差なし。バイトランプ群間には有意差なし。

documents.title: Quantitative Comparison of Bone and Dental Morphology Between Invisalign® Integrated CBCT Images and Conventional CBCT Images.
documents.abstract: Background/Objectives: A recent feature in the Invisalign® system allowed integration of cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) with intraoral scans, thereby enabling visualization of the tooth roots and surrounding alveolar bone. Here, we aimed to compare differences between anatomical measurements obtained from integrated CBCT using Invisalign® software and conventional CBCT images. Methods: In this cross-sectional study, we included 45 adult patients (mean age 29.53 ± 7.66 years). Alveolar bone width was measured at the crestal, mid-root, and apical levels and the root length, maxillary and mandibular outer and inner transverse widths, and symphyseal width were assessed. Intra-examiner reliability was assessed using intraclass correlation coefficients. Paired t-tests were used to compare the two methods, and Bland-Altman analysis was used to evaluate agreement. Results: Intra-examiner reliability demonstrated excellent agreement for all measurements (intraclass correlation coefficients > 0.90). Integrated CBCT models showed greater alveolar bone width, symphyseal width, and interbuccal transverse measurements than conventional CBCT, whereas the root length and interlingual transverse widths were underestimated. Most of the differences between the two methods were statistically significant (p < 0.05), although 5 of the 12 crestal measurements did not reach statistical significance (p > 0.05). For most measurements, the mean absolute differences were below 0.7 mm, except for root length, which showed larger discrepancies. Bland-Altman analysis revealed good agreement between the methods, with most observations lying within the 95% limits of agreement and no evident proportional bias. Conclusions: Most measured variables showed significant differences between integrated and conventional CBCT (p < 0.05), ranging from 0.7 mm to 1.3 mm; however, at the crestal level, 5/12 measurements showed no statistically significant difference between methods (p > 0.05).
documents.authors: Albilali Hind W, Alamri Abdulaziz S, Shahin Suliman Y, Almasoud Naif N, Alsulaiman Osama A, Almazrou Dalal M, Alsulaiman Ahmed A
documents.summary_ja: Invisalign®統合CBCT画像と従来型CBCT画像間の解剖学的測定値（歯槽骨幅、根長、上下顎内外側横径、顎底幅）を比較した横断研究。45名の成人患者を対象に、Invisalign®ソフトウェアによる統合CBCTと従来型CBCTの測定値をペアt検定とBland-Altman解析で比較した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 統合CBCTは従来型CBCTと比較して歯槽骨幅・顎底幅・外側横径が過大評価され、根長・内側横径が過小評価された。大部分の測定値で統計的有意差（p<0.05）を認めたが、平均絶対差は根長を除き0.7 mm未満であり、Bland-Altman解析では95%一致限界内に収まり比例バイアスは認められなかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：統合CBCTの測定値に系統的バイアス（骨幅の過大評価、根長の過小評価）が存在するため、治療計画時の解剖学的判断に留意が必要。planned-vs-achieved：根長で特に大きな乖離が認められるため、根の位置や骨量に関する計画の精度に影響しうる。ワークフロー：Bland-Altman解析で良好な一致が示されたことで、統合CBCTが臨床ワークフローにおいて従来型CBCTの代替として利用可能であることが示唆される。
documents.study_type_ja: 横断研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 歯槽骨幅（crestal, mid-root, apical）、根長、上顎・下顎の外側および内側横径、顎底幅
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 検査者内信頼性：全測定値でICC > 0.90。統合CBCTは従来型CBCTより歯槽骨幅・顎底幅・外側横径が大きい、根長・内側横径が小さい。大部分の差は統計的有意（p < 0.05）、ただしcrestalレベルの12測定中5つは有意差なし（p > 0.05）。平均絶対差は根長を除き0.7 mm未満。Bland-Altman解析：95%一致限界内に大部分の観測値が収まり、比例バイアスは認められなかった。差の範囲は0.7 mm〜1.3 mm。

documents.title: Clear aligner therapy among orthodontists in Turkey: practice patterns and comparison with previously reported Iranian findings.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: The aim of this paper is to investigate clear aligner therapy (CAT) practice patterns among Turkish orthodontists and compare them with Iranian specialist orthodontists.
METHODS: A web-based cross-sectional survey of Turkish specialist orthodontists assessed CAT use, adjuncts, training, case selection by malocclusion and age, monitoring and retention protocols, and perceived advantages/disadvantages. Findings were compared with a previously published survey of 142 Iranian orthodontists.
RESULTS: A total of 178 Turkish orthodontists participated (7.5% response rate; 71 males, 107 females). Most were aged 30-39 years (53.9%), had 11-20 years of experience (42.1%), and worked in private practice (62.9%). CAT use was reported by 96.1% of Turkish orthodontists versus 69.0% of Iranian orthodontists. More Turkish orthodontists initiated >50 new CAT cases annually (33.1% vs. 7.7%), while fewer reported <10 cases/year (18.0% vs. 35.9%). CAT use was significantly higher in Turkey across all age groups (P < 0.001). Preferences were similar for mild crowding, spacing, and anterior cross-bite. Turkish orthodontists more frequently used CAT for complex cases, including mild/moderate open bite and severe crowding (P < 0.05). CAT was preferred more for limited extraction and space-opening cases than orthognathic surgery cases. Iranian orthodontists more commonly used local manufacturers (49.3% vs. 15.7%) and in-office aligner production (19% vs. 9%). Perceptions regarding CAT advantages and limitations were largely similar between groups.
CONCLUSION: Among respondents, CAT was more widely integrated into orthodontic practice in Turkey, with broader self-reported clinical indications and more positive clinician perceptions than in Iran. Iranian orthodontists relied more on locally manufactured and in-office aligners.
documents.authors: Borzabadi-Farahani Ali, Olkun Hatice Kübra, Behnaz Mohammad
documents.summary_ja: トルコの専門矯正歯科医178名を対象としたWebベースの横断調査により、クリアアライナー治療（CAT）の実践パターンを評価し、以前に発表されたイランの矯正歯科医142名の調査結果と比較した。CATの使用率、補助装置、トレーニング、不正咬合・年齢別ケース選択、モニタリング・保定プロトコル、および利点・限界の認識を調査した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: トルコの矯正歯科医ではCATがより広く臨床に統合されており（96.1% vs イラン69.0%）、軽度〜中等度のオープンバイトや重度の叢生を含むより複雑な症例への自己申告的な適応範囲が広い。イランの矯正歯科医は地元メーカー製アライナー（49.3% vs 15.7%）や院内アライナー製造（19% vs 9%）により多く依存していた。
documents.why_matters_ja: ケース選択パターンの観点：トルコの矯正歯科医は軽度〜中等度オープンバイトや重度叢生を含むより複雑な症例にCATをより頻繁に使用しており（P<0.05）、治療計画の適応範囲の拡大を示唆する。ワークフローの観点：年間新規CAT症例数>50例の割合がトルコで33.1%とイラン（7.7%）を大きく上回り、高頻度での治療計画立案・モニタリング業務の負荷が示唆される。
documents.study_type_ja: 横断調査（Webベース）
documents.endpoints_ja: CAT使用率、年間新規CAT症例数、不正咬合タイプ別ケース選択、年齢別CAT使用率、地元メーカー使用率、院内アライナー製造率、CATの利点・限界の認識
documents.endpoint_results_ja: CAT使用率：トルコ96.1% vs イラン69.0%。年間新規CAT症例>50例：33.1% vs 7.7%。<10例/年：18.0% vs 35.9%。全年齢層でトルコの方がCAT使用率有意に高い（P<0.001）。軽度〜中等度オープンバイト・重度叢生への使用がトルコで有意に多い（P<0.05）。地元メーカー使用：49.3% vs 15.7%。院内アライナー製造：19% vs 9%。
documents.sample_size_ja: トルコ矯正歯科医178名（回答率7.5%；男性71名、女性107名）。比較対象：イラン矯正歯科医142名（既往論文）。

documents.title: Clear Aligners as a Prescribed Source of Unmeasured Intra-Oral Micro- and Nanoplastic Exposure: Release Mechanisms, Human Evidence, Salivary Biomonitoring and the EU Regulatory Context.
documents.abstract: Clear orthodontic aligners are removable polymer devices worn about 22 h a day for 12 to 24 months, increasingly by children. A growing in vitro literature shows that thermoformed and 3D-printed aligners shed micro- and nanoplastics and co-release elemental or organic constituents under oral, gastric and mechanical conditions, yet aligner-derived particle burden and systemic dose in wearers have not been measured. This review sets aligner-derived release against the wider human micro- and nanoplastic record and evaluates saliva as a biomonitoring matrix. Directly printed devices release more and larger microplastics under mechanical stress, whereas thermoformed materials show acid-related degradation, with Sb/Sn release and nanometre-scale particles reported in a single, not yet replicated in vitro study. Particles below 5 microns, especially below 1 micron, are plausible translocation candidates, but translocation of aligner-derived particles has not been demonstrated. In vitro work reports macrophage and oxidative responses, whereas detections in blood, placenta and atheroma are not source-specific and remain associative. The EU amalgam phase-out does not regulate aligners but highlights a substitution question, because device and chemicals law addresses intentionally added microplastics, not wear-generated secondary particles. ICP-MS for antimony and tin, with Raman, micro-FTIR and electron microscopy, forms a plausible analytical toolbox. We propose harmonised release testing and validated salivary biomonitoring, prioritising children, to characterise source-proximal exposure before use expands.
documents.authors: Mikulewicz Marcin, Chojnacka Katarzyna

documents.title: Forces and Moments Generated by Thermoforming Aligners and Direct-Printed Aligners: A Systematic Review.
documents.abstract: Objectives: This systematic review aims to compare the forces and moments generated by thermoforming aligners and direct-printed aligners in guiding tooth movement in orthodontic patients, evaluating their impact on orthodontic outcomes. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus databases, covering studies on thermoforming and direct-printed aligners from inception to October 2024. Eligible studies included randomized controlled trials, quasi-experimental studies, and observational studies assessing forces and moments generated by these aligners on teeth. In vitro studies pertinent to the topic were also considered. Data extraction focused on study characteristics, aligner details, force and moment measurements, and clinical outcomes. Quality assessment utilized the ROBINS- I for Risk of Bias. The review has been registered on PROSPERO CRD42024620341. Results: A total of nine studies met the inclusion criteria. Findings indicate that thermoforming aligners, while effective in initial force application, exhibit significant force decay over time due to material stress relaxation. In contrast, direct-printed aligners maintain more consistent force levels, potentially resulting in more predictable and sustained tooth movement. Both aligner types vary in their ability to control force direction and magnitude, with direct-printed aligners showing advantages in customization and force retention. Conclusions: The biomechanical properties of thermoforming and direct-printed aligners offer distinct advantages and limitations. Direct-printed aligners may enhance clinical predictability and reduce treatment time through consistent force application, though further research is necessary to validate these benefits in clinical settings. This review underscores the importance of material selection and fabrication method in optimizing orthodontic outcomes.
documents.authors: Mohanty Pritam, Priyadarshini Saundarya, Mohanty Debapreeti, Tumedei Margherita, Del Fabbro Massimo, Tirunelveli Mani Parameswaran, Chaudhary Partha Pratim, Krishnan Balaji
documents.summary_ja: サーモフォーム型アライナーと直接印刷型アライナーが歯の移動に生じる力とモーメントを比較したシステマティックレビュー。PubMed、Web of Science、Scopusを2024年10月まで検索し、9件の研究が包含基準を満たした。サーモフォーム型アライナーは初期の力適用には有効だが、材料の応力緩和により時間の経過とともに力の減衰が顕著である一方、直接印刷型アライナーはより一貫した力レベルを維持し、より予測可能で持続的な歯の移動をもたらす可能性がある。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 直接印刷型アライナーはサーモフォーム型アライナーと比較して力レベルの一貫性を維持し、臨床的な予測可能性を高め、治療期間の短縮につながる可能性がある。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: サーモフォーム型アライナーの応力緩和による力の減衰は、計画された歯の移動と実際の移動の乖離に直結する。直接印刷型アライナーの一貫した力適用は、計画と達成の一致を向上させる可能性がある。ワークフロー: 材料選択と製造方法（サーモフォーム vs 直接印刷）が正畸治療結果の最適化に重要であることが示唆されており、製造プロセスの選択が治療計画の品質に影響する。

documents.title: A 41-Month Case Report: Correction of Anterior Open Bite Using Clear Aligners Combined With Long-Arm Uprighting Springs.
documents.abstract: Anterior open bite (AOB) is a challenging vertical malocclusion that requires careful control of posterior vertical dimension, and when it is combined with first molar loss, restoration of posterior occlusal support may require either prosthetic replacement or orthodontic molar protraction. This case report describes the treatment of a 22-year-old male patient with AOB and compromised first molars who underwent extraction of Teeth 16, 26, and 46 followed by long-distance molar protraction with clear aligners; similar nonprosthetic approaches have been reported for patients with missing first molars, although clear aligner treatment remains less predictable for complex tooth movements and extraction-space closure. During space closure, mesial tipping and aligner off-tracking were managed with long-arm molar uprighting springs used as auxiliary devices, because molar protraction requires appropriate moment-to-force control to reduce uncontrolled crown tipping and improve root paralleling. After 41 months and 82 aligner sets, the extraction spaces were substantially closed, the anterior overbite and overjet were improved, and the facial profile became more harmonious, supporting previous observations that adult AOB correction with aligners may be achievable when vertical control and auxiliary biomechanics are carefully managed. Because root resorption and enamel opacities occurred during treatment, this report also discusses the biological limitations and risk-control considerations of long-distance molar protraction in an adult patient, as prolonged orthodontic tooth movement, extraction-space closure, and aligner or fixed-appliance therapy may be associated with adverse effects such as external apical root resorption and white spot lesions.
documents.authors: Xin Yewei, Chen Yaqiu, Qiu Feng, Liu Chang, Sun Xiaojing, Jiang Qian
documents.summary_ja: 22歳男性の前方開咬（AOB）と第一大臼歯の欠損を伴う症例報告。歯16、26、46を抜歯し、クリアアライナーによる長距離臼歯牽引を行った。アライナーのオフトラッキングと近心チッピングを管理するため、長腕臼歯アップライトスプリングを補助装置として併用した。41ヶ月・82セットのアライナー治療で抜歯スペースがほぼ閉鎖され、前方オーバーバイト・オーバージェットが改善し、側貌が調和的になった。治療中に根尖吸収とエナメル質白斑が発生した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 成人の前方開咬は、垂直方向の制御と補助バイオメカニクス（長腕アップライトスプリング）を適切に管理すればクリアアライナーによる矯正が達成可能であるが、長期間の歯移動に伴う根尖吸収やエナメル質白斑などの生物学的限界を考慮する必要がある。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：アライナーのオフトラッキングが発生し、補助装置（長腕アップライトスプリング）による介入が必要であった。安全性の観点：根尖吸収とエナメル質白斑が発生し、長距離臼歯牽引のリスク管理が示された。ワークフローの観点：複雑な歯移動（長距離臼歯牽引）においてアライナー単独では不十分であり、補助装置の併用が治療計画に組み込まれた。

documents.title: Ageing effects on chemical, physical, mechanical, and morphological properties of clear aligners - a systematic review.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Clear aligner (CA) therapy has experienced rapid use over the past two decades to treat orthodontic malocclusions. However, evidence on CA material degradation in the oral environment remains limited and often focuses on single brands or isolated material properties.
OBJECTIVES: To investigate CA ageing characteristics across different materials and brands and evaluate the chemical, physical, mechanical, and morphological changes following simulated or intraoral ageing.
SEARCH METHODS: Five databases (PubMed, Web of Science, MEDLINE [Ovid], ProQuest, and Scopus) were searched to 18 March 2026, with no restrictions.
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: Studies assessing CA properties after intraoral use or simulated ageing (thermocycling, cyclic loading, or liquid immersion) were included.
DATA COLLECTION AND ANALYSIS: Study selection followed PRISMA 2020. RoB was assessed using QUIN for purely in vitro studies, JBI for cohort in vivo studies, and Cochrane RoB 2 for RCTs. Results were synthesised narratively and organised by property domain, as substantial methodological heterogeneity precluded formal meta-analysis. Where protocols were comparable, a simple pooled weighted mean was calculated and presented graphically.
RESULTS: Ninety-five studies were included. RoB was low in eight studies, moderate in sixty-two, and high in twenty-five. Chemical composition remained largely stable during ageing, though some brands showed trace elemental release. Physical, mechanical, and morphological properties showed material-dependent deterioration. Pooled discolouration was greatest with coffee (weighted mean ΔE = 70.9), versus tea (ΔE = 18.4) and red wine (ΔE = 11.5), with Invisalign® consistently exceeding the clinically perceptible threshold. Force decay of 40-90% typically occurred within 48 h. Thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU)-based and directly printed aligners (DPAs) generally showed greater susceptibility than polyethylene terephthalate glycol-modified (PETG)-based aligners, though findings on hardness, roughness, and stiffness were inconsistent.
CONCLUSIONS: CA materials undergo clinically relevant degradation during use, particularly in TPU-based and DPAs aligners. Clinicians may need to prioritise material-specific protocols, reinforce dietary and cleaning instructions, and consider force decay when determining aligner replacement intervals. PROSPERO number: CRD420251110248.
documents.authors: Almotairy Nabeel, Aleisa Fahad, Alshammari Abdulrahman K
documents.summary_ja: クリアアライナー（CA）の化学的・物理的・力学的・形態学的特性に対する老化影響を調査したシステマティックレビュー。PubMed、Web of Science、MEDLINE、ProQuest、Scopusの5データベースから95研究を包含。化学組成は老化中に概ね安定したが、一部のブランドで微量元素の溶出が認められた。物理的・力学的・形態学的特性は材料依存性の劣化を示した。TPU系および直接印刷アライナー（DPA）はPETG系アライナーよりも劣化感受性が高い傾向を示した。

documents.title: Clear Aligner Therapy Assisted by Implant Anchorage and S-Shaped Root Control Attachments for Anterior Open Bite Correction: A 30-Month Treatment Case Report.
documents.abstract: Anterior open bite is a prevalent malocclusion that can cause occlusal dysfunction and markedly reduce masticatory efficiency. This case report describes the successful management of a 37-year-old female with an anterior open bite secondary to excessive vertical development in the molar region and clockwise mandibular rotation. The treatment combined clear aligners with implant anchorage for molar intrusion, alongside S-shaped double-arm root control attachments to facilitate the uprighting of severely tilted teeth. Following the placement of four implants in the maxillary posterior region, the therapy was systematically carried out in four distinct phases: molar intrusion, premolar intrusion, correction of mandibular anterior tooth axial inclination, and final occlusal refinement. After 30 months, both the occlusal relationship and facial profile were significantly improved, with complete resolution of the anterior open bite and establishment of normal overbite and overjet. Cephalometric analysis confirmed favorable outcomes, including counterclockwise rotation of the mandible. This case highlights the efficacy of an implant-assisted clear aligner protocol augmented by specialized attachments for managing complex anterior open bite, thereby expanding the scope of clear aligner therapy.
documents.authors: Chen Yaqiu, Xin Yewei, Liu Chang, Sun Xiaojing, Yang Juanying, Jiang Qian, Qiu Feng
documents.summary_ja: 上顎後歯部の過剰な垂直方向発育および下顎の時計回り回転に起因する前歯部オープンバイトを有する37歳女性症例の報告。上顎後歯部に4本のインプラントを埋入し、インプラントアンカレッジによる臼歯部圧入とS字型ダブルアームルートコントロールアタッチメントによる重度に傾斜した歯の直立を併用したクリアアライナー治療を実施。治療は臼歯部圧入、小臼歯部圧入、下顎前歯部軸傾斜の修正、最終咬合リファインメントの4フェーズで構成され、30ヶ月で前歯部オープンバイトの完全解消と正常なオーバーバイト・オーバージェットの確立が達成された。頭部X線計測分析により下顎の反時計回り回転が確認された。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: インプラントアンカレッジとS字型ルートコントロールアタッチメントを併用したクリアアライナープロトコルは、複雑な前歯部オープンバイトの管理に有効であり、クリアアライナー治療の適応範囲を拡大しうる。

documents.title: Effect of PolyJet print orientation on the fit of thermoformed aligners: An in vitro scanning electron microscopy study.
documents.abstract:
AIM: The study aimed to compare the fit of thermoformed aligners fabricated on the original dental model over the corresponding dental models created using rapid-prototyping, in horizontal or vertical orientations using scanning electron microscopy (SEM).
METHODS: This study involved scanning 10 dental models using a Maestro 3D Desktop Scanner. The 10 processed STL files were then additively manufactured into 20 models using a PolyJet printer, 10 models printed in horizontal or vertical orientations, respectively. Two thermoformed aligners using 0.75 mm Duron blanks were fabricated over each original dental model with a Biostar machine and were adapted over the corresponding additively manufactured models. Models manufactured in two different orientations along with aligners were sectioned on the upper and lower-central incisors, first premolars and first molars and were prepared for SEM evaluation. The difference in data between the two groups was determined using an unpaired t-test.
RESULTS: The fit of aligners on additively manufactured dental models in vertical or horizontal orientations was generally comparable. Across all regions evaluated, the mean measured discrepancies ranged below 196.2 ± 44.32 µm, which falls within ranges previously reported in the literature as clinically acceptable for thermoformed aligners (117.76 ± 23.58-196.2 ± 44.32 µm).
CONCLUSION: SEM evaluation revealed that thermoformed aligners fabricated on the original dental models demonstrated a comparable fit on rapid-prototyped dental models, with no significant differences observed between models fabricated in horizontal or vertical three-dimensional printing orientations.
documents.authors: Subbaiah Naveen K, Chaudhari Prabhat Kumar, Duggal Ritu, Samrit Vilas D
documents.summary_ja: PolyJetプリンターで水平方向または垂直方向に造形した急速プロトタイピング歯型上に、オリジナル歯型で成形したサーモフォームアライナーの適合性を走査型電子顕微鏡（SEM）で比較したin vitro研究。10本の歯型をスキャンし、水平・垂直方向に各10本のモデルを造形し、0.75 mm Duronシートで成形したアライナーの適合差を測定した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: PolyJet造形の方向（水平・垂直）の違いは、サーモフォームアライナーの適合性に有意な差を生じさせず、いずれの方向も臨床的に許容される範囲内（196.2 ± 44.32 µm以下）の適合差であった。
documents.why_matters_ja: ワークフロー：アライナー製造における急速プロトタイピング歯型の造形方向の選択が適合性に影響しないことを示し、製造工程の柔軟性を裏付ける。planned-vs-achieved：造形モデル上のアライナー適合差が臨床的に許容範囲内であることを定量し、計画モデルと実物モデル間の精度差の目安を提供する。

documents.title: Effects of Clear Aligner Therapy on Quality of Life and Anxiety Levels: An Exploratory Study in Patients With Disabilities.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Considering the orthodontic needs of individuals with disabilities and the potential impact of such treatments on both quality of life (QoL) and anxiety, this study aims to assess the effects of using clear aligner therapy (Invisalign) on QoL and anxiety levels in this population.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Fourteen patients with malocclusion and disabilities were enrolled. Initial orthodontic examinations were performed, and questionnaires were administered to assess QoL and anxiety using the WHOQoL-BREF and the State-Trait Anxiety Inventory (STAI-T), respectively, with assessments completed at baseline (T0), three months (T1), and six months (T2) after the start of therapy. The maximum sampling error was evaluated using Pearson's Coefficient of Variation. The normality of the sample distributions was assessed using the Shapiro-Wilk test. For within-group comparisons across the three time points, Friedman's nonparametric test for paired samples was employed, with a post hoc 2-to-2 Pairwise Comparison test. The correlation between QoL and anxiety levels was evaluated with Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (p < 0.05).
RESULTS: A statistically significant decrease was observed in the Environment domain at T2 compared to T0 and T1 (p = 0.0126), as well as a significant increase in the Overall Quality of Life domain from T1 to T2 (p = 0.0145). The correlation analysis revealed significant associations among the domains of the WHOQoL-BREF and STAI-T.
CONCLUSIONS: An improvement in the overall quality of life among children and adolescents with disabilities was observed during clear aligner therapy; nonetheless, further controlled studies are needed to confirm this association.
documents.authors: Micheletti-Cerqueira Kelly Regina, Inagaki-Nomura Luciana Tiemi, Nagata Mariana Emi, de Oliveira Lima Carlos Eduardo, Tondelli Pedro Marcelo, de Araújo Fonseca Figueiredo Mariane, Brancher João Armando
documents.summary_ja: 知的・身体的障害を有する不正咬合患者14名を対象に、クリアアライナー治療（Invisalign）が生活の質（QoL）と不安レベルに与える影響を評価した探索的研究。WHOQoL-BREFとSTAI-Tを用い、治療開始時（T0）、3ヶ月後（T1）、6ヶ月後（T2）の3時点での評価を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 障害を有する小児・思春期患者において、クリアアライナー治療中に全体的な生活の質の改善が観察された。Environment領域はT2でT0・T1と比較して有意に低下（p=0.0126）、Overall Quality of Life領域はT1からT2で有意に上昇（p=0.0145）した。WHOQoL-BREF各領域とSTAI-Tの間に有意な関連が認められた。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：障害を有する患者における不安レベル（STAI-T）の追跡が治療中の安全性評価に寄与する。ワークフローの観点：T0/T1/T2の構造化された評価プロトコルは、特殊な患者群における治療モニタリングのワークフロー設計に参考となる。

documents.endpoints_ja: 生活の質（WHOQoL-BREF各領域）、不安レベル（STAI-T）をT0、T1、T2の3時点で評価
documents.endpoint_results_ja: Environment領域：T2がT0・T1と比較して有意に低下（p=0.0126）。Overall Quality of Life領域：T1からT2で有意に上昇（p=0.0145）。WHOQoL-BREF各領域とSTAI-Tの間に有意な関連が認められた。

documents.title: Unexpected complications of long-term fixed retainers: A case series.
documents.abstract: Unwanted tooth movements caused by long-term bonded fixed retainer placement or improperly placed orthodontic appliances can cause adverse occlusal and periodontal effects. This case series reports the treatment of severe complications of long-term fixed retention in two previously orthodontically treated adult patients. Both patients wore a mandibular canine-to-canine bonded retainer, with no evident signs of debonding or breakage; however, the mandibular incisor, which had remained bonded to the retainer, was bearing the entire incisor load, resulting in extreme lingual movement of the root, and ultimately severe lingual fenestration. In both patients the treatment opted for was carefully designed customized appliances comprising clear aligners in one case and a fully customized lingual fixed appliance in the other, to recover proper alignment, with labial repositioning of the displaced roots. The treatment outcomes were satisfactory, and lingual gingival recession appeared resolved in both patients, as confirmed by pre- and post-treatment CBCT. The treatment and clinical manifestations initially observed are discussed, along with the possible causes and considerations for the prevention of similar clinical scenarios.
documents.authors: Mampieri Gianluca, Scuzzo Giacomo, Giancotti Aldo
documents.summary_ja: 長期固定保装置による重大な合併症を呈した2名の成人患者の症例シリーズ。両患者とも下顎犬歯間ボンド型固定保装置を装着しており、デボンドや破損の所見はなかったが、下顎切歯が保装置にボンドされたまま切歯荷重を全て負担し、歯根の極端な舌側移動と重度の舌側穿通（fenestration）をきたした。治療には、1例ではクリアアライナー、もう1例ではフルカスタマイズされた舌側固定装置を用い、歯根の唇側再位置と咬合回復を目的とした。治療成績は満足可であり、術前後CBCTで舌側歯肉退縮の解決が確認された。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 固定保装置がデボンドや破損なく intact に見える場合でも、力分布の不適切さにより重度の歯周合併症（舌側穿通）を来し得る。クリアアライナーやカスタマイズ舌側固定装置を用いた治療により、歯根の唇側再位置と歯肉退縮の解決が可能であった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：保装置が外観上問題なく見える状態でも重度の歯周損傷を来し得ることを示し、保装置装着中の定期モニタリングの重要性を裏付ける。計画品質の観点：保装置の設計における力分布の考慮が不十分であったことが合併症の一要因であり、保装置計画時の生体力学的評価の重要性を示唆する。planned-vs-achievedの観点：保装置は計画通り装着・維持されていたが、意図しない重度の歯根移動という結果が生じた。
documents.study_type_ja: 症例シリーズ（2例）
documents.endpoints_ja: 治療成績（満足可否）、舌側歯肉退縮の解決（術前後CBCTによる確認）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に数値は記載されていない。定性的な記述のみ：「治療成績は満足可であり、両患者とも舌側歯肉退縮が解決したことが術前後CBCTで確認された」。

documents.title: Evaluation of the preventive effects of fluoride varnish, CPP-ACP, nHAp, and self-assembling peptide P11-4 on enamel demineralization around and under clear aligner attachments: An in vitro study.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: This study aimed to evaluate and compare the effects of fluoride varnish (FV), casein phosphopeptide-amorphous calcium phosphate (CPP-ACP), nano-hydroxyapatite (nHAp), and self-assembling peptide (SAP) P11-4 on the prevention of enamel demineralization around and under orthodontic clear aligner attachments.
METHODS: Ninety-six freshly extracted human premolar teeth were randomly assigned to six groups (n=16): FV, CPP-ACP, nHAp, SAP, positive control (CO+), and negative control (CO-). Attachments were bonded to the buccal surfaces of the teeth in the treatment groups. The positive control group received attachments without additional treatment. The negative control group received no attachment and was immersed only in deionized water. The remineralizing agents were then applied to the buccal surfaces of the teeth. All groups, except for the negative control group, were subjected to a pH-cycling process for 15 days. Each tooth was sectioned buccolingually; one half was utilized for cross-sectional microhardness (CSMH) testing and the other half for energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) analysis. Both tests were conducted at the occlusal, middle, and gingival areas of the attachment. Enamel CSMH and EDX calcium/phosphorus (Ca/P) ratio were assessed at multiple depths from the external enamel surface in each area. Statistical analysis was performed using a three-way mixed-design ANOVA and Games-Howell post hoc tests.
RESULTS: The group effect was significant for both CSMH (F(5,90)=123.8, P<0.001, partial η2=0.87) and the Ca/P ratio (F(5,90)=30.0, P<0.001, partial η2=0.63). SAP showed the highest values among the remineralizing agents (CSMH, 189.8, 95% confidence intervals [CI], 186.6-193.0; Ca/P, 2.13, 95% CI, 2.10-2.16). For CSMH, SAP values were significantly higher than those for nHAp and the positive control (p ≤ 0.002). Differences among SAP, FV, and CPP-ACP were not significant once within-tooth clustering was accounted for. For the Ca/P ratio, SAP values were significantly higher than those for FV, CPP-ACP, nHAp, and the positive control (P≤0.03). All agents showed significantly higher values than the positive control (P<0.02). CSMH and the Ca/P ratio increased with depth (P<0.001), and gingival values were lower than occlusal and middle values (P<0.001).
CONCLUSION: All tested remineralizing agents demonstrated variable preventive effects against enamel demineralization around and under clear aligner attachments when compared with the positive control group. SAP showed the most favourable results among all treatment groups.
documents.authors: Hasan Ali Khalil, Kamel Ahmed Mohamed, Shamaa Marwa Sameh
documents.summary_ja: クリアアライナーアタッチメント周囲および下面のエナメル質脱灰予防効果について、フッ化物バーニッシュ（FV）、CPP-ACP、ナノヒドロキシアパタイト（nHAp）、自己集合ペプチド（SAP）P11-4の効果を比較評価したin vitro研究。抜歯したヒト前臼歯96本を6群（各n=16）に無作為割り付けし、15日間のpHサイクル処理後に断層マイクロ硬さ（CSMH）およびCa/P比をアタッチメントの切端・中部・歯肉部で測定した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: SAP（P11-4）は、クリアアライナーアタッチメント周囲および下面のエナメル質脱灰予防において、全治療群中で最も良好な結果を示した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：クリアアライナーアタッチメント周囲のエナメル質脱灰（ホワイトスポット病変）はアライナー治療の既知の臨床的懸念事項であり、本研究はアタッチメント周囲の脱灰予防に有効な再石灰化剤をin vitro条件下で比較したものであり、治療中の安全性管理に示唆を与える。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 断層マイクロ硬さ（CSMH）、Ca/P比（アタッチメントの切端・中部・歯肉部、エナメル質外表面から複数深度で測定）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: CSMH：群効果有意（F(5,90)=123.8, P<0.001, partial η2=0.87）。Ca/P比：群効果有意（F(5,90)=30.0, P<0.001, partial η2=0.63）。SAPのCSMHは189.8（95% CI 186.6-193.0）、Ca/P比は2.13（95% CI 2.10-2.16）で、再石灰化剤中最も高値。CSMHにおいてSAPはnHApおよび陽性対照より有意に高値（p≤0.002）。SAP、FV、CPP-ACP間の差は歯内クラスタリングを考慮すると有意でなかった。Ca/P比においてSAPはFV、CPP-ACP、nHAp、陽性対照より有意に高値（P≤0.03）。全薬剤が陽性対照より有意に高値（P<0.02）。CSMHおよびCa/P比は深度とともに増加（P<0.001）、歯肉部は切端部・中部より低値（P<0.001）。

documents.title: A retrospective study of mandibular incisor intrusion with invisalign in adult deep-bite patients.
documents.abstract: This retrospective study quantitatively evaluated mandibular incisor intrusion and associated vertical skeletal changes during deep-bite correction using Invisalign clear aligner therapy. Twenty-seven adult patients (19-54 years of age) with skeletal Class I or II malocclusion and deep overbite (> 3 mm) treated with Invisalign incorporating precision bite ramps were retrospectively analyzed. Lateral cephalometric radiographs obtained before (T0) and after treatment (T1) were superimposed on the cranial base and mandible. Mandibular incisor movement was assessed using centroid-based measurements to isolate pure intrusion and minimize the influence of tipping. Changes in the occlusal plane angle, mandibular plane angle (FMA), incisor mandibular plane angle (IMPA), and molar vertical position were also evaluated. Paired t-tests were performed for statistical comparisons. The mandibular incisor centroid demonstrated statistically significant pure intrusion of 1.63 mm (p < 0.001). Occlusal plane angle increased significantly (mean change: 2.38°, p = 0.001) and overbite decreased (mean change: -1.98 mm, p = 0.001), whereas changes in the FMA, IMPA, and mandibular molar extrusion were not statistically significant, suggesting limited vertical skeletal changes during treatment. These findings suggest that Invisalign therapy with precision bite ramps demonstrated mandibular incisor intrusion in adult deep-bite patients.
documents.authors: Choo Hyunhee, Kim Young Ho, Chang Kunyoung, Hong Pureum, Kim Minseo, Kim Soo Jin, Shin Jeong Won, Ji Hyeok
documents.summary_ja: Invisalign透明アライナー治療（precision bite ramps併用）による成人deep-bite症例の顎下前歯圧入および関連する垂直骨格変化を定量的に評価した後ろ向き研究。骨格Class IまたはIIの不正咬合でdeep overbite（>3 mm）を有する成人27例（19〜54歳）を対象に、治療前（T0）と治療後（T1）の側面頭部X線写真を頭蓋底および下顎に重ね合わせ、重心ベースの測定により純粋な圧入を分離評価した。咬合平面角、FMA、IMPA、下顎臼歯の垂直位置の変化も評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: Precision bite rampsを併用したInvisalign治療は、成人deep-bite症例で顎下前歯の統計的に有意な純粋圧入（1.63 mm）を達成し、咬合平面角の増加（+2.38°）とoverbiteの減少（-1.98 mm）を伴ったが、FMA・IMPA・下顎臼歯の圧出には統計的有意な変化はなく、治療中の垂直骨格変化は限定的であった。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：precision bite rampsという特定機能を用いた際の実際の圧入量（1.63 mm）が定量化されており、治療計画時の期待値設定に参考となる。planning qualityの観点：重心ベース測定による純粋圧入とtipの分離評価手法は、治療計画の精度評価に有用。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き研究（retrospective study）
documents.endpoints_ja: 顎下前歯の純粋圧入量（重心ベース）、咬合平面角の変化、overbiteの変化、FMAの変化、IMPAの変化、下顎臼歯の垂直位置（圧出）の変化
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 顎下前歯純粋圧入：1.63 mm（p < 0.001）、咬合平面角：+2.38°（p = 0.001）、overbite：-1.98 mm（p = 0.001）、FMA：統計的に有意な変化なし、IMPA：統計的に有意な変化なし、下顎臼歯圧出：統計的に有意な変化なし

documents.title: Evaluation of Antibacterial Effect and Mechanical Properties of Thermoformed Clear Aligners Coated with Chitosan and Cellulose Nanocrystals.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Though aligners are considered more hygienic, they are linked to a higher occurrence of white spot lesions. These lesions pose clinical challenges and compromise aesthetics.
PURPOSE: The aim of present study was the evaluation of antibacterial effect and mechanical properties of thermoformed clear aligners coated with chitosan and cellulose nanocrystals.
MATERIALS AND METHOD: This in vitro study evaluated five experimental groups of aligners including (1) Passive control, (2) Active control, (3) Aligners coated with chitosan (CH), (4) Aligners coated with cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs), and (5) Aligners coated with a combination of CH/CNCs. Each group consisted of 30 samples that consisted of 10 discs for antimicrobial testing, 5 cubes for surface microhardness, and 15 cubes for the three-point bending test. Surface morphology was analyzed using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS). Antibacterial properties were assessed through disc diffusion and serial dilution methods against Escherichia coli (E. coli) and Streptococcus mutans (S. mutans). Mechanical properties, including surface microhardness and maximum force under bending, were evaluated using Vickers hardness and three-point bending tests. Statistical analysis was performed using ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis tests, with p Value< 0.05 considered significant.
RESULTS: The CH/CNC group showing the highest microhardness (13.37±1.00 VHN) and the CNC group demonstrated the highest force resistance (62.31±7.36 MPa), though the difference was not statistically significant (p> 0.05). In the disc diffusion test, CH coatings showed significant antibacterial activity, especially against E. coli (10.8±1.09mm zone of inhibition, p= 0.006), and while CH/CNC showed significant antibacterial activity, especially against S. mutans (6.00±5.47, p= 0.020). CNC coatings showed no bacterial inhibitory effect (p> 0.05).
CONCLUSION: The results of our study suggested that applying CNC combined with chitosan as coatings on orthodontic aligners offers a viable strategy to improve both antimicrobial and mechanical properties.
documents.authors: Hosseini Seyyed Hadi, Motamedifar Mohammad, Ajami Shabnam
documents.summary_ja: 熱成形型クリアアライナーにキトサン（CH）とセルロースナノクリスタル（CNC）をコーティングした5群（パッシブ対照、アクティブ対照、CHコーティング、CNCコーティング、CH/CNC複合コーティング）について、抗菌効果と機械的性質をin vitroで評価した研究。抗菌性はE. coliとS. mutansに対するディスク拡散法と連続希釈法で、機械的性質は表面マイクロ硬さ（ビッカース硬さ）と3点曲げ試験で評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: CH/CNC複合コーティング群が最も高いマイクロ硬さ（13.37±1.00 VHN）を示し、CNC群が最も高い曲げ耐 lực（62.31±7.36 MPa）を示したが、群間差は統計的に有意ではなかった（p>0.05）。抗菌性ではCHコーティングがE. coliに対して有意な抗菌活性（10.8±1.09mm、p=0.006）を示し、CH/CNC複合コーティングがS. mutansに対して有意な抗菌活性（6.00±5.47、p=0.020）を示した。CNC単独コーティングには抗菌効果は認められなかった（p>0.05）。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：アライナー使用に伴うホワイトスポット病変の発生は臨床的課題であり、抗菌コーティングによる細菌付着抑制は患者の口腔健康リスク低減に寄与し得る。planned-vs-achievedの観点：アライナー材料の機械的性質（硬さ・曲げ耐性）は力伝達の一貫性に影響し、治療計画通りの歯移動が達成されるかどうかに関わる材料特性として関連する。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro研究（材料評価・ベンチスタディ）
documents.endpoints_ja: 抗菌活性（ディスク拡散法による阻害環直径）、表面マイクロ硬さ（ビッカース硬さ）、3点曲げ試験による最大曲げ力、表面形態（SEM・EDS）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: CH/CNC群：マイクロ硬さ 13.37±1.00 VHN（最高値）。CNC群：曲げ耐力 62.31±7.36 MPa（最高値）。群間差は統計的に有意でない（p>0.05）。CHコーティング：E. coliに対する阻害環 10.8±1.09mm（p=0.006、有意）。CH/CNC複合コーティング：S. mutansに対する阻害環 6.00±5.47（p=0.020、有意）。CNCコーティング：抗菌効果なし（p>0.05）。

documents.title: Nonsurgical clear aligner treatment of an adult right-sided Class III subdivision malocclusion using miniscrew-assisted mandibular distalization: A case report.
documents.abstract: Adult asymmetric Class III malocclusions can be challenging to camouflage when crowding, anterior crossbite, and dental midline discrepancies must be corrected without worsening an acceptable soft-tissue profile. This case report describes a 40-year-old woman with mild skeletal Class III malocclusion mainly due to maxillary retrusion, a normodivergent pattern, a right-sided Class III subdivision associated with leftward mandibular deviation, mild crowding in both arches, an edge-to-edge incisor relationship, and noncoincident dental midlines. After extraction of all third molars, treatment was performed with Invisalign Comprehensive aligners, staged interproximal enamel reduction, programmed maxillary incisor extrusion, and asymmetric mandibular distalization of up to 2.0mm on the right and 1.3mm on the left. Two posterior mandibular miniscrews were connected to composite buttons on the mandibular canines to reinforce distal traction, and a right-sided Class III elastic was added during refinement. A refinement-related posterior open bite was managed with posterior aligner cutback and vertical settling elastics. Active treatment lasted 21 months. Bilateral Class I canine and molar relationships, coincident dental midlines, positive overjet and overbite, correction of the anterior crossbite, and improved maxillary incisor display were achieved. Cephalometric changes were predominantly dentoalveolar, with maintenance of the skeletal pattern, mandibular incisor retraction, and lower-lip retrusion. Miniscrew anchorage was essential in combination with aligners, interproximal reduction, attachments, and elastics. The occlusion and periodontal condition remained stable at the 1-year follow-up.
documents.authors: Nguyen Viet Anh, Doan Thi Bich Ngoc, Ha Phuong Linh, Nguyen Thi Nhu Trang
documents.summary_ja: 40歳の女性で、上顎後退を主因とする軽度骨格性Class III不正咬合、右側Class III subdivision、両顎の軽度叢生、エッジトゥエッジ切歯関係、歯軸中線不一致を呈した症例。全第三大臼歯抜去後、Invisalign Comprehensiveアライナー、段階的IPR、上顎切歯のプログラムされた圧排、右側最大2.0mm・左側1.3mmの非対称下顎遠心移動（後方下顎ミニスクリュー2本を犬歯のコンポジットボタンに連結して遠心牽引を強化）により治療。精査段階で生じた後方オープンバイトは後方アライナーカットバックと垂直方向セッティングエラстикで管理。主治療期間は21ヶ月。両側Class I犬歯・臼歯関係、歯軸中線一致、正のオーバージェット・オーバーバイト、前歯交叉咬合の修正、上顎切歯露出の改善を達成。頭部X線計測所見は主に歯槽骨性変化であり、骨格パターンは維持された。1年後フォローアップで咬合および歯周状態は安定。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 複雑なClass III subdivision症例における非対称下顎遠心移動には、アライナー・IPR・アタッチメント・エラстикとの組み合わせにおいてミニスクリューアンカレッジが不可欠であった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 精査（refinement）段階で後方オープンバイトが発生し、アライナーカットバックと垂直方向セッティングエラстикで対応した事例として、精査フェーズの計画品質管理に示唆を与える。また、計画された非対称遠心移動量（右2.0mm・左1.3mm）と達成された咬合結果（両側Class I関係、中線一致）の対応関係が示されており、planned-vs-achievedの観点で参考となる。1年後の歯周安定性は安全性の観点からも意義がある。
documents.study_type_ja: 症例報告
documents.endpoints_ja: 咬合結果（犬歯・臼歯関係、オーバージェット、オーバーバイト、歯軸中線）、頭部X線計測変化、1年後の咬合・歯周安定性
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 非対称下顎遠心移動：右側最大2.0mm、左側1.3mm。主治療期間21ヶ月。両側Class I犬歯・臼歯関係、歯軸中線一致、正のオーバージェット・オーバーバイトを達成。頭部X線計測変化は主に歯槽骨性。1年後フォローアップで咬合および歯周状態は安定。

documents.title: Do resin composite type and bleaching regimen influence tooth color change under attachment presence? An in vitro study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to assess the influence of composite resin type used for attachment fabrication and of bleaching regimen on the colour and whiteness changes of bovine enamel submitted to bleaching.
METHODS: Standardized crowns received attachments made with Voco AlignerFlow LC (AF), 3M™ Transbond™ Supreme LV, (LV), or were left without attachment (WA). Specimens were treated with at-home (HO), in-office (OF), or without bleaching (WB). Therefore, nine groups were established (n=10/group): AF/HO, AF/OF, AF/WB, LV/HO, LV/OF, LV/WB, WA/HO, WA/OF, and WA/WB. Color (ΔE00), whiteness index (ΔWID), and colour coordinates (ΔL*, Δa*, Δb*) changes were evaluated by means of digital spectrophotometry. Data were analysed using generalized linear models followed by Bonferroni tests (α=5%).
RESULTS: AF/HO and AF/OF showed similar ΔE00 and ΔWID (P=1.000), both being higher than AF/WB (P<0.05). For the LV resin, only LV/OF differed from LV/WB for ΔE00 (P=0.044) and ΔWID (P=0.018), whereas LV/HO and LV/OF showed similar ΔWID (P=0.998). In the absence of attachments, WA/HO and WA/OF exhibited higher ΔE00 and ΔWID than WA/WB (both P<0.001). Specimens without attachments showed higher ΔE00, ΔWID, and Δb* than those with AF or LV attachments (all P<0.05). All bleached groups exceed the perceptibility and acceptability thresholds for both ΔE00 and ΔWID, whereas WA/WB remained below these thresholds.
CONCLUSION: The presence of attachments reduced bleaching effectiveness and compromised colour uniformity, although bleaching remained effective compared to non-bleached conditions. No differences were observed between at-home and in-office protocols, and the type of attachment resin composite also did not interfere in the outcomes.
documents.authors: Rodrigues Rebeca J G, Oporto Ana Júlia S P, Saraceni Cíntia H C, Cavalli Vanessa, Fronza Bruna M, Kury Matheus, Sendyk Michelle
documents.summary_ja: 牛歯エナメル質を用いたin vitro研究であり、アタッチメント作製に使用したコンポジットレジンタイプ（Voco AlignerFlow LC、3M Transbond Supreme LV、アタッチメントなし）とホワイトニングプロトコル（ホームホワイトニング、オフィスホワイトニング、ホワイトニングなし）が色および白さの変化に与える影響を評価した。9群（各群n=10）を設け、デジタル分光光度計によりΔE00、ΔWID、色座標（ΔL*、Δa*、Δb*）の変化を測定した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: アタッチメントの存在はホワイトニングの効果を低下させ、色の均一性を損なうが、非ホワイトニング条件と比較してホワイトニングは依然として有効であった。ホームホワイトニングとオフィスホワイトニングの間には差が認められず、アタッチメント用コンポジットレジンのタイプも結果に影響しなかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療計画の観点：アタッチメント装着中のホワイトニングでは色均一性が損なわれるため、ホワイトニングとアタッチメント装着のタイミング計画に示唆を与える。ワークフローの観点：ホームとオフィスのホワイトニングプロトコル間で差がないことは、患者の選択肢や臨床ワークフロー設計に参考となる。planned-vs-achievedの観点：アタッチメント存在下では期待されるホワイトニング効果が低下し、色の均一性において計画と達成の乖離が生じうる。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro研究
documents.endpoints_ja: ΔE00、ΔWID（白さ指数）、色座標（ΔL*、Δa*、Δb*）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: AF/HOとAF/OFはΔE00とΔWIDで類似（P=1.000）、いずれもAF/WBより高値（P<0.05）。LV/OFはLV/WBとΔE00（P=0.044）およびΔWID（P=0.018）で有意差。LV/HOとLV/OFはΔWIDで類似（P=0.998）。WA/HOとWA/OFはWA/WBよりΔE00とΔWIDで高値（いずれもP<0.001）。アタッチメントなし群はAFまたはLVアタッチメント群よりΔE00、ΔWID、Δb*で高値（いずれもP<0.05）。全ホワイトニング群はΔE00とΔWIDの両方で知覚閾値および許容閾値を超え、WA/WBは閾値未満であった。

documents.title: Thirty-Day Thermomechanical Ageing of 3D-Printed and Thermoformed Orthodontic Aligners: A Comparative Force Analysis.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To investigate the effect of thermomechanical ageing on the force system of three-dimensional (3D)-printed orthodontic aligners compared with conventional thermoformed aligners and to evaluate the thickness characteristics of both aligner types.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Ten aligners were fabricated from 3D-printed Tera Harz TC-85 resin, and 10 from thermoformed Zendura FLX (ZF). All aligners underwent thermomechanical ageing for up to 30 days. Forces transmitted to the maxillary right central incisor (Tooth 11) in a resin model were measured before ageing (Day 0) and after thermomechanical ageing (Days 2, 7, and 30) using Fuji pressure-sensitive films to assess contact normal forces and an orthodontic measurement and simulation system (OMSS) to measure resultant 3D forces. Aligner thickness was evaluated using a digital caliper and microcomputed tomography.
RESULTS: TC-85 aligners generated significantly higher initial normal contact forces than ZF aligners (149.7 ± 25.6 N vs 69.8 ± 9.0 N). Both materials exhibited significant force decay following thermomechanical ageing. Orthodontic measurement and simulation system analysis demonstrated comparable preageing resultant forces for both materials (0.1 ± 0.07 N to 0.5 ± 0.09 N), with no statistically significant difference in facial force components at baseline. Facial forces remained relatively stable over time, whereas lingual resultant forces decreased significantly. Thickness analysis demonstrated pronounced thinning in ZF aligners (≈0.5 ± 0.05 mm) and thickening in TC-85 aligners (≈1.0 ± 0.09 mm).
CONCLUSIONS: TC-85 aligners produced higher initial normal contact forces than ZF aligners, consistent with their greater postmanufacturing thickness and reported improved adaptation to the dental model; however, both materials exhibited force decay over time. Although preageing resultant forces were comparable between materials, the reduction in lingual resultant forces may adversely affect the predictability of tooth movement during prolonged aligner wear.
CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE: The current findings underscore the significant impact of aligner material, thickness, and manufacturing method on force stability and consistency in clear aligner therapy.
documents.authors: Elshazly Tarek, Alhotan Abdulaziz, Shalabi Ammar Al, Elshennawy Ahmad, Diraz Hala, Puchert Kathrin, Kim Hoon, Talaat Sameh
documents.summary_ja: 3Dプリント（TC-85レジン）と熱成形（Zendura FLX）の矯正アライナーについて、30日間の熱機械的経時変化が力系に与える影響を比較し、両アライナーの厚さ特性を評価したin vitro比較研究。上顎右側中切歯（Tooth 11）への伝達力をDay 0、2、7、30日にFuji圧感紙とOMSSで測定し、厚さはデジタルノギスとマイクロCTで評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: TC-85アライナーはZFアライナーより有意に高い初期接触法線力を生じた（149.7±25.6 N vs 69.8±9.0 N）が、両材料とも経時変化により力減衰を示した。特に舌側合成力が有意に減少し、長時間アライナー装着時の歯移動の予測可能性に悪影響を与える可能性がある。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 舌側合成力の経時的減少は、長時間アライナー装着時の歯移動の予測可能性（planned vs achieved）に悪影響を与える可能性が示唆されている。安全性: アライナー材料・厚さ・製造方法が力の安定性と一貫性に大きな影響を与えることが確認され、治療計画時の材料選択の根拠となる。
documents.study_type_ja: 比較研究（in vitro / ベンチトップ研究）
documents.endpoints_ja: 接触法線力（Fuji圧感紙）、合成3D力（OMSS）、頬側力成分、舌側合成力、アライナー厚さ（デジタルノギス・マイクロCT）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 初期接触法線力: TC-85 149.7±25.6 N vs ZF 69.8±9.0 N（有意差あり）。経時変化前の合成力: 両材料とも0.1±0.07 N〜0.5±0.09 N（有意差なし）。頬側力成分は基線時に有意差なし、経過中に比較的安定。舌側合成力は有意に減少。厚さ変化: ZFは約0.5±0.05 mmの薄化、TC-85は約1.0±0.09 mmの厚化。

documents.title: Comparative Evaluation of Transverse Maxillary Arch Changes in Mixed Dentition with Clear Aligners vs Conventional Maxillary Expanders: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate and compare the effects of clear aligner therapy (CAT) vs conventional maxillary expanders [rapid maxillary expansion (RME) and slow maxillary expansion (SME)] in treating maxillary arch constriction during mixed dentition with a focus on transverse arch parameters, including intercanine and intermolar widths, molar inclination, arch perimeter, and palatal depth.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Electronic searches of PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Medline upto August 2025 identified 341 records. Studies included randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and prospective and retrospective cohorts assessing ME outcomes with clear aligners and conventional RME/SME expanders in mixed dentition patients. Outcomes included intercanine width, intermolar width, arch perimeter, arch width and depth, molar inclination, and palatal volume. Risk of bias was evaluated using the revised Cochrane risk-of-bias tool for randomized trials (RoB 2) for RCTs and the Methodological Index for Nonrandomized Studies (MINORS) for nonrandomized studies.
RESULTS: Eight studies met inclusion criteria, comprising a total of 412 patients aged 8.4 ± 1.3 years. Meta-analysis showed a significant trend favoring maxillary expanders over CAT for both intercanine width expansion [-0.54; 95% confidence interval (CI): -1.17, 0.09; p = 0.09] and intermolar width [-1.01 (95% CI: -1.59, -0.43; p = 0.0006)]. CAT demonstrated superior control over molar inclination with reduced buccal tipping. Heterogeneity varied across outcomes, largely owing to differences in study designs and protocols. Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) assessment revealed overall very low quality of evidence with moderate risk of bias.
CONCLUSION: RME demonstrated significantly greater increases in intermolar width compared to CAT, while intercanine width changes were comparable between treatments. Although both modalities effectively address transverse deficiencies in mixed dentition, they differ in expansion patterns and dental effects, with CAT offering more controlled dentoalveolar expansion and minimal molar tipping.
HOW TO CITE THIS ARTICLE: Athawale S, Mohelay N, Batra P, et al. Comparative Evaluation of Transverse Maxillary Arch Changes in Mixed Dentition with Clear Aligners vs Conventional Maxillary Expanders: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis. Int J Clin Pediatr Dent 2026;19(8):1067-1077.
documents.journal: International journal of clinical pediatric dentistry
documents.authors: Athawale Sayali, Mohelay Nikita, Batra Puneet, Talwar Aditya, Singh Ashish Kumar
documents.summary_ja: 混合歯列期における上顎横径拡大に対し、クリアアライナー（CAT）と従来の上顎拡大装置（RME/SME）の効果を比較したシステマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス。8研究・412例（平均年齢8.4±1.3歳）を対象に、犬歯間幅、大臼歯間幅、歯弓周囲長、歯弓幅・深さ、大臼歯傾斜、口蓋体積を評価した。メタアナリシスでは、大臼歯間幅の拡大においてRMEがCATに有意に優位（-1.01; 95%CI: -1.59, -0.43; p=0.0006）であり、犬歯間幅は両群間で有意差なし（-0.54; 95%CI: -1.17, 0.09; p=0.09）。CATは歯槽骨性拡大の制御性が高く、大臼歯の頬側傾斜が少なかった。GRADE評価では全体的に非常に低い質のエビデンス、中等度のバイアスリスクと判定された。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 混合歯列期の横径拡大において、大臼歯間幅の拡大効果はRMEがCATに有意に優位である一方、犬歯間幅は同等。CATは歯槽骨性拡大の制御性が高く大臼歯傾斜が少ないが、横径拡大の絶対量ではRMEに劣る。エビデンスの質は非常に低く、臨床判断には注意が必要。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：CATによる横径拡大の達成量はRMEより小さい（特に大臼歯間幅）ため、治療計画時にCAT単独での横径拡大目標を設定する場合は、期待される拡大量に上限があることを認識する必要がある。refinementの観点：CATは歯槽骨性拡大の制御性が高く大臼歯の頬側傾斜が少ないため、歯の移動パターンを精密に制御したい症例ではCATの特性が計画の質に影響する。ただし、エビデンスの質が非常に低いため、計画時の信頼度は限定的。
documents.study_type_ja: システマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス
documents.endpoints_ja: 犬歯間幅、大臼歯間幅、歯弓周囲長、歯弓幅・深さ、大臼歯傾斜、口蓋体積
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 犬歯間幅：-0.54; 95%CI: -1.17, 0.09; p=0.09（上顎拡大装置がCATに優位な傾向）。大臼歯間幅：-1.01; 95%CI: -1.59, -0.43; p=0.0006（上顎拡大装置がCATに有意に優位）。大臼歯傾斜：CATが優位な制御（頬側傾斜の減少）。GRADE：全体的に非常に低い質のエビデンス、中等度のバイアスリスク。

documents.title: The Environmental Burden and Sustainability Challenges of Clear Aligners: Implications for Public Health, Practice, Policy, and Future Research-A Scoping Review.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Malocclusion is a major global oral health concern and has driven the rapid adoption of clear aligner therapy (CAT) as an esthetic and removable alternative to conventional fixed appliances. However, the widespread use of CAT has raised important concerns regarding its environmental footprint and potential public health implications, including waste generation, chemical leaching, and the release of microplastics. This scoping review aimed to systematically synthesize the available evidence on the environmental and public health implications of CAT and identify key areas in practice, research, and policy to advance toward sustainable oral healthcare services in alignment with the World Health Organization's Global Oral Health Action Plan 2023-2030.
METHODS: This scoping review was conducted in accordance with Arksey and O'Malley's framework and reported in line with PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Eligible sources were identified through a search across four databases, namely, PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Embase, to identify literature addressing environmental or public health aspects of clear aligners, published in English, either in print or online ahead of print, between January 2005 and December 2025. Data charting was conducted, followed by qualitative analysis using ATLAS.ti to identify the key themes emerging from included sources relating to the research question.
RESULTS: A total of 61 sources were included. The major themes which emerged from this scoping review included material toxicity and chemical exposure, microplastic and nanoplastic release, environmental burden of CAT, technological transitions in the form of 3D/4D aligners, strategies toward sustainability and governance, regulation, and research gaps.
CONCLUSIONS: CAT must be recognized not only as an orthodontic innovation but also as an emerging public health and sustainability challenge, highlighting the need for stronger evidence, safer materials, improved waste management, and clearer regulations to align future orthodontic care with Sustainable Development Goals 3 (Good Health and Well-being) and 13 (Climate Action).
documents.authors: Sakshi Sakshi, Desai Asavari, Bajaj Parul Dasson
documents.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正（CAT）の環境負荷と持続可能性に関するスコーピングレビュー。廃棄物発生、化学物質溶出、マイクロプラスチック放出などの公衆衛生上の懸念を体系的に統合し、WHOグローバルオーラルヘルス行動計画2023-2030に沿った持続可能な口腔医療サービスへの課題を特定することを目的とした。Arksey and O'Malleyのフレームワークに従い、PRISMA-ScRガイドラインに沿って報告。PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Embaseの4データベースから2005年1月から2025年12月までに英語で出版された文献を抽出し、ATLAS.tiを用いて定性分析を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: CATは正畸学的イノベーションであると同時に、新興の公衆衛生・持続可能性上の課題であり、より強力なエビデンス、より安全な材料、改善された廃棄物管理、明確な規制が必要である。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：材料毒性・化学物質曝露、マイクロプラスチック・ナノプラスチック放出が主要テーマとして特定されており、CATの安全性プロファイルに関する公衆衛生上の懸念が示唆されている。
documents.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュー（Arksey and O'Malleyフレームワーク、PRISMA-ScR準拠）
documents.endpoints_ja: 臨床的エンドポイントの定義なし。スコーピングレビューであり、環境・公衆衛生関連のテーマの定性統合が目的。
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 61件のソースが包含された。主要テーマ：材料毒性と化学物質曝露、マイクロプラスチック・ナノプラスチック放出、CATの環境負荷、3D/4Dアライナーとしての技術的転換、持続可能性とガバナンスへの戦略、規制、研究のギャップ。

documents.title: Antibacterial Interventions for Orthodontic Appliances; Surface Modifications, Coatings and Bulk-Incorporated Antibacterial Agents: Materials, Mechanisms and Clinical Application-A Scoping Review.
documents.abstract: Biofilm accumulation on orthodontic appliances is a recognized risk factor for white spot lesion formation and caries during treatment. Antibacterial surface modifications and coating strategies have been proposed as appliance-level preventive approaches. Studied interventions in the literature span true thin-film surface coatings, plasma-based and ion-implantation surface modifications, and bulk-incorporated antibacterial agents in appliance matrix materials. Yet the extent to which in vitro efficacy translates to clinically meaningful protection remains unresolved. This PRISMA-ScR-compliant scoping review searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar, identifying 109 eligible studies: 96 in vitro, 8 in vivo animal studies and 5 clinical trials, covering brackets, archwires, clear aligners, bands, miniscrews, elastomeric ligatures, and removable appliances, some articles studied multiple types of appliances. In vitro studies consistently demonstrated significant reductions in bacterial adhesion and biofilm formation across all appliance types, with silver-based coatings and nitrogen-doped TiO2 showing the broadest evidence base; combination systems (Ag/ZnO, CuO-ZnO) outperformed individual agents. The 13 in vivo and clinical studies provided limited but directionally supportive evidence: silver nanoparticle-incorporated acrylic retainers reduced S. mutans counts in a double-blind RCT, and silver-infiltrated tungsten material-maintained biofilm reduction after simulated two-year abrasion. Coating durability emerged as an important determinant of potential clinical translation. Surface-deposited thin-film coatings degraded substantially within one month of intraoral use, whereas substrate-integrated approaches showed greater longevity. This scoping review maps the current evidence landscape, identifies coating durability and clinical endpoint validation as critical gaps, and prioritizes silver-based and nitrogen-doped TiO2 coatings for future randomized clinical trials.
documents.authors: Furió-Alonso Berta, Gil Javier, Nikolic Jovanovic Danica, Puigdollers-Pérez Andreu
documents.summary_ja: PRISMA-ScR準拠のスコーピングレビューであり、PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Google Scholarを検索し、109件の適格研究（in vitro 96件、in vivo動物実験8件、臨床試験5件）を特定した。ブラケット、アークワイヤー、クリアアライナー、バンド、ミニスクリュー、エラストマーリガチャー、可撤式装置を対象に、抗菌性表面改質・コーティング・マトリクス内分散型抗菌剤の証拠を整理した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: in vitro研究では全装置タイプで細菌付着・バイオフィルム形成の有意な減少が一貫して示されたが、in vivo・臨床研究（13件）は限定的であり、薄膜コーティングは口腔内使用1ヶ月以内に著しく劣化し、基質統合型アプローチの方が耐久性に優れることが示された。臨床転換の重要なギャップはコーティング耐久性と臨床エンドポイントの検証である。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：装置上のバイオフィルム蓄積は治療中のホワイトスポット病変形成と齲蝕の既知のリスク因子であり、クリアアライナーを含む装置レベルの予防戦略として抗菌コーティングが検討されている。ただし、薄膜コーティングが1ヶ月以内に劣化するという知見は、長期治療計画における持続的保護の観点から重要な制約条件となる。
