documents.title: Management of Skeletal Class II Malocclusion in a Growing Patient Using Clear Aligners and Class II Elastics: A Case Report.
documents.abstract: Objective: Class II malocclusion with mandibular retrusion in growing patients is traditionally managed with functional appliances. Recent advances in clear aligner therapy have introduced new biomechanical approaches combining aligners with intermaxillary elastics. This case report describes the correction of a skeletal Class II malocclusion using clear aligners combined with Class II elastics during the pubertal growth spurt. Methods: An 11-year-old female patient with skeletal Class II due to mandibular retrusion, increased overjet, deep bite, and dental Class II relationship was treated with clear aligners, transverse expansion, bite ramps, attachments, and full-time Class II elastics. Results: After 24 months of treatment, favorable dentoskeletal and occlusal outcomes were achieved, including improvement of the sagittal relationship (ANB reduction from 7° to 4°), mandibular advancement (SNB increase from 76° to 79°), and correction of overjet and overbite. Conclusions: The combination of clear aligners and Class II elastics may represent a valid treatment option for growing patients with mandibular Class II malocclusion, providing effective sagittal correction and good control of dental movements when applied during the appropriate growth phase.

documents.title: A retrospective study of planned and achieved rotational changes of maxillary canines with clear aligner therapy.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: This retrospective study aimed to assess the accuracy of planned moderate-to-severe rotation changes (≥5°) of maxillary canines with the Invisalign (Align Technology, Tempe, Ariz) appliance. The secondary aim was to evaluate the influence of the planned rotation direction on the accuracy.
METHODS: Digital models representing the initial malocclusion, the planned occlusions, and the achieved occlusions after the wear of an initial series of Invisalign aligners by adult patients were measured using metrology software. A method to define rotation directions was formulated. The sample was then divided into 5 categories by rotation type: mesial-in, mesial-out, distal-in, distal-out, and combination rotations. This categorization enabled subsequent analyses to determine whether the planned rotation directions were met and whether rotation direction influenced accuracy.
RESULTS: A total of 114 maxillary canines from 75 patients satisfied the inclusion criteria. Overall, the mean accuracy of the planned rotation was 64%. Rotation direction had no statistically significant influence on the accuracy of the planned rotations. Planned rotation directions were achieved in 77% of the maxillary canines evaluated. Combination rotations demonstrated the greatest variability, with 51% rotating in a direction other than that planned. A 1° increase in rotational velocity per aligner correlated with a 5.35° shortfall in the accuracy of this rotation (P < 0.05).
CONCLUSIONS: The achieved rotation of maxillary canines after the wear of an initial series of Invisalign aligners differed from the planned movements in both magnitude and direction for planned rotations of ≥5°. A method for classifying rotation types was developed, which may facilitate further research to guide clinicians and optimize treatment outcomes.

documents.summary_ja: Invisalign（Align Technology）による上顎犬歯の中等度〜重度（≥5°）の回転計画の精度を評価した後ろ向き研究。初期不正咬合、計画咬合、達成咬合のデジタルモデルを計測ソフトウェアで測定し、回転方向を5分類（mesial-in, mesial-out, distal-in, distal-out, combination）に分類して分析した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 上顎犬歯の≥5°の回転計画において、達成回転は計画と大きさ・方向の両方で乖離しており、平均精度は64%、方向の達成率は77%にとどまった。combination rotationでは51%が計画と異なる方向に回転した。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの乖離が明確に示されており、治療計画の品質（特に回転計画の設定）とrefinementの必要性に直接関連する。combination rotationの方向乖離率の高さは、計画段階での回転方向の分類方法やvelocity設定の改善を示唆する。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き研究（retrospective study）
documents.endpoints_ja: 計画回転の精度（magnitude）、計画回転方向の達成率、回転方向が精度に与える影響、アライナーあたりの回転速度と精度不足の相関
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 計画回転の平均精度：64%。計画回転方向の達成率：77%。combination rotationで51%が計画と異なる方向に回転。アライナーあたりの回転速度が1°増加するごとに5.35°の精度不足と相関（P < 0.05）。回転方向は精度に統計的に有意な影響を与えなかった。

documents.title: Assessing the environmental impact of clear aligner therapy: a scoping review.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the environmental impact and sustainability-related practices of clear aligner therapy (CAT), focusing on environmental impact, economic implications, waste management, recycling practices, manufacturing processes, and aligner materials. It further explores the alignment of clear aligner practices with Sustainable Development Goals (SDG's) 3,9,12 and 13.
METHODOLOGY: A scoping review was conducted following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guidelines. The review was guided by the Population-Concept-Context (PCC) framework. A comprehensive literature search was performed across five electronic databases (PubMed Central, Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, and EBSCOhost) for studies published between January 2014 and December 2024. Studies evaluating the environmental sustainability of clear aligner therapy, including materials, manufacturing processes, waste management, recycling practices, and carbon emissions, were included.
RESULTS: Thirteen studies met the inclusion criteria. The evidence indicates that clear aligner therapy contributes to plastic waste, microplastic generation, and greenhouse gas emissions throughout its life cycle. The included studies reported biodegradable materials, direct three-dimensional (3D) printing technologies (SDG-9), recycling initiatives (SDG 12), and circular economy approaches as potential strategies to reduce environmental impacts (SDG 3 & 13). However, the implementation of these strategies remains constrained by limited recycling infrastructure, economic considerations, and insufficient high-quality evidence.
CONCLUSION: Available evidence suggests that innovations in material selection, circular economy approaches, optimized manufacturing processes, and enhanced recycling programs may reduce the environmental burden associated with clear aligner therapy. Nevertheless, further high-quality environmental assessment studies are required to support the development of more sustainable orthodontic practices aligned with SDGs 3, 9, 12, and 13.
documents.authors: Pai Sapthami, Ahuja Dhruv, Mv Ashith, Pt Haneesh Kiran, Singh Amoli
documents.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正（CAT）の環境影響とサステナビリティ関連プラクティスを評価するスコーピングレビュー。環境影響、経済的含意、廃棄物管理、リサイクル実務、製造プロセス、マウスピース材料に焦点を当て、SDGs 3, 9, 12, 13との整合性を検討した。PRISMA-ScRガイドラインに従い、2014年1月から2024年12月までに発表された文献を5つの電子データベースから検索した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正はライフサイクル全体を通じてプラスチック廃棄物、マイクロプラスチック生成、温室効果ガス排出に寄与している。生分解性材料、直接3Dプリント技術、リサイクルイニシアチブ、サーキュラーエコノミーアプローチが環境影響低減の潜在的策略として報告されているが、リサイクルインフラの不足、経済的制約、高品質エビデンスの不足により実施が制限されている。
documents.why_matters_ja: ワークフロー：製造プロセスと材料選定が環境負荷に直結しており、生産・製造ワークフローの最適化（3Dプリント技術、サーキュラーエコノミー）が環境影響低減の鍵となる。
documents.study_type_ja: スコーピングレビュー（PRISMA-ScR準拠）
documents.endpoints_ja: 環境影響、経済的含意、廃棄物管理、リサイクル実務、製造プロセス、マウスピース材料、SDGs 3/9/12/13との整合性
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 13件の研究が包含基準を満たした。透明マウスピース矯正はライフサイクル全体を通じてプラスチック廃棄物、マイクロプラスチック生成、温室効果ガス排出に寄与すると報告された。生分解性材料、直接3Dプリント技術（SDG-9）、リサイクルイニシアチブ（SDG 12）、サーキュラーエコノミーアプローチ（SDG 3 & 13）が潜在的策略として報告されたが、リサイクルインフラの不足、経済的制約、高品質エビデンスの不足により実施が制限されている。
documents.sample_size_ja: 13件の研究（スコーピングレビューの包含対象）

documents.title: Impact of reducing aligners' wear schedule from 7-days to 3-days on the predictability of tooth movement and treatment efficiency: a randomized controlled trial.
documents.abstract:
TRIAL DESIGN: This was a two-arm, parallel-group, single-blinded, single-center prospective randomized controlled trial conducted between October 2023 and March 2025.
PARTICIPANTS: Thirty-eight adults aged 18-30 years with Class I malocclusion and moderate-to-severe mandibular anterior crowding were included, recruited from a university orthodontic clinic. Forty-five participants were initially randomized; seven were excluded due to non-compliance.
INTERVENTIONS: Participants were randomly assigned to a 3-day aligner wear protocol with reduced activation (0.11 mm/1° per tray) or a conventional 7-day protocol (0.25 mm/2° per tray).
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the impact of reducing the aligner wear schedule from 7 days to 3 days on the predictability of linear and angular tooth movements for the mandibular incisors.
OUTCOME: The primary outcome was the deviation between predicted and achieved mandibular incisors' tooth movement following the first aligner series, assessed across three linear and three angular dimensions.
RANDOMIZATION: Participants were allocated using fixed block randomization with concealed sequentially numbered envelopes.
BLINDING: Outcome assessors were blinded to group allocation.
RESULTS: Linear deviations were comparable between groups and within the 0.5 mm ABO clinical threshold. Statistically significant angular deviations were observed for teeth 31 (p = 0.040) and 41 (p = 0.003), with additional significant buccolingual inclination for tooth 41 (p = 0.005); none exceeded the 2° clinical threshold. The 3-day group required significantly more refinement and clinical visits. No significant differences were observed in overall treatment duration or final occlusal outcomes. No adverse effects were reported.
CONCLUSIONS: While both protocols produced comparable occlusal outcomes, the 3-day protocol required more refinements and visits without improved predictability, suggesting wear duration plays a key role in aligner effectiveness.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov xxxx.
documents.authors: Brown Alexandra, Rifai Maya, Saadatmand Kiana, Zhong Kelin, Kuo Chia-Ling, Uribe Flavio, Dolce Calogero, Abu Arqub Sarah
documents.summary_ja: 2023年10月から2025年3月にかけて実施された、2群並行型・単盲検・単施設前向きランダム化比較試験。Class I不正咬合で下顎前歯部の中等度〜重度叢生を有する18〜30歳の成人38名を対象に、3日間装着プロトコル（1枚あたり0.11 mm/1°の低活性化）と従来の7日間プロトコル（1枚あたり0.25 mm/2°）を比較した。主評価項目は、最初のアライナーシリーズ後の下顎切歯の予測値と達成値の偏差（線形3次元・角度3次元）であった。線形偏差は両群で同等であり0.5 mmのABO臨床閾値以内であった。角度偏差は歯31（p=0.040）と歯41（p=0.003）で統計的に有意な差が認められたが、いずれも2°の臨床閾値を超えなかった。3日群は有意に多くのリファインメントと臨床訪問を要した。全治療期間や最終咬合結果には有意差は認められず、有害事象は報告されなかった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 3日間装着プロトコルは7日間の従来プロトコルと比較して、歯移動の予測精度（planned-vs-achieved偏差）の改善をもたらさず、むしろリファインメント回数と臨床訪問数を増加させた。最終咬合結果は両群で同等であった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 計画品質（planned-vs-achieved）：3日間の低活性化プロトコルは、線形・角度いずれの次元でも予測精度の向上を示さず、装着期間がアライナーの予測可能性に重要な役割を果たすことを示唆。リファインメント：3日群で有意に多くのリファインメントを要し、治療計画の初期設定精度やリファインメント頻度への影響が示された。ワークフロー：3日群で臨床訪問数が増加し、患者負担と診療効率への影響が実証された。
documents.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（前向き・2群並行型・単盲検・単施設）
documents.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：最初のアライナーシリーズ後の下顎切歯の予測値と達成値の偏差（線形3次元・角度3次元）。副次評価項目（結果から読み取れるもの）：リファインメント回数、臨床訪問数、全治療期間、最終咬合結果、有害事象。
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 線形偏差：両群で同等、0.5 mmのABO臨床閾値以内。角度偏差：歯31（p=0.040）、歯41（p=0.003）で有意差、歯41の頬舌傾斜（p=0.005）で有意差、いずれも2°の臨床閾値以内。リファインメント：3日群で有意に多。臨床訪問：3日群で有意に多。全治療期間：有意差なし。最終咬合結果：有意差なし。有害事象：報告なし。

documents.title: A Comparison of Clear Aligners and Fixed Appliances in Orthodontic-Surgical Treatment of Non-Extraction Skeletal Class III Malocclusion.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: This retrospective study assessed the outcomes of combined orthodontic-surgical treatment in skeletal Class III patients by comparing results achieved with clear aligners to those achieved with conventional fixed appliances.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This study involved 24 skeletal Class III malocclusion patients who were treated with non-extraction orthodontic using either fixed appliances or clear aligners (Invisalign), in conjunction with orthognathic surgery. All patients underwent mandibular surgery only. Lateral cephalometric radiographs were obtained and analysed for both groups at three stages: before orthodontic treatment (T0), one week before surgery (T1), and at least eight months after surgery (T2). All the statistical tests were performed in SPSS 30 and power calculations were done in G*Power.
RESULTS: In this pilot study, significant skeletal and dentoalveolar changes occurred in both groups (p < 0.001). Between-group comparisons showed that during presurgical decompensation (T1-T0), fixed appliances produced greater lower incisor proclination (IMPA) (p < 0.05, Cohen's d = -1.13 - 1.27). During postsurgical orthodontics (T2-T1), clear aligners resulted in less lower incisor labial tipping (L1-FH), less upper incisor intrusion (U1-PP), and less lower first molar intrusion (L6-MP) (p < 0.05, d = -1.03 - 1.1). At final follow-up (T2-T0), the clear aligner group continued to show less vertical intrusion of the lower incisor and first molar (L1-MP, L6-MP; p < 0.05, d = 1.11-1.17). After adjusting for genioplasty, clear aligners were associated with superior postsurgical vertical skeletal control, upper lip retraction, and facial convexity (p < 0.05).
CONCLUSION: Within this pilot study, clear aligners showed signals of greater treatment efficiency, less unwanted labial tipping, and reduced vertical intrusion, whereas fixed appliances showed greater incisor and molar decompensation. These hypothesis-generating findings indicate that treatment individualization by biomechanical needs and patient preferences should be tested in future powered trials.
LEVEL OF EVIDENCE III: This journal requires that authors assign a level of evidence to each article. For a full description of these Evidence-Based Medicine ratings, please refer to the Table of Contents or the online Instructions to Authors www.springer.com/00266 .
documents.authors: Zaw Thinzar, Min Hsu Yin, Wei Yi, Lyu Wei, Jiang Lihua, Li Xiujin, Wu Zhong, Huang Xuanping
documents.summary_ja: 骨格III類非抜歯症例における矯正外科併用治療において、クリアアライナー（Invisalign）と固定式矯正装置の効果を比較した後ろ向きパイロット研究。24例が下顎手術のみを併用し、側面頭部X線写真を用いてT0（矯正開始前）、T1（手術1週間前）、T2（術後8ヶ月以上）の3時点にて頭部計測分析を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナー群は術後矯正段階で下切歯の唇側傾斜（L1-FH）、上切歯圧入（U1-PP）、下第一大臼歯圧入（L6-MP）が少なく、最終フォローアップ時点でも下切歯および第一大臼歯の垂直方向圧入が少なかった。固定式装置群は術前デコンペンセーション段階で下切歯の唇側傾斜（IMPA）が有意に大きかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：矯正外科併用症例において、クリアアライナーは不要な唇側傾斜や垂直方向圧入を抑制し、術後の垂直骨格コントロール・上唇後退・顔面凸面において固定式装置より優位な結果を示した。治療効率の観点：結論部でクリアアライナーに治療効率の向上を示すシグナルが認められたと記載されている。治療計画の個別化（バイオメカニクス的必要性と患者嗜好に基づく選択）の根拠として有用。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き比較研究（パイロット研究）
documents.endpoints_ja: 術前デコンペンセーション（T1-T0）：下切歯唇側傾斜（IMPA）／術後矯正（T2-T1）：下切歯唇側傾斜（L1-FH）、上切歯圧入（U1-PP）、下第一大臼歯圧入（L6-MP）／最終フォローアップ（T2-T0）：下切歯垂直圧入（L1-MP）、下第一大臼歯垂直圧入（L6-MP）／ genioplasty補正後：術後垂直骨格コントロール、上唇後退、顔面凸面
documents.endpoint_results_ja: T1-T0：固定式装置群で下切歯唇側傾斜（IMPA）が有意に大（p < 0.05, Cohen's d = -1.13 ~ -1.27）。T2-T1：クリアアライナー群で下切歯唇側傾斜（L1-FH）、上切歯圧入（U1-PP）、下第一大臼歯圧入（L6-MP）が有意に小（p < 0.05, d = -1.03 ~ -1.1）。T2-T0：クリアアライナー群で下切歯・第一大臼歯の垂直圧入（L1-MP, L6-MP）が有意に小（p < 0.05, d = 1.11-1.17）。genioplasty補正後：クリアアライナー群で術後垂直骨格コントロール、上唇後退、顔面凸面が優位（p < 0.05）。
documents.sample_size_ja: 24例（骨格III類非抜歯症例、全例下顎手術のみ併用）

documents.title: The predictability of clear aligner treatment in space opening for permanent maxillary lateral incisors: An observational retrospective cohort study.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Space opening with clear aligner therapy has been little researched. The aim of this retrospective observational study was to investigate the predictability of the Invisalign appliance (Align Technology, San José, Calif) in opening space for the permanent maxillary lateral incisor (PMLI).
METHODS: Data from Align Technology's digital treatment planning software system, ClinCheck (Align Technology, San Jose, Calif), were evaluated to determine the initial, predicted, and achieved space opening for the PMLI in patients satisfying the selection criteria. Acquisition of the relevant measurement values was performed using the Geomagic (3D Systems, Rock Hill, SC) metrology system. A mixed-effects model was used to account for within-patient dependence among tooth spaces and the 2 one-sided tests for equivalence testing and Bland-Altman analysis were employed.
RESULTS: Space opening for 41 PMLIs in 25 patients with a mean age of 21.2 ± 13.0 years was evaluated. Approximately 65.2%-69.8% of predicted space opening was achieved, with the mean differences between predicted and achieved values ranging from 0.9 ± 1.0 mm to 1.4 ± 1.2 mm (P <0.05). For patients <18 years of age, the mean difference between predicted and achieved canine angulation changes was 9.4 ± 9.1°, with 95% limits of agreement from -8.4° to +27.2° (P = 0.015). Mean differences between predicted and achieved canine angulation changes in patients ≥18 years of age (5.3 ± 6.4°) and central incisor angulation changes in patients <18 years of age (-0.1 ± 8.0°) and ≥18 years of age (-4.8 ± 7.6°) were not statistically significant.
CONCLUSIONS: The findings can help clinicians better understand the planning of space opening for PMLIs before clear aligner therapy commences and provide baseline information for future research.

documents.summary_ja: 永久上顎側切歯（PMLI）のスペースオープニングにおけるInvisalign（Align Technology）の予測可能性を評価した後ろ向き観察コホート研究。ClinCheckデジタル治療計画ソフトウェアから初期・予測・達成値を取得し、Geomagic計測システムで測定値を算出。混合効果モデル、等価性検定、Bland-Altman解析を用いて予測値と達成値の差を評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: PMLIのスペースオープニングにおいて、予測値の約65.2%〜69.8%しか達成されておらず、予測値と達成値の平均差は0.9±1.0 mm〜1.4±1.2 mm（P<0.05）で統計的に有意な乖離が認められた。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：ClinCheckが予測するPMLIのスペースオープニング量が臨床で完全に達成されないことが定量的に示され、治療計画の精度評価およびリファインメント判断の根拠となる。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き観察コホート研究
documents.endpoints_ja: PMLIのスペースオープニング量（予測値 vs 達成値）、犬歯の角度変化（予測値 vs 達成値）、中切歯の角度変化（予測値 vs 達成値）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: PMLIスペースオープニング：予測値の約65.2%〜69.8%が達成、予測値と達成値の平均差は0.9±1.0 mm〜1.4±1.2 mm（P<0.05）。18歳未満の犬歯角度変化：平均差9.4±9.1°、95%一致限界-8.4°〜+27.2°（P=0.015）。18歳以上の犬歯角度変化：平均差5.3±6.4°（有意差なし）。18歳未満の中切歯角度変化：平均差-0.1±8.0°（有意差なし）。18歳以上の中切歯角度変化：平均差-4.8±7.6°（有意差なし）。
documents.sample_size_ja: 25例の患者における41本のPMLI（平均年齢21.2±13.0歳）

documents.title: Features of Aligners and Artificial Intelligence in Surgical-Orthodontic Protocol: A Narrative Communication.
documents.abstract: Background and Objectives: Dentofacial deformities require a multidisciplinary surgical-orthodontic protocol (SOP) in which orthodontic preparation, orthognathic surgery, postoperative finishing, and retention are closely coordinated to achieve stable functional and aesthetic outcomes. The increasing adoption of clear aligners, digital workflows, and artificial intelligence (AI) has profoundly modified this therapeutic pathway. This communication examines the role of clear-aligner therapy and AI throughout the contemporary surgical-orthodontic protocol, with particular emphasis on their integration into clinical practice. Discussion: From the surgical perspective, clear aligners provide treatment outcomes comparable to those achieved with conventional fixed appliances while offering greater predictability of treatment duration through digital treatment planning. However, their use requires careful management of specific clinical aspects, including surgical timing, intraoperative anchorage, postoperative dentoalveolar stabilisation, transverse dimension management, and retention, all of which demand close collaboration between the orthodontist and the maxillofacial surgeon. The communication also summarises current AI applications in orthodontics and orthognathic surgery, including automated cephalometric analysis, image segmentation, treatment-decision support, virtual patient construction, clear-aligner setup, soft-tissue prediction, refinement-risk assessment, and remote monitoring. Although AI has significantly improved the efficiency, reproducibility, and standardisation of diagnosis and treatment planning, current evidence supports its use as a clinician-supervised decision-support technology rather than as an autonomous system capable of managing the entire orthodontic-surgical pathway. Conclusions: The integration of clear aligners, digital planning, and AI represents an important step toward a more personalised and efficient workflow, while continued clinical validation and multidisciplinary expertise remain essential for achieving predictable long-term outcomes.
documents.authors: Varazzani Andrea, Brochet Louis, Prevost Alice, Graillon Nicolas, Bouletreau Pierre
documents.summary_ja: 外科矯正プロトコル（SOP）におけるマウスピース型矯正装置（クリアアライナー）と人工知能（AI）の役割を叙述的に考察した通信論文。外科的視点から、クリアアライナーは固定式装置と同等の治療成績を達成しつつ、デジタル治療計画により治療期間の予測可能性を向上させる一方、手術タイミング、術中アンカレッジ、術後歯槽安定化、横径管理、保定など歯科矯正医と顎顔面外科医の緊密な連携を要する臨床的側面の管理が求められる。また、AIの応用として自動頭部X線計測解析、画像セグメンテーション、治療判断支援、バーチャル患者構築、クリアアライナーセットアップ、軟組織予測、リファインメントリスク評価、リモートモニタリングを概説し、AIは自律システムではなく臨床医監督下の判断支援技術として位置づけるべきと結論している。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 外科矯正プロトコルにおいてクリアアライナーは固定式装置と同等の治療成績を達成し、デジタル治療計画により治療期間の予測可能性を高める。AIは診断・治療計画の効率性・再現性・標準化を向上させるが、臨床医監督下の判断支援技術として用いるべきであり、矯正外科経路全体を自律的に管理するシステムではない。
documents.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：デジタル治療計画により治療期間の予測可能性が向上する。planned-vs-achieved：クリアアライナーは固定式装置と同等の治療成績を達成する。リファインメント：リファインメントリスク評価がAI応用として言及されている。ワークフロー：クリアアライナー、デジタル計画、AIの統合によりより個別化かつ効率的なワークフローへの移行が示唆される。安全性：手術タイミング、術中アンカレッジ、術後歯槽安定化、横径管理、保定などの臨床的側面の慎重な管理が求められる。

documents.title: Micronuclei and cytomorphometric alterations in fixed (metal/ceramic) and removable orthodontic appliances: a prospective exploratory comparative study.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Orthodontic appliances may induce mechanical and biochemical stress on the oral mucosa, potentially leading to early cytological alterations.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate and compare the cytomorphometric parameters and micronuclei (MN) frequency in fixed metal, ceramic, and removable orthodontic appliances in adolescents at 1 and 6 weeks after appliance placement.
METHODS: This prospective exploratory comparative study was conducted on 30 adolescents divided into three groups: metal, ceramic, and removable orthodontic appliance (n = 10 each). Exfoliative cytology using Papanicolaou staining was performed at two experimental sites (S1, S2) and one non-contact intraoral comparison site (S3) at 1 week (T1) and 6 weeks (T2). No true pre-treatment baseline (T0) was available. Intergroup comparisons were made using Kruskal-Wallis, and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test was used for within-group comparisons.
RESULTS: Intergroup comparison showed no significant differences for cytoplasmic (C ) area and nuclear (N) area, and N: C ratio across most comparisons (p > 0.05) (p = 0.096-0.995; η² = 0.0003-0.16). A difference was noted only for MN frequency at the S1T1 (p = 0.04; η²=0.22). The principal findings were derived from intragroup T1-to-T2 comparisons. In the fixed metal appliance group, MN (p ≤ 0.028) and N: C ratio (p = 0.002) increased significantly across all sites(S1, S2, S3), with strong effect sizes. The ceramic appliance group showed limited, site-specific changes, with micronucleus frequency significantly increased at S1 (p = 0.014), while the N: C ratio (p = 0.037) and nuclear area (p = 0.002) showed significant changes at S3. The removable appliance group showed a significant increase in MN frequency, N:C ratio, and cytoplasmic area across selected sites, with strong effect sizes.
CONCLUSIONS: Within the limitations of this small exploratory study, early post-placement cytological alterations were observed in the oral mucosa during orthodontic treatment, particularly in MN frequency and N: C ratio. However, these findings should be interpreted cautiously due to lack of true pre-treatment baseline. Also, most intergroup comparisons were non-significant. MN frequency and N: C ratio may indicate promising research indicators of cytological alterations suggestive of cytogenetic stress, especially in the fixed metal and removable appliance groups. Nevertheless, there is need for larger longitudinal studies with true baseline assessment before stronger conclusions can be drawn.
documents.authors: Kapoor Priyanka, Chowdhry Aman, Shrivastava Priyanshu Kumar, Uppal Simran, Bhawal Ujjal K, Dave Aparna, Natarajan Srikant
documents.summary_ja: 固定式金属・セラミック・可撤式矯正装置の3群（各n=10、計30名の青少年）を対象に、装置装着後1週（T1）と6週（T2）における口腔粘膜の細胞形態計測パラメータ（細胞質面積、核面積、N:C比）および微小核（MN）頻度を比較した前向き探索的比較研究。Papanicolaou染色による剥離細胞診を2つの接触部位（S1, S2）と1つの非接触対照部位（S3）で実施。真の処置前ベースライン（T0）は得られていない。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 装置装着後早期に口腔粘膜の細胞学的変化（特にMN頻度とN:C比の増加）が観察されたが、固定式金属群と可撤式群で顕著であった。ただし真のベースライン欠如と小規模サンプルのため、結果は慎重に解釈すべきであり、より大規模な縦断研究が必要と結論されている。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：矯正装置の種類（金属・セラミック・可撤式）による口腔粘膜への細胞遺伝学的ストレスの差異が示唆されており、治療計画における装置選択時の安全性評価の参考情報となり得る。特に固定式金属装置と可撤式装置でMN頻度とN:C比の有意な増加が認められた点は、装置の生体適合性に関する安全性検討の文脈で関連する。

documents.endpoints_ja: 細胞形態計測パラメータ（細胞質面積、核面積、N:C比）および微小核（MN）頻度
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 群間比較：細胞質面積・核面積・N:C比に有意差なし（p > 0.05、p = 0.096-0.995、η² = 0.0003-0.16）。MN頻度はS1T1のみ有意差（p = 0.04、η² = 0.22）。群内T1→T2比較：固定式金属群でMN（p ≤ 0.028）とN:C比（p = 0.002）が全部位（S1, S2, S3）で有意増加。セラミック群でMN頻度がS1で有意増加（p = 0.014）、N:C比（p = 0.037）と核面積（p = 0.002）がS3で有意変化。可撤式群でMN頻度・N:C比・細胞質面積が選択部位で有意増加。

documents.title: A multivariable model for treatment duration in nonextraction clear aligner therapy.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: The objective of this study was to evaluate the associations between pretreatment dentoalveolar characteristics and treatment duration in nonextraction clear aligner therapy (CAT).
METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 296 patients treated with nonextraction CAT. Pretreatment variables were extracted from Invisalign ClinCheck (Align Technology, Santa Clara, Calif) digital treatment planning software and included deviations in overjet and overbite from a 3 mm reference, arch irregularities, midline deviation, and posterior crossbite. Treatment duration was defined as the time from initial aligner delivery to the completion of all refinement stages. Multivariable linear regression analysis was performed to evaluate the associations between pretreatment characteristics and treatment duration. Internal validation was performed using bootstrap resampling (5000 iterations).
RESULTS: The 11 pretreatment variables collectively explained 32.8% of the variability in treatment duration (R2 = 0.328; adjusted R2 = 0.302). Overbite showed the strongest association with treatment duration, followed by mandibular crowding, midline deviation, and posterior crossbite (P <0.001). Each 1 mm increase in overbite and overjet was associated with increases of approximately 41 and 15 days in treatment duration, respectively. The presence of posterior crossbite was associated with an approximately 89-day increase. Bootstrap analysis demonstrated the stability of the regression estimates.
CONCLUSIONS: Pretreatment dentoalveolar characteristics were significantly associated with treatment duration in nonextraction CAT. Although several baseline characteristics independently contributed to treatment duration, the model explained approximately one-third of its variability, highlighting the influence of biological, behavioral, and treatment-related factors beyond pretreatment records.

documents.summary_ja: 非抜歯型クリアアライナー治療（CAT）における治療期間と治療前の歯顎所見との関連を評価した後ろ向きコホート研究。Invisalign ClinCheckから治療前変数（オーバージェット・オーバーバイトの3mm基準からの偏差、アーチ不整、中线偏差、後方交叉咬合）を抽出し、多変量線形回帰分析を行った。治療期間は初回アライナー交付から全リファインメント段階完了までの期間として定義した。ブートストラップ再サンプリング（5000反復）による内部検証も実施した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 11の治療前変数は治療期間の変動の32.8%を説明した（R2=0.328）。オーバーバイトが最も強い関連を示し、次いで下顎叢生、中线偏差、後方交叉咬合が有意に関連した（P<0.001）。オーバーバイト1mm増加につき約41日、オーバージェット1mm増加につき約15日、後方交叉咬合の存在につき約89日の治療期間延長が関連した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療計画の品質とワークフローの観点から、治療前の歯顎所見が治療期間に与える影響を定量化しており、ClinCheck上のベースライン所見から治療期間の予測精度を向上させる可能性を示唆する。ただしモデルが変動の約1/3しか説明しないことから、生物学的・行動的・治療関連因子の影響も大きく、計画時の期間設定には注意が必要である。

documents.title: Demographic and clinical characteristics of patients who underwent clear aligner therapy: A multicenter cohort study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the demographic and clinical characteristics of patients who underwent clear aligner therapy in Korea.
METHODS: This retrospective descriptive multicenter study included 1,068 patients who completed Invisalign treatment under four orthodontists. The variables included age, sex, region, problem list, previous orthodontic treatment, aligner option, extraction pattern, treatment duration, refinement number, and change interval.
RESULTS: Females outnumbered males (65.2% vs. 34.8%, P < 0.001). Only 10.8% had a history of previous orthodontic treatment. Skeletal Class I and II malocclusions were more common than Class III (45.2% and 41.8% vs. 13.0%, respectively). The First option was mainly used in children under 10, while among patients aged 10-19 years, 88.5% received the Comprehensive option. Adults (≥ 20 years) were treated with either the Lite or Comprehensive option. Nonextraction treatment was more frequent than extraction (86.0% vs. 14.0%). All extraction cases used the Comprehensive option. In First cases, girls had a shorter total treatment duration than boys (19.7 months vs. 21.6 months, P < 0.05). However, no significant sex differences were observed in Lite, Comprehensive-nonextraction, or Comprehensive-extraction cases. In males, the proportion of cases requiring no or only one refinement was lower in Comprehensive-extraction cases than in Comprehensive-nonextraction cases (32.7% vs. 54.0%, P < 0.01). The change interval tended to be longer in Lite and Comprehensive-extraction cases compared to First and Comprehensive-nonextraction cases (12.0 and 10.3 days vs. 8.3 and 8.8 days).
CONCLUSIONS: Treatment duration, refinement number, and aligner change interval showed variations according to treatment groups. Further studies using initial malocclusion severity indices, treatment outcome indices, and compliance evaluations are needed.
documents.authors: Cho Keun-Chul, Park Hong-Sik, Choi Kwang-Hyo, Ji Hyeok, Ahn Hyo-Won, Baek Seung-Hak
documents.summary_ja: 韓国におけるInvisalign治療を完了した1,068例を対象とした後方視的記述的多施設コホート研究。年齢、性別、地域、問題リスト、過去の矯正治療歴、アライナーオプション、抜歯パターン、治療期間、リファインメント回数、交換間隔の変数を調査した。女性が多く（65.2% vs 34.8%）、非抜歯治療が86.0%を占めた。治療期間、リファインメント回数、アライナー交換間隔は治療グループによって変動した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: Invisalign治療の臨床特性はアライナーオプション（First/Lite/Comprehensive）と抜歯の有無によって治療期間・リファインメント回数・交換間隔が異なり、特に男性のComprehensive-extraction群ではリファインメント0〜1回で完了した割合がComprehensive-nonextraction群より有意に低かった（32.7% vs 54.0%）。
documents.why_matters_ja: リファインメント：男性のComprehensive-extraction群でリファインメント0〜1回で完了した割合がComprehensive-nonextraction群より有意に低く（32.7% vs 54.0%）、抜歯症例の計画精度やリファインメント頻度の観点で計画品質の改善余地を示唆する。ワークフロー：アライナー交換間隔がLite（12.0日）とComprehensive-extraction（10.3日）でFirst（8.3日）やComprehensive-nonextraction（8.8日）より長くなる傾向があり、治療グループに応じたワークフロー設計の参考となる。

documents.title: Impacts of clean-up visualization techniques on excess composite of orthodontic attachments.
documents.abstract:
PURPOSE: This study compared visualization methods for removing excess composite around ellipsoid and rectangular attachments used in clear aligner therapy (CAT).
METHODS: Ninety teeth were divided into three groups based on how they were assessed during cleaning: direct vision (group I), ultraviolet (UV) light (group II), and dental loupe (group III). Each group had two subgroups: rectangular (group A) and ellipsoid (group B) attachments. Excess composite was removed using tungsten carbide burs, and the clean-up duration was recorded. Surface deviations were evaluated by scan superimposition, and surface morphology was examined using scanning electron microscopy. Data were analyzed using parametric or nonparametric tests (p < 0.05).
RESULTS: Group IA showed significantly longer clean-up duration than groups IIA and IIIA (p < 0.001). Group IB also differed significantly from group IIB (p = 0.012). Group IIB demonstrated significantly lower residual composite values than the other groups.
CONCLUSION: Auxiliary visualization methods, particularly UV light, improved excess composite clean-up around orthodontic attachments and reduced chairside time. This may help clinicians optimize attachment bonding and enhance aligner fit.

documents.title: Tooth-level spatial distribution of AI-detected oral hygiene insufficiency in fixed appliance versus clear aligner patients: A large-scale analysis using the dental monitoring™ platform.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: To characterize the tooth-level spatial distribution of AI-detected oral hygiene insufficiency across the full dentition in patients undergoing fixed appliance (FA) and clear aligner therapy (CAT) using the Dental Monitoring (DM) remote monitoring platform at population scale.
METHODS: A retrospective analysis of 15,331,019 Dental Monitoring oral hygiene scan notifications from 40,748 orthodontic patients (9,940,299 CAT; 5,390,720 FA) was performed. Notifications were scored on a 0-2 ordinal scale; absent notifications were excluded. Hygiene scores were aggregated by appliance type, arch, region, tooth type, quadrant, and individual tooth. Mann-Whitney U (MWU) tests compared FA and CAT distributions; rank-biserial correlation (RBC) quantified effect size. Chi-square tests compared hygiene category frequency distributions between groups; Cramér's V quantified effect size.
RESULTS: FA patients exhibited significantly higher AI-detected hygiene insufficiency than CAT patients at every tooth, arch, tooth type, and quadrant (all P < 0.0001). Overall FA mean score was 0.85 ± 0.46 versus 0.55 ± 0.52 for CAT (mean difference = 0.30); effect sizes were small (RBC = 0.090-0.104), though patient-level analysis yielded a medium effect (RBC = 0.401). Within both groups, mandibular and anterior teeth demonstrated greater insufficiency than maxillary and posterior teeth. Canines and incisors carried the greatest burden across tooth types, with the mandibular right lateral incisor recording the highest FA mean (0.88). Near-bilateral symmetry was observed across all quadrant comparisons.
CONCLUSIONS: At unprecedented scale, AI-driven remote monitoring confirms that FA patients carry a substantially higher oral hygiene burden than CAT patients across the entire dentition. The spatial distribution of insufficiency, concentrated at mandibular and anterior teeth, identifies tooth-level targets for precision hygiene intervention during orthodontic treatment.

documents.summary_ja: Dental Monitoring（DM）リモートモニタリングプラットフォームを用い、固定装置（FA）とクリアアライナー（CAT）治療中の患者におけるAI検出された口腔衛生不十分の歯レベル空間分布を、全歯列にわたり大規模に特徴づけた後向き比較研究。15,331,019件のDM口腔衛生スキャン通知（40,748名、CAT 9,940,299件、FA 5,390,720件）を分析し、装置タイプ・アーク・領域・歯種・象限・個別歯ごとに集約して比較した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: FA患者はCAT患者と比較し、全歯・全アーク・全歯種・全象限においてAI検出された口腔衛生不十分が有意に高かった（全P < 0.0001）。不十分な分布は下顎歯および前歯に集中し、下顎右側側切歯がFAで最高平均値（0.88）を記録した。

documents.title: Assessing viscoelastic properties of clear aligners using a geometry-independent indentation method.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Clear aligners are widely used in digital orthodontics, but their clinical force delivery is governed by the time-dependent viscoelastic behavior of thermoplastic materials. Due to the thin-walled, curved, and geometrically irregular characteristics of clinical aligners, conventional tensile or bending tests and standard indentation analyses cannot reliably recover their intrinsic viscoelastic properties. Thus, the present study aimed to introduce and validate a geometry-independent indentation framework for characterizing the intrinsic viscoelastic response of clear aligners. In the present context, intrinsic viscoelastic properties refer to the reduced relaxation function and its characteristic relaxation spectrum after normalization removes time-independent geometric factors, rather than to the absolute instantaneous modulus.
METHODS: The proposed method was derived from dimensional analysis and the elastic-viscoelastic correspondence principle. Its validity was examined by finite element simulations of a clinically realistic aligner geometry. Indentation experiments were further conducted on raw thermoplastic films, thermoformed films, as-fabricated aligners, and intraorally used aligners to track the viscoelastic evolution of materials during manufacturing and clinical service.
RESULTS: Numerical simulations showed that the normalized creep and relaxation functions obtained from different aligner regions and indenter profiles agreed closely with the prescribed reference functions. Experimental measurements revealed pronounced differences between flat films and shaped aligners, together with position-dependent differences between two regions of the same appliance. These results show that the suggested method can suppress time-independent geometric contributions while retaining spatial variations in the local viscoelastic response.
SIGNIFICANCE: The suggested indentation method enables minimally destructive, direct characterization of the reduced viscoelastic behavior of intact clear aligners without geometry-specific inverse analysis. By separating time-independent geometric effects from the normalized time-dependent response, the method can also reveal position-dependent viscoelastic characteristics associated with local forming history and clinical wear.

documents.summary_ja: 本研究は、クリアアライナーの固有の粘弾性応答を特徴づけるための幾何学非依存インデンテーション手法を導入・検証した。次元解析と弾性-粘弾性対応原理から導出された手法を、臨床的に現実的なアライナー形状の有限要素シミュレーションで検証し、生熱可塑性フィルム、熱成形フィルム、製造済みアライナー、口腔内使用済みアライナーに対するインデンテーション実験により、製造過程および臨床使用における材料の粘弾性変化を追跡した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 提案手法は、時間非依存の幾何学的寄与を抑制しつつ、局所粘弾性応答の空間的変異を保持でき、完全なアライナーに対して非破壊的に減衰緩和関数と特徴的緩和スペクトルを直接特徴づけられる。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 臨床的な力伝達は熱可塑性材料の時間依存性粘弾性挙動によって支配されるため、本手法が位置依存性粘弾性特性（局所成形履歴および臨床摩耗に関連）を明らかにできることは、治療計画における力予測の精度向上に直接関連する。計画品質: 幾何学非依存の固有粘弾性パラメータをアライナー全体で直接取得できることは、デジタル矯正における材料モデルの精度向上に寄与する。

documents.title: Patient-Facing AI Chatbot Treatment-Direction Advice in Orthodontic Health Communication: A Scenario-Based Comparison with Expert Consensus.
documents.abstract: Background/Objectives: AI chatbots may shape patient expectations before professional consultation. This scenario-based first-response study evaluated whether four user-facing chatbots provided orthodontic treatment-direction advice concordant with an expert benchmark and whether responses contained safety, referral, or overconfidence concerns. Methods: Forty fictional Turkish patient-oriented scenarios across eight categories were independently coded by three orthodontists as clear aligners, fixed appliances, both options, examination required, or advanced specialist/surgical evaluation required. Each scenario was submitted once to ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, and Gemini on 20 May 2026. Two independent non-author orthodontists coded 160 archived first responses using a predefined framework, with adjudication before analysis. Results: Inter-expert agreement was moderate (Fleiss kappa = 0.491; Gwet AC1 = 0.528). Under the majority benchmark, exact concordance was 82.5% for ChatGPT, 67.5% for Claude, 42.5% for Copilot, and 37.5% for Gemini (Cochran Q = 34.105, p < 0.001). The overall difference remained significant in the 17 unanimous scenarios (Q = 11.455, p = 0.010), but a post hoc alternative-reference analysis that adopted the dissenting expert code in the 23 non-unanimous scenarios attenuated the rates to 57.5%, 52.5%, 52.5%, and 42.5%, respectively (Q = 4.222, p = 0.238). Coded safety-concern rates ranged from 15.0% to 62.5%. Conclusions: The sampled first responses differed in treatment direction and safety coding, but estimates were sensitive to the expert reference definition. Under the tested single-date, single-language, and single-run conditions, the findings represent a conditional snapshot rather than a time-invariant ranking of model capability. Patient-facing chatbots should support nondirective pre-consultation education and referral, not autonomous appliance selection.
documents.authors: Karaoğlan Neslihan, Karaoğlan Hakan
documents.summary_ja: 40の架空のトルコ語患者シナリオ（8カテゴリ）を3人の矯正歯科医が独立にコーディングし、ChatGPT、Claude、Copilot、Geminiの4つのAIチャットボットに各1回ずつ送信した。2人の非著者矯正歯科医が160件の初回応答を事前定義フレームワークでコーディングし、裁定後に分析した。専門家ベンチマークとの一致率と安全性・紹介・過信の懸念を評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 専門家多数決基準での完全一致率はChatGPT 82.5%、Claude 67.5%、Copilot 42.5%、Gemini 37.5%とモデル間で大きく異なり、Cochran Q = 34.105（p < 0.001）で有意差があった。ただし、23件の非一致シナリオで少数派コードを採用したpost hoc分析では差が縮小した（Q = 4.222, p = 0.238）。安全性懸念率は15.0%〜62.5%の範囲であった。著者は、患者向けチャットボットは非指示的な事前相談教育と紹介を支援すべきであり、自主的な装置選択を行うべきではないと結論づけた。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：コーディングされた安全性懸念率が15.0%〜62.5%と幅広く、患者向けAIが誤った治療方向を提示するリスクが示唆される。教育：著者は非指示的な事前相談教育と紹介を支援する役割を提言しており、Alignの患者教育ワークフローにおけるAI活用方針と関連する。ワークフロー：AIチャットボットが専門医の相談前に患者の期待を形成し得るという前提は、初診前の患者接点設計に影響する。

documents.title: Biomechanical effects of varying intrusion-to-retraction ratios on anterior tooth displacement during extraction space closure with clear aligners: an iterative finite element analysis.
documents.abstract: Using finite element analysis, the present work examined the three-dimensional biomechanical responses of anterior and posterior teeth to a range of intrusion-to-retraction ratios during anterior space closure with clear aligners after extraction of a maxillary first premolar. A three-dimensional model of a maxillary first premolar extraction case was built, comprising the upper dentition, periodontal ligament, aligner, and attachments. The intrusion-to-retraction ratio was altered in a stepwise manner to define seven groups (C0-R6), and movement was reproduced through an iterative simulation of alveolar bone remodeling. For anterior and posterior teeth alike, three-dimensional displacement, change in tooth angulation, and the torque-loss-per-posterior-displacement (TL/PD) ratio were quantified. As the ratio rose, anterior crown displacement generally shifted from extrusion toward intrusion. Compared with C0, the 1:1 intrusion-to-retraction ratio reduced crown extrusion by 59.5% in the central incisors and 81.4% in the lateral incisors while maintaining distal displacement of all anterior teeth. The central incisors shifted to mesial displacement in the R3, R5, and R6 groups, indicating reduced retraction efficiency, and began to tip labially at R5. In contrast, distal displacement was maintained in the lateral incisors up to R5 and the canines across all groups. In the posterior segment, mesial crown movement shifted to distal movement from R2 onward, although the associated vertical responses differed among the posterior teeth. Variability in the TL/PD ratio was greatest for the central incisors, whereas the lateral incisors and canines remained comparatively stable. Under the constraints of this finite element study, overly high intrusion-to-retraction ratios lowered retraction efficiency and produced labial tipping, chiefly in the central incisors. Among the evaluated conditions, a 1:1 ratio (the R2 group) showed a comparatively balanced combination of anterior vertical control and space-closure efficiency while maintaining distal displacement of all anterior teeth. This ratio may serve as a biomechanical reference for digital treatment planning during extraction space closure with clear aligners, although clinical validation is required before routine application.
documents.authors: Bae Chanho, Choi Youn-Kyung, Kim Sung-Hun, Kim Seong-Sik, Kim Yong-Il
documents.summary_ja: 上顎第一大臼歯抜歯後のクリアアライナーによる前歯部スペースクローズにおいて、イントラージョンとレトラクションの比率（7グループ：C0〜R6）を変化させた際の前後歯の三次元生体力学的応答を、歯槽骨リモデリングの反復シミュレーションを含む有限要素解析で評価した。1:1比率（R2グループ）が前歯部の垂直方向制御とスペースクローズ効率のバランスに優れ、全前歯の遠心移動を維持しつつ、中切歯の冠エクストルージョンを59.5%、側切歯を81.4%低減した。過剰に高い比率では中切歯のレトラクション効率低下と唇側チッピングが生じた。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナーによる抜歯スペースクローズのデジタル治療計画において、1:1のイントラージョン：レトラクション比率が前歯部の垂直制御とスペースクローズ効率のバランスに最も優れ、全前歯の遠心移動を維持できる生体力学的参考値として提示された。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療計画品質：デジタル治療計画におけるイントラージョン：レトラクション比率のパラメータ設定が、前歯部の実際の歯移動パターン（垂直方向制御、レトラクション効率、チッピングリスク）にどう影響するかを定量的に示しており、計画パラメータの最適化に直接関連する。planned-vs-achieved：有限要素解析により、計画された移動と生体力学的に実際に生じる移動の乖離を予測可能であり、特に過剰なイントラージョン比率が中切歯の近心移動反転や唇側チッピングを引き起こすことを示した。refinement：1:1比率を治療計画の生体力学的参考値として提案しており、計画の精緻化に資する。
documents.study_type_ja: 有限要素解析（計算シミュレーション研究）
documents.endpoints_ja: 三次元歯移動量、歯軸角変化、トルクロスパーポステリアルディスプレースメント（TL/PD）比
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 1:1比率（R2）はC0と比較して中切歯の冠エクストルージョンを59.5%、側切歯を81.4%低減し、全前歯の遠心移動を維持。中切歯はR3・R5・R6グループで近心移動に反転し、R5で唇側チッピング開始。側切歯はR5まで、犬歯は全グループで遠心移動を維持。後歯部ではR2以降に近心冠移動が遠心移動に反転。TL/PD比の変動は中切歯で最大、側切歯と犬歯は比較的安定。

documents.title: Cone beam computed tomography integration in clear aligner therapy in the treatment planning of Class II division 2 malocclusion.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the impact of cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) integration on clear aligner therapy (CAT) digital treatment planning for maxillary incisors in patients with Class II division 2 malocclusion.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Digital treatment plans were developed for patients using Spark Approver software (Ormco, Orange, CA, USA), with and without CBCT integration. Planned lingual root torque (LRT) and lingual root movement (LRM) were recorded from the tooth movement table for maxillary incisors that satisfied selection criteria. Predicted lingual dehiscence (PLD) and clinical parameters including number of aligners, prescribed interproximal reduction (IPR), and number of intermediate and challenging tooth movements were recorded. Inferential statistics were used to compare treatment plans developed with and without CBCT.
RESULTS: 56 maxillary incisors from 18 patients were assessed. With CBCT integration, planned LRT and LRM were significantly reduced by 51.5% and 42.4%, respectively. PLD per tooth significantly decreased from 3.7 mm (SD: 3.5) without CBCT, to 0.8 mm (SD: 1.3) with CBCT. Although no significant differences were observed in the number of aligners, prescribed IPR, or planned intermediate tooth movements, significantly fewer challenging movements were planned when CBCT was utilized.
CONCLUSIONS: CBCT integration into CAT digital treatment planning significantly alters planned root movements, minimizes PLD, and limits challenging tooth movements. Clinicians must carefully review digital treatment plans to identify and modify planned movements that may exceed anatomical limits to ensure alveolar boundaries are respected.
documents.authors: Boubaris Matthew, Freezer Simon, Meade Maurice
documents.summary_ja: Class II division 2不正咬合患者のmaxillary incisorsにおけるCBCT統合がclear aligner therapy (CAT)デジタル治療計画に与える影響を評価した研究。Spark Approverソフトウェアを用い、CBCT統合あり/なしでデジタル治療計画を作成し、計画された舌側ルートトルク(LRT)、舌側ルート移動(LRM)、予測される舌側デヒシセンス(PLD)、アライナー枚数、IPR量、中間的・困難な歯移動数を比較した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: CBCT統合により、計画されたLRTが51.5%、LRMが42.4%有意に減少し、PLDは3.7 mmから0.8 mmに有意に低下した。また、困難な歯移動の計画数が有意に減少した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：CBCT統合により計画されたルート移動が有意に減少し、解剖学的限界を考慮したより現実的な治療計画が作成可能になる。安全性：PLD（予測される舌側デヒシセンス）が有意に低下し、歯槽骨境界の侵害リスクを低減する可能性を示唆。結論部では、臨床医がデジタル治療計画を慎重にレビューし、解剖学的限界を超える計画移動を特定・修正する必要があると指摘。
documents.study_type_ja: CBCT統合あり/なしの比較研究（非ランダム化）
documents.endpoints_ja: 計画された舌側ルートトルク(LRT)、計画された舌側ルート移動(LRM)、予測される舌側デヒシセンス(PLD)、アライナー枚数、処方されたIPR量、中間的歯移動数、困難な歯移動数
documents.endpoint_results_ja: LRT: CBCT統合により51.5%有意に減少。LRM: CBCT統合により42.4%有意に減少。PLD: CBCTなし 3.7 mm (SD: 3.5) → CBCTあり 0.8 mm (SD: 1.3)、有意に減少。アライナー枚数、処方IPR量、中間的歯移動数：有意差なし。困難な歯移動数：CBCT統合により有意に減少。

documents.title: Pediatric mainstream clear-aligner early orthodontic orders in Guangdong public tertiary hospitals: service patterns, service-duration tiers and order conversion.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Early orthodontic assessment is increasingly recognized as part of child oral-health and dentofacial developmental care. Clear-aligner therapy has expanded from adult permanent-dentition treatment to selected mixed-dentition and adolescent indications, but real-world evidence on pediatric clear-aligner service delivery in public hospital settings remains limited. This study examined pediatric mainstream clear-aligner orders in Guangdong, China, focusing on annual service patterns, city-level distribution, service-duration tiers, clinician participation and manufacturer-observed order conversion.
METHODS: This retrospective observational real-world service study used de-identified operational order records from public tertiary hospital settings in Guangdong. Eligible records were restricted to commercially manufactured pediatric mainstream clear-aligner orders with one-year, two-year or six-year service-duration categories; no in-house aligners were included. These categories mainly target children approximately 6-13 years of age in late primary, mixed and early permanent dentitions and were treated as administrative service tiers rather than validated clinical severity grades. Order conversion was defined as a non-missing production-scheduling date. Descriptive analyses summarized service-duration tier, year, city, public hospital institution type and anonymized clinician-account participation. A multivariable logistic regression model with city-clustered robust standard errors estimated exploratory associations with conversion.
RESULTS: A total of 4,531 pediatric mainstream clear-aligner orders were submitted, and 3,994 progressed to production scheduling, yielding a crude conversion rate of 88.1%. The one-year, two-year and six-year categories accounted for 2,202, 2,048 and 281 orders, respectively, with conversion rates of 91.9%, 85.2% and 80.1%. By manufacturer-defined service-function positioning, the one-year and two-year categories were not positioned for extraction-including or molar-distalization pediatric workflows and accounted for most submitted and converted orders. A total of 362 anonymized clinician accounts submitted pediatric orders, and 346 had at least one converted pediatric order. Guangzhou and Shenzhen contributed the largest order volumes. Public stomatological hospitals had a higher crude conversion rate than Departments of Stomatology of public general hospitals (91.7% vs. 81.3%). Exploratory adjusted modeling suggested associations with service-duration category and institution type, but these findings were interpreted as service-process signals rather than clinical efficacy or treatment success.
CONCLUSIONS: Pediatric mainstream clear-aligner early orthodontic orders showed heterogeneity by year, service-duration tier, city, institution type and clinician-account participation. The findings describe administrative ordering and production-scheduling patterns within a defined public-hospital manufacturer channel and should not be interpreted as evidence of clinical effectiveness, patient benefit, population-level treatment coverage or unmet need. Future research should link verified patient-residence data, official child-population denominators and clinical diagnostic records to estimate population-adjusted utilization and need-service alignment.
documents.authors: Cheng Weiqi, Hou Le, Wang Yi
documents.summary_ja: 広東省の公立三級病院における小児向け主流クリアアライナー早期矯正オーダーの回顧的観察研究。4,531件のオーダーを対象に、年間サービスパターン、都市別分布、サービス期間階層（1年・2年・6年）、臨床医アカウントの参加状況、およびメーカー観測によるオーダー転換率を分析した。粗転換率は88.1%であり、1年・2年カテゴリ（抜歯・大臼歯遠心移動を想定しない）が大多数を占めた。公立口腔病院の転換率（91.7%）は公立総合病院の口腔科（81.3%）より高かった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 小児クリアアライナー早期矯正オーダーは、サービス期間階層・都市・施設タイプ・臨床医アカウントにより異質性を示す。1年・2年カテゴリ（抜歯・大臼歯遠心移動を想定しないポジショニング）が提出・転換オーダーの大部分を占め、小児市場は主に早期介入・モニタリング用途に集中していることを示唆する。施設タイプによる転換率の差（91.7% vs 81.3%）はワークフロー上の差異を反映している可能性がある。
documents.why_matters_ja: ワークフロー観点：オーダー提出から生産スケジューリングまでの転換率（88.1%）は、オーダー→生産パイプラインにおける離脱ポイントを特定する上で有用。サービス期間階層の分布（1年: 2,202件、2年: 2,048件、6年: 281件）は、どのサービス製品が利用されているかを示し、製品ポートフォリオの需要構造を把握できる。施設タイプによる転換率差（91.7% vs 81.3%）は、オーダー処理プロセスの標準化や教育介入の優先順位付けに参考となる。

documents.title: Selected clinical approaches for the treatment of classic Class II, division 1 malocclusion.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Class II, division 1 malocclusion is the most common sagittal discrepancy, marked by distal positioning of the lower teeth, upper incisor protrusion, maxillary constriction, and facial profile imbalance. Its multifactorial etiology-skeletal, dental, and functional - results in diverse clinical presentations and treatment approaches.
OBJECTIVE: This article aims to present a series of clinical approaches for the management of classic Class II, division 1 malocclusion, underlining how different treatment modalities -selected according to individual patient characteristics- can lead to effective outcomes.
CONSIDERATIONS: Treatment strategies for Class II, division 1 malocclusion include growth modification, headgear therapy, maxillary molar distalization with temporary anchorage devices (TADs), premolar extractions, clear aligner therapy, and orthodontic-surgical approaches for severe skeletal cases. Advances in biomechanics and skeletal anchorage have expanded non-extraction and less invasive options. However, careful case selection remains essential. Diagnosis must assess skeletal, dental, functional, and psychosocial factors, with treatment choices balancing esthetics, biomechanics, stability, and patient cooperation, customized to individual needs.
documents.authors: Tanaka Orlando Motohiro, Gasparello Gil Guilherme, Pithon Matheus Melo, Antelo Oscar Mario, Martins Renato Parsekian
documents.summary_ja: 本稿は、経典的Class II division 1不正咬合の管理における一連の臨床的アプローチを提示する。成長修正、ヘッドギヤー治療、TADを用いた上顎臼歯遠心移動、前歯部抜歯、クリアアライナー治療、重症骨格例における矯正外科的アプローチを含む。骨格・歯・機能・心理社会的因子を評価した個別化された治療選択の重要性を強調している。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: Class II div 1不正咬合の治療は、審美性・生体力学・安定性・患者協力度のバランスを考慮した個別化アプローチが不可欠であり、生体力学と骨格アンカリングの進歩により非抜歯・低侵襲な選択肢が拡大している。

documents.title: Does Thermoforming Setup Affect Thickness in Thermoplastic Orthodontic Appliances? A Comparison of Single vs. Dual-Model Fabrication.
documents.abstract: Thermoforming remains the predominant fabrication route for clear thermoplastic orthodontic appliances, yet it reduces and redistributes sheet thickness, which governs force delivered to teeth. Simultaneous thermoforming of two models may reduce fabrication time and material waste; however, its effect on final appliance thickness has not been evaluated. This in vitro study compared appliance thickness after thermoforming over a single model or two models simultaneously, using ten commercial aligner brands with different polymer composition and initial thickness. Thickness was measured with a digital caliper at anterior, canine and posterior sites, and analyzed using three-way ANOVA with Tukey post hoc tests. A significant three-way interaction (measurement point × number of models × brand; p < 0.001) was found. Significant single- versus dual-model differences emerged in some brand-region combinations; in most, dual-model appliances were thicker than single-model appliances. Four brands showed no significant difference at any site. Within the limits of this study, simultaneous fabrication of two appliances in a single thermoforming cycle produced appliances with thicknesses comparable to, and often slightly greater than, those fabricated over a single model. Simultaneous thermoforming maintained comparable appliance thickness and may improve manufacturing efficiency.

documents.title: Corticotomy-assisted rapid maxillary expansion and maxillary protraction therapy in late adolescence: Evaluation of 3-dimensional stereophotogrammetric soft-tissue, cephalometric, and 2-dimensional airway changes: A prospective controlled clinical trial.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: This study aimed to assess the short-term 3-dimensional (3D) stereophotogrammetric soft-tissue, cephalometric, and airway effects of corticotomy-assisted rapid maxillary expansion (RME) and facemask (FM) therapy in late-adolescent patients with Class III malocclusion.
METHODS: This prospective controlled clinical trial included 16 late-adolescent patients with Class III malocclusion (mean age, 14.90 ± 0.64 years) treated with corticotomy-assisted RME and Petit-type FM therapy and 16 untreated Class III controls (mean age, 14.03 ± 0.90 years). Lateral cephalograms and 3D stereophotogrammetric records were obtained at pretreatment and posttretment or at corresponding time points during the observation period. Paired t tests or Wilcoxon signed rank tests were used for within-group comparisons, and independent t tests or Mann-Whitney U tests were used for between-group comparisons (P <0.05).
RESULTS: In the corticotomy group, SNA (2.36°), A-Na perp (2.67 mm), ANB (4.08°), SN-GoGn (3.41°), and overjet (5.97 mm) increased, whereas SNB (-1.71°), Pg-Na perp (-2.61 mm), and IMPA (-4.32°) decreased. A 3D soft-tissue analysis revealed increases in ANB angle (2.50°), maxillary length (1.16 mm), mandibular height (2.94 mm), and nasal ala and alar base width (1.57 and 1.97 mm), whereas mandibular corpus length (-2.58 mm), facial convexity (-4.84°), and bigonial width (-3.94 mm) decreased. After treatment, bilateral Al showed lateral displacement along the horizontal (x) axis, whereas bilateral alare curvature and subnasale showed anterior displacement along the sagittal (z) axis, with nonsignificant 2.5 mm between-group difference observed at Pg. An approximately 1-mm increase in nasopharyngeal airway length was observed, but no significant between-group differences were found.
CONCLUSIONS: Despite reduced growth potential, corticotomy-assisted RME and FM therapy produced measurable short-term skeletal and 3D soft-tissue improvements in patients with true skeletal Class III malocclusion in late adolescence and may serve as an intermediate adjunctive option; however, long-term stability and randomized comparative data are required.

documents.title: Bioactive orthodontic adhesive for clear-aligner attachments: antibacterial activity, ion release, and bonding performance.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To formulate a novel dual-functional adhesive integrating dimethylaminododecyl methacrylate (DMADDM) for antibacterial activity and nano-amorphous calcium phosphate (NACP) for calcium/phosphate ion release, without compromising enamel bond strength.
METHODS: A low-shrinkage-stress resin of urethane dimethacrylate/triethylene glycol divinylbenzyl ether (UDMA/TEGDVBE, denoted UV) was used as the base resin. 10-methacryloyloxydecyl dihydrogen phosphate (MDP) was incorporated at 6% by weight to promote chemical bonding to enamel and stabilize the adhesive interface. DMADDM (0%, 3%, 6% by weight) and NACP (0%, 10%, 20% by weight) were incorporated. A commercial adhesive (Assure Plus) served as a control. Degree of conversion (DC), paste flowability, and enamel shear bond strength (SBS) were measured. Streptococcus mutans biofilms were analyzed for colony-forming units (CFU), lactic-acid production, and metabolic activity (MTT). Calcium and phosphate ion release were measured. Data were analyzed using ANOVA/Tukey (α = 0.05).
RESULTS: Experimental adhesives showed SBS (n = 12) of 15.2 MPa to 18.5 MPa, statistically similar to the control (p > 0.05). DC for the experimental formulations ranged from 48.8% to 65.2% versus 72.5% for the commercial control. Flow (n = 3) decreased with increasing NACP (p < 0.05). Adhesives containing 6% DMADDM reduced S. mutans biofilm CFU by approximately 2-log compared to the control and substantially reduced lactic acid production and metabolic activity of biofilms (p < 0.05). NACP formulations released Ca and PO₄ ions up to (1.55 ± 0.06) mmol/L and (1.0 ± 0.04) mmol/L, respectively, at 35 days and pH 4.
CONCLUSION: NACP formulations released Ca and PO₄ ions, demonstrating sustained ion release under acidic conditions. These in vitro findings support further investigation of bioactive adhesives for reducing biofilm-related risks around clear-aligner attachments. Direct enamel demineralization and remineralization testing is needed to evaluate their effect on white-spot lesion formation.
CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE: This in vitro study developed a bioactive orthodontic adhesive for clear-aligner attachments with antibacterial activity, calcium and phosphate ion release, and bonding performance comparable to a commercial adhesive. These findings support further investigation of bioactive adhesives for reducing biofilm-related risks around clear-aligner attachments.

documents.title: Clear Aligners and Patient-Specific Plates in Orthognathic Surgery for a Periodontally Compromised Patient.
documents.abstract: Orthognathic surgery in patients with severe dental and periodontal compromise represents a significant clinical challenge, particularly in the presence of a history of prolonged compensatory orthodontics and suboptimal initial diagnosis. This report presents the case of a patient with a class III dentofacial deformity, 3-dimensional maxillary deficiency, mandibular prognathism, multiple tooth loss, and advanced periodontal disease. Management included periodontal therapy, initial dental rehabilitation, and the use of clear aligners as an orthodontic alternative, given the limited potential for conventional decompensation. An early orthognathic surgery approach was selected after a short aligner phase, with the aim of correcting the skeletal discrepancy and facilitating subsequent dental movements. The surgical procedure was performed using fully customized osteosynthesis systems in the maxilla, mandible, and chin, along with specific surgical guides, allowing precise execution without the need for intermediate or final splints. Surgery was completed without complications, and postoperative evaluation demonstrated skeletal stability and absence of dental or periodontal deterioration. This case demonstrates that the combination of aligners and patient-specific plates represents an effective and predictable strategy for the management of complex dentofacial deformities, particularly in scenarios with biological limitations, optimizing functional outcomes and reducing risks associated with prolonged conventional treatments.

documents.summary_ja: 重度の歯・歯周疾患を伴うClass III歯顔貌変形、3次元的上顎不足、下顎前突、多数歯欠損、高度歯周病を有する患者の単一症例報告。従来のデコンペンセーションが困難なためクリアアライナーを矯正手段として使用し、短期間のアライナーフェーズ後に早期顎顔面外科手術を実施。上顎・下顎・顎先に完全カスタマイズされた骨固定システムと手術ガイドを用い、中間スプリントや最終スプリントなしで手術を完了した。

documents.title: Short-Term Effects of Anterior and Posterior Bite Blocks on the Electromyographic Activity of the Masticatory Muscles in Healthy Volunteers: An Analysis of Variability.
documents.abstract: Background/Objectives: Bite blocks (BBs) are commonly used in clear aligner therapy, yet their effect on masticatory muscle activity is poorly characterised. This study aims to examine the variability in the effects of anterior and posterior BBs on masticatory muscle activity in healthy participants. Methods: Twenty-four healthy adults were included in a crossover design comparing anterior and posterior BBs in removable passive aligners. Surface electromyography measured muscle activity at baseline, 24 h, 48 h and one week. Participants completed psychosocial questionnaires. Response patterns were identified via cluster analysis, and psychosocial differences were assessed with t-tests. Results: Anterior BBs immediately reduced muscle work intensity, with significant inter-individual variability (p = 0.030 at T1; p = 0.047 at T3). In contrast, posterior BBs altered muscle activity without significant variability over time (p > 0.05). Cluster analysis applied to anterior BB revealed two distinct adaptation patterns, which had significantly different Somatosensory Amplification Scale scores (p = 0.040). Conclusions: Within the limitations of the study, in the same participants, wearing passive aligners with anterior bite blocks significantly increased the inter-individual variability of muscular work intensity relative to the no-appliance baseline, whereas passive aligners with posterior bite blocks produced no significant change in variability.
documents.authors: D'Antò Vincenzo, Oliva Giorgio, Bucci Rosaria, Rongo Roberto, Valentino Ruggiero, Michelotti Ambrosina
documents.summary_ja: 24名の健常成人を対象に、前歯部バイトブロック（anterior BB）と後歯部バイトブロック（posterior BB）を装着した可撤式パッシブアライナーの咀嚼筋活動への影響の変動性をクロスオーバーデザインで比較した。表面筋電図（sEMG）をベースライン、24時間、48時間、1週間で測定し、心理社会的質問票も実施した。前歯部BBは筋作業強度を直ちに低下させ、個人間の変動性が有意であった（T1でp=0.030、T3でp=0.047）。一方、後歯部BBは筋活動を変化させたが、時間経過に伴う変動性の有意差は認められなかった（p>0.05）。前歯部BBに対するクラスター分析では2つの適応パターンが識別され、Somatosensory Amplification Scaleの得点に有意差が認められた（p=0.040）。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: パッシブアライナーに前歯部バイトブロックを装着すると、無装着ベースラインと比較して筋作業強度の個人間変動性が有意に増加する一方、後歯部バイトブロックでは変動性に有意な変化は生じない。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：バイトブロック装着による咀嚼筋活動の変化と個人間変動性の存在が示され、患者ごとに異なる筋応答が生じ得ることが示唆される。ワークフローの観点：クリアアライナー治療で頻用されるバイトブロックの装着による筋活動への影響が定量的に評価され、治療計画時の患者別リスク評価の参考となる。

documents.title: The effect of an indirect anchorage reinforcement device on maxillary anterior intrusion with clear aligners: a three-dimensional finite element analysis and exploratory clinical validation.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Anterior intrusion is commonly incorporated into clear aligner protocols to correct deep overbite and maintain overbite control during anterior retraction. However, anterior intrusion remains difficult to achieve predictably, potentially due to insufficient vertical anchorage of the posterior segment. This study proposed an indirect anchorage reinforcement (IAR) device to guide occlusal contact and indirectly reinforce posterior vertical anchorage, and evaluated its biomechanical effects and clinical performance.
METHODS: A two part study was conducted. First, three-dimensional finite element analysis simulated initial responses in anterior intrusion (Model A) and combined anterior intrusion and retraction with first premolar extraction (Model B). Each model included a Control and an IAR condition (A-Control, A-IAR, B-Control, B-IAR). A 0.2 mm activation was applied for intrusion, and Model B additionally included a 0.2 mm activation for retraction. A 200 g vertical load was applied to the IAR device to simulate occlusal contact. Outcomes included initial tooth displacement, sagittal axial inclination, the sagittal force-moment system, and aligner displacement and von Mises stress. Second, a matched exploratory clinical study with a historical control evaluated a maxillary anterior intrusion protocol. The planned total intrusion was 2 mm, delivered in 10 aligners at 0.2 mm per aligner, with no other programmed tooth movements during these steps. Aligners alone were compared with aligners incorporating the IAR device. Intrusion accuracy was quantified by three-dimensional model superimposition and calculated as achieved divided by planned intrusion. Propensity score overlap weighting and overlap-weighted regression were used to compare the groups.
RESULTS: In finite element simulations, the IAR design increased anterior intrusion and suppressed posterior extrusion, with smaller axial inclination changes and a reduced moment arm d, consistent with a resultant force acting closer to the center of resistance. Clinically, the IAR group achieved higher intrusion accuracy. In overlap-weighted analyses, the weighted mean difference (IAR minus control) was 18.96% points for incisors (95% confidence interval 9.01-28.91; P < 0.001) and 33.56% points for canines (95% confidence interval 24.65-42.46; P < 0.001). Intra-examiner reliability was good (intraclass correlation coefficient = 0.85).
CONCLUSION: Across both non-extraction and extraction scenarios, the IAR concept improved the achievement and predictability of anterior intrusion while suppressing extrusion of the posterior anchorage teeth, indicating improved vertical anchorage control. The exploratory clinical findings supported its clinical feasibility, with a more pronounced improvement in canine intrusion.
documents.authors: Yang Zexuan, Liu Qiong, Yang Zhijie, Hu Yirong, Kou Bingguo, Hui Yue, Lan Siyu, Gu Zexu
documents.summary_ja: 上顎前歯のイントラージョンにおいて後方セグメントの垂直アンカレッジ不足が予測可能性を低下させる問題に対し、咬合接触を誘導して後方垂直アンカレッジを間接的に強化するIAR（indirect anchorage reinforcement）デバイスを提案し、その生体力学的効果と臨床性能を評価した。第1部は3次元有限要素解析で、前歯イントラージョン単独（Model A）と第一小臼歯抜歯を伴うイントラージョン＋リトラクション（Model B）をControlとIAR条件で比較し、0.2 mmのアクティベーションと200 gの垂直荷重を適用した。第2部は歴史的対照を用いたマッチング探索的臨床研究で、計画総イントラージョン2 mmを10枚のアライナーで0.2 mm/枚として実施し、アライナー単独とIARデバイス併用を比較した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: IARデバイスは上顎前歯イントラージョンの達成率を有意に向上させ、後方アンカレッジ歯のエクストルージョンを抑制した。臨床では犬歯のイントラージョン精度改善が最も顕著であった（対照群比+33.56% points, P<0.001）。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: イントラージョン精度をachieved/plannedの比として定量化しており、治療計画の達成度評価に直接関連する。refinement: 既存のアライナープロトコルにIARデバイスを追加することで困難なイントラージョンの予測可能性を高める改良アプローチを示している。安全性: 後方アンカレッジ歯の意図しないエクストルージョンを抑制することで、アンカレッジ喪失という既知のリスクを軽減する。

documents.endpoints_ja: 有限要素解析: 初期歯移動量、矢状軸傾斜、矢状力-モーメント系、アライナー変位、von Mises応力。臨床: イントラージョン精度（achieved/planned比）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 有限要素解析: IAR条件で前歯イントラージョン増加、後方エクストルージョン抑制、軸傾斜変化の低減、モーメントアームdの短縮。臨床: overlap-weighted解析で、切歯の加重平均差（IAR−Control）は18.96% points（95% CI 9.01–28.91; P<0.001）、犬歯は33.56% points（95% CI 24.65–42.46; P<0.001）。検査者内信頼性 ICC=0.85。

documents.title: Evaluation of Oxidizable Substance Interaction Associated with Orthodontic Clear Aligners and an Acrylic Material: A Preliminary in vitro Study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to comparatively evaluate the interactions of oxidizable substances associated with different orthodontic aligner materials using potassium permanganate (KMnO4).
METHODS: In this study, materials from three different clear-aligner manufacturers (SmartTrack, ClearQuartz, and Scheu Dental CA Pro+) and one acrylic block were used. The materials were mechanically fragmented and exposed to KMnO4, a strong oxidizing agent. Potassium permanganate solutions were prepared at six concentrations (1.24 mM, 0.62 mM, 0.31 mM, 0.16 mM, 0.08 mM, 0.04 mM) to establish a calibration curve (R²=0.9999). Based on this calibration, 0.2 mM and 1 mM solutions were selected for the experimental phase. The color change was evaluated spectrophotometrically at 1, 4, and 24 hours to assess interactions with oxidizable substances.
RESULTS: The amount of oxidizable substances interacting with KMnO4 was estimated in mM. Oxidizable substances were detected in all samples (Acrylic Block 0.0723 mM, ClearQuartz 0.0826 mM, Scheu Dental CA Pro+ 0.0584 mM, SmartTrack 0.0271 mM); however, the estimated levels of oxidizable-substance interaction varied among samples. The highest level was observed in ClearQuartz at 24 hours.
CONCLUSION: Orthodontic aligner materials exhibit varying levels of interaction with oxidizable substances, particularly during the first 24 hours. The method may serve as a simple preliminary screening tool. Future studies should investigate the composition of the released substances using more sensitive analytical methods.
documents.authors: Kurnaz Merve, Biren Bora İsmail, Kayhan Ataberk, Biçim Gökhan, Biren Sibel, Güven Yegane
documents.summary_ja: 3社のクリアアライナー材料（SmartTrack、ClearQuartz、Scheu Dental CA Pro+）とアクリルブロックの酸化性物質との相互作用を、過マンガン酸カリウム（KMnO4）を用いて比較評価した予備的in vitro研究。材料を機械的に破砕し、0.2 mMおよび1 mMのKMnO4溶液に曝露し、1時間・4時間・24時間後に分光光度計で色変化を評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 全材料から酸化性物質が検出されたが、材料間で相互作用レベルに差が認められた。SmartTrackが最も低値（0.0271 mM）、ClearQuartzが24時間で最高値（0.0826 mM）を示した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点から、アライナー材料から遊離する酸化性物質の量に材料間で差があることを示しており、材料選択時の安全性評価の参考となる。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro研究（予備的）
documents.endpoints_ja: KMnO4と相互作用する酸化性物質の量（mM換算）、1時間・4時間・24時間後の分光光度計による評価
documents.endpoint_results_ja: Acrylic Block 0.0723 mM、ClearQuartz 0.0826 mM、Scheu Dental CA Pro+ 0.0584 mM、SmartTrack 0.0271 mM。最高値は24時間のClearQuartzで観察された。

documents.title: Biocompatibility of a novel directly printed orthodontic aligner at variable material thicknesses.
documents.abstract: Direct printed aligners (DPAs) represent a revolution in aligner orthodontics, enabling in-office fabrication of customized removable orthodontic appliances and precise, region-specific thickness modulation within a single aligner. Accordingly, this study assessed whether the manufacturer's standard 20-minute UV post-cure is adequate to ensure biocompatibility of DPAs made from LuxCreo DCA resin (LuxCreo Inc., Chicago, IL, USA) as appliance thickness increases up to 6 mm. Specimen discs (Ø 10 mm) of varying thickness (0.5, 1, 2, 4, and 6 mm) were 3D printed and post-processed according to the LuxAlign (LuxCreo Inc., Chicago, IL, USA) closed end-to-end workflow. Thickness was verified by digital caliper and biocompatibility was assessed using the AlamarBlue assay on human gingival fibroblasts. Printed specimens closely matched nominal dimensions and cell viability always remained above 70%, the ISO 10993-5 threshold for non-cytotoxicity. No significant differences were observed between the standard 0.5 mm and thicker groups (1-6 mm), indicating that increased thickness did not further impair biocompatibility. These findings demonstrate that the standardized LuxAlign workflow, including a 20-minute UV-curing, produces dimensionally accurate, non-cytotoxic appliances from LuxCreo DCA resin up to 6 mm thickness, supporting safe clinical use without extending post-curing.
documents.authors: Bleilöb Maximilian, Welte-Jzyk Claudia, Knode Vanessa, Ludwig Björn, Bulski Julia, Erbe Christina
documents.summary_ja: 直接印刷型マウスピース（DPA）の生体適合性を、材料厚さ（0.5、1、2、4、6 mm）を変えて評価した。LuxCreo DCA樹脂で3D印刷し、LuxAlignの標準ワークフロー（20分UV後硬化）に従って後処理した。AlamarBlueアッセイによるヒト歯肉線維芽細胞の細胞生存率を測定し、厚さ増加が生体適合性に与える影響を調べた。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 標準的な20分UV後硬化を含むLuxAlignワークフローは、最大6 mm厚まで寸法精度が高く非細胞毒性のマウスピースを製造でき、後硬化時間の延長なしに安全な臨床使用を支持する。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性（生体適合性）とワークフローの観点から重要。厚さ増加により生体適合性がさらに低下しないことを示し、標準的な後硬化プロトコルで十分であることを確認。地域別厚さ制御（region-specific thickness modulation）を伴うDPAの臨床導入における安全性の根拠となる。
documents.study_type_ja: 試験管内研究（in vitro）
documents.endpoints_ja: 細胞生存率（AlamarBlueアッセイ、ヒト歯肉線維芽細胞）、寸法精度（デジタルノギスによる厚さ測定）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 細胞生存率は常に70%以上（ISO 10993-5の非細胞毒性閾値）を維持。0.5 mm群と厚い群（1-6 mm）の間には有意差なし。印刷試料は公称寸法に近接。

documents.title: Orthodontic-related posts on Instagram: are they evidence based?
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To determine the prevalence of orthodontic-related evidence-based posts on Instagram. A secondary aim was to assess the quality of studies cited within these orthodontic-related posts.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A cross-sectional analysis of publicly available Instagram posts was conducted between April 1 and November 30, 2025. Posts were identified using eight orthodontic hashtags (#orthodontics, #orthobiomechanics, #damonbraces, #clearaligners, #invisalign, #tads, #airwayorthodontics, #myofunctionalorthodontics). The first 200 eligible posts per hashtag were included. Screening and data extraction of post characteristics was conducted in duplicate and independently. For posts citing evidence, the referenced articles were retrieved, and the study quality assessed. Descriptive statistics and frequency distributions were calculated.
RESULTS: From 1600 posts analyzed, the content type was predominantly treatment descriptions (710/1600) and marketing (618/1600), with 187 categorized as educational. Engagement was modest (median likes: 21). Critically, only 25 posts cited any scientific evidence. Among these, narrative reviews (6/25) and epidemiological studies (5/25) were the most frequently cited study types. Of the 23 citable articles retrieved, five were rated as high quality, nine moderate quality, and nine low quality.
CONCLUSIONS: This study confirms a lack of evidence-based orthodontic posts on Instagram. The small number of posts that cite scientific literature rely on moderate to low-quality studies. A coordinated effort among clinicians, professional societies, and online platforms is required to improve the credibility and quality of orthodontic information.
documents.authors: Hong Matthew Jun Xian, Abdulahad Andrew, Pandis Nikolaos, Cobourne Martyn T, Seehra Jadbinder
documents.summary_ja: 2025年4月1日から11月30日にかけて、8つの正畸関連ハッシュタグ（#orthodontics, #orthobiomechanics, #damonbraces, #clearaligners, #invisalign, #tads, #airwayorthodontics, #myofunctionalorthodontics）を用いてInstagram上の公開投稿を横断的に分析し、正畸関連のエビデンスベース投稿の頻度と、引用された研究の質を評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 1,600件の投稿のうち科学的エビデンスを引用したものはわずか25件であり、取得できた23件の引用文献のうち高品質は5件、中品質9件、低品質9件であった。Instagram上の正畸関連情報は概してエビデンスベースでない。
documents.why_matters_ja: 教育：#clearalignersや#invisalignを含む正畸関連ハッシュタグで流通する情報が低品質のエビデンスに依存している場合、患者や臨床医の治療判断に誤った影響を与える可能性がある。安全性：低品質の研究に基づく情報が広く共有されることは、治療のリスク・ベネフィットに関する誤解を招きうる。

documents.endpoints_ja: Instagram上の正畸関連エビデンスベース投稿の頻度；引用された研究の質
