documents.title: Effectiveness of using bite turbos on temporary implant crowns for intrusion in clear aligner therapy: a clinical retrospective study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This retrospective study aimed to evaluate whether aligner-incorporated bite turbos placed on implant-supported temporary crowns improve the predictability of maxillary molar intrusion during clear aligner treatment (CAT).
METHODS: 80 adult patients treated with clear aligners were included and divided into two groups: no-BT (n = 45) and bite turbo (BT) (n = 35). Digital models were superimposed using palatal rugae-based registration in OnyxCeph (Image Instruments, Chemnitz, Germany). Planned and achieved intrusion, lack of correction, and molar inclination were analyzed. Intra- and inter-examiner reliability were assessed using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC).
RESULTS: No statistically significant differences were observed between BT and control groups in planned intrusion (p = 0.184), lack of correction (p = 0.953), or achieved inclination (p = 0.137).
CONCLUSIONS: Within the limitations of this retrospective study, aligner-incorporated bite turbos on temporary prosthetic crowns did not significantly improve elongated maxillary molar intrusion during clear aligner therapy.
documents.authors: Jarmakienė Goda, Kirlys Robertas, Oliva Giorgio, Beil Anastasija, D'Antò Vincenzo, Gnusins Vitalijs
documents.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース治療（CAT）における上顎大臼歯の圧入の予測可能性を、インプラント支持の仮冠に装着したアライナー一体型バイトターボ（BT）が改善するかを評価した後ろ向き研究。80名の成人患者をBTなし群（n=45）とBT群（n=35）に分類し、OnyxCephにて口蓋リッジベースの登録でデジタルモデルを重ね合わせ、計画圧入量・達成圧入量・未修正量・大臼歯傾斜を解析した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 仮補綴冠にアライナー一体型バイトターボを装着しても、透明マウスピース治療における延長した上顎大臼歯の圧入を有意に改善しなかった。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved：計画圧入量と達成圧入量、未修正量を直接比較し、補助装置が計画と達成の乖離を縮小するかを評価している。refinement：特定の臨床介入（バイトターボ）が圧入の予測可能性を向上させるかというrefinementの観点に直接関連する。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き臨床研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 計画圧入量、達成圧入量、未修正量、大臼歯傾斜（達成傾斜）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: BT群と対照群の間で、計画圧入量（p=0.184）、未修正量（p=0.953）、達成傾斜（p=0.137）に統計的に有意な差は認められなかった。

documents.title: Evaluation of bonding of clear aligner attachments on aesthetic crown materials: a systematic review of in vitro studies.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: This study aims to assess the impact of various surface roughening treatments and bonding agents on aesthetic crown materials for the bonding of clear aligner attachments in orthodontic treatment. The primary objective is to assess their impact on shear bond strength, and the secondary objective is to assess their effect on surface roughness.
METHODS: This systematic review of literature (2015-2025) followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines. Data were collected from scientific articles investigating the impact of various surface roughening procedures on the bond strength and surface roughness for clear aligner attachments bonded to aesthetic crown materials. The articles were retrieved from three databases: Scopus, PubMed, and Web of Science. Risk of bias was assessed using the QUIN bias assessment tool for dental in vitro studies.
RESULTS: The results of the included articles were organised into tables in Word under the headings of author, country, material used, intervention(s), and results. The findings showed a positive increase in bond strength and surface roughness following surface treatments.
CONCLUSION: This systematic review concludes that etching with hydrofluoric acid for 1 min and bonding with Filtek Z350 composite resin result in relatively higher bond strength and surface roughness. These findings may assist orthodontists in enhancing the bond strength of clear aligner attachments to aesthetic crown materials, hence improving orthodontic tooth movement. No external or internal funding was received for this review. It is registered with PROSPERO under the registration ID CRD420251174624.
SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251174624, identifier CRD420251174624.
documents.authors: Kaur Armaan, Soans Crystal Runa, Ravi M S, Shilpa M
documents.summary_ja: 2015〜2025年のin vitro研究を対象に、審美冠材料へのクリアアライナーアタッチメント接着における各種表面粗造化処理と接着剤の影響を評価したPRISMA準拠の系統的レビュー。主目的はせん断接着強度、副目的は表面粗さの評価。Scopus、PubMed、Web of Scienceの3データベースから文献を収集し、QUINバイアス評価ツールを用いてリスク評価を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: フッ化水素酸1分エッチングとFiltek Z350コンポジットレジンによる接着が、審美冠材料に対して比較的高い接着強度と表面粗さを示した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 審美冠材料（セラミッククラウン等）は臨床で頻出する対象であり、アタッチメントのデボンドは計画された歯移動の達成を妨げ、治療期間の延長や計画と実績の乖離（planned-vs-achieved）に直結する。本レビューは接着プロトコルの最適化を通じて治療計画の信頼性を高める根拠を提供する。
documents.study_type_ja: 系統的レビュー（in vitro研究）
documents.endpoints_ja: 主評価項目：せん断接着強度（shear bond strength）。副評価項目：表面粗さ（surface roughness）。
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録には具体的な数値（MPa値、Ra値等）は記載されていない。定性的に「表面処理後に接着強度と表面粗さの正向的な増加が認められた」および「フッ化水素酸1分エッチング＋Filtek Z350接着が比較的高い接着強度と表面粗さを示した」とのみ記載。

documents.title: Mechanical properties of thermoplastic and 3-dimensional printed thermoset orthodontic aligner materials: An in vitro study.
documents.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Shape-memory polymers (SMPs) have been proposed for use in the direct printing of clear aligners. The purpose of this study is to evaluate and compare the mechanical properties of SMPs and thermoplastic materials.
METHODS: Samples of SMPs, Tera Harz Direct Aligner Clear (TC-85, Graphy Inc, Seoul, South Korea) and Dental Clear Aligner (DCA, LuxCreo Inc, Chicago, Ill), and a thermoplastic material, polyethylene terephthalate glycol (PET-G, Dentsply Sirona, Charlotte, NC), were fabricated, wet-conditioned, and tested for yield strength, ultimate tensile strength (UTS), stress and strain at failure, as well as stress relaxation and modulus relaxation. The SMPs underwent stress relaxation testing twice, with the second run (Run 2) conducted after shape recovery. Statistical analysis included 1-way analysis of variance followed by Tukey post-hoc analysis and independent t tests to determine significance (P <0.05).
RESULTS: PET-G exhibited the highest values for yield strength, UTS, strength at failure, and strain at failure, followed by DCA, and TC-85 had the lowest strength values (P <0.001). For stress relaxation, PET-G had the lowest values of stress loss and modulus loss (P <0.001), with a total stress loss of 23% and modulus loss of 38%. The stress loss of DCA and TC-85 was 83%-99%, and the modulus loss was 89%-99%. Both TC-85 and DCA had greater total stress and modulus loss at Run 2 than at Run 1.
CONCLUSIONS: There were significant differences in yield strength, UTS, and strength at failure, stress relaxation, and modulus relaxation for the materials. There was also a significant decrease in stress relaxation and modulus relaxation for SMP materials between Run 1 and Run 2.
documents.journal: American journal of orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics : official publication of the American Association of Orthodontists, its constituent societies, and the American Board of Orthodontics
documents.authors: Cook Bethany, Shirey Nicholas, Groth Christian, Aliaga Del Castillo Aron, Kim-Berman Hera
documents.summary_ja: 形状記憶ポリマー（SMP）のTera Harz Direct Aligner Clear（TC-85）とDental Clear Aligner（DCA）、および熱可塑性材料PET-Gの機械的性質（降伏強度、最大引張強度、破断時の応力・ひずみ、応力緩和、弾性率緩和）をin vitroで比較検討した研究。SMPは形状回復後に2回目の応力緩和試験も実施した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: PET-Gは降伏強度・UTS・破断強度・破断ひずみで最も高い値を示し、応力損失23%・弾性率損失38%と最も低い損失であった。一方、SMP（DCA・TC-85）は応力損失83-99%・弾性率損失89-99%と著しく高い損失を示し、形状回復後のRun 2ではRun 1よりさらに損失が増大した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 応力緩和・弾性率緩和の大きさは、アライナーが治療期間中に持続的に力を伝達できるか（planned-vs-achieved force delivery）に直接関連する。SMP材料の83-99%の応力損失は、治療計画で想定される力学的挙動と実際の力伝達に乖離が生じる可能性を示唆し、材料選定と治療計画の精度に影響しうる。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro比較研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 降伏強度、最大引張強度（UTS）、破断時の応力・ひずみ、応力緩和、弾性率緩和
documents.endpoint_results_ja: PET-Gが降伏強度・UTS・破断強度・破断ひずみで最高値（P<0.001）。応力損失：PET-G 23%、DCA・TC-85 83-99%（P<0.001）。弾性率損失：PET-G 38%、DCA・TC-85 89-99%（P<0.001）。TC-85・DCAともにRun 2でRun 1より総応力損失・弾性率損失が大きい。

documents.title: The effect of thermoforming foils' material and thickness on the physical properties of orthodontic clear aligners: an in vitro study.
documents.abstract: Selection of an appropriate thermoforming foils is a crucial step for fabrication of in-office aligners. The aim of this study was to evaluate the effect of different thermoforming material and thickness on the color and weight stability and elastic modulus of clear aligners. Thermoforming foils of five types and two thickness (0.7 and 1.0 mm) were selected. For each group, 12 specimens were prepared to be a standard clear aligner. Weight change, color stability and elastic modulus was measured before and after thermocycling. Data were analyzed using Kruskal-Wallis and Mann-Whitney tests. PETG aligners tended toward weight reduction, while TPU and multi-layer aligners tended toward weight gain. PETG (1.0 mm) specimens weight reduction was significant (P = 0.041). TPU (0.7 mm) specimens weight gain was significant (P = 0.002). PETG aligners had the highest color change (ΔE), while multi-layer aligners showed the least. The thicker foils (1.0 mm) had better color consistency than thinner foils (0.7 mm). PETG (1.0 mm) aligners had the highest elastic modulus while multi-layer aligners had the lowest. Thermocycling caused elastic modulus reduction in PETG and increase in TPU and multi-layer aligners. It was concluded that both the type of thermoforming material and its thickness affect weight change, color stability, and elastic modulus of clear aligners.
documents.authors: Salari Behzad, Hosseininasab Amirhossein, Esmailzadeh Shima
documents.summary_ja: 5種類のサーモフォームフィルム（PETG、TPU、多層構造など）と2種類の厚さ（0.7mm、1.0mm）を用いて、各群12個の標準クリアアライナー標本を製作し、サーモサイクリング前後の重量変化、色安定性（ΔE）、弾性率を測定したin vitro研究。PETGは重量減少傾向、TPUと多層構造は重量増加傾向を示した。PETGは最も大きな色変化（ΔE）を示し、多層構造が最小であった。厚いフィルム（1.0mm）は薄いフィルム（0.7mm）より色安定性に優れていた。PETG（1.0mm）が最も高い弾性率、多層構造が最も低い弾性率を示した。サーモサイクリングによりPETGの弾性率は低下し、TPUと多層構造では上昇した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: サーモフォームフィルムの素材種類と厚さの両方が、クリアアライナーの重量変化、色安定性、弾性率に影響を与える。
documents.why_matters_ja: 計画品質：素材選択がアライナーの物理的特性（弾性率、色安定性）を決定し、治療計画の遂行品質に直接関わる。安全性：サーモサイクリングによる弾性率の変化（PETGでは低下）は、口腔内での長期使用時の材料劣化リスクを示唆する。ワークフロー：in-officeアライナーの製造における素材選定基準の根拠となる。
documents.study_type_ja: in vitro研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 重量変化、色安定性（ΔE）、弾性率
documents.endpoint_results_ja: PETG（1.0mm）の重量減少は有意（P=0.041）。TPU（0.7mm）の重量増加は有意（P=0.002）。PETGが最も大きな色変化（ΔE）、多層構造が最小。厚いフィルム（1.0mm）は薄いフィルム（0.7mm）より色安定性に優れる。PETG（1.0mm）が最も高い弾性率、多層構造が最も低い弾性率。サーモサイクリングによりPETGの弾性率は低下、TPUと多層構造では上昇。

documents.title: From Polyethylene Terephthalate Glycol (PETG) to 3D-Printed Resins: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Clear Aligner Material Performance and Safety.
documents.abstract: Clear aligner therapy depends on polymeric materials that differ in stiffness, elasticity, force retention, surface stability, optical behavior, and biological safety. Polyethylene terephthalate glycol (PETG), thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), polyurethane (PU), copolyesters, multilayer polymers, polypropylene/polyethylene (PP/PE)-based materials, and three-dimensional (3D)-printed resins are increasingly used, but their comparative performance remains heterogeneous. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the mechanical performance, aging behavior, cytotoxicity, chemical release, microplastic release, and surface stability of orthodontic clear aligner materials. PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, Cochrane Library, Google Scholar, Embase, and ScienceDirect were searched for English-language full-text studies published from January 2000 through June 23, 2026. Eligible studies evaluated material-specific mechanical, optical, biological, chemical, surface, or clinically relevant outcomes. Findings were synthesized narratively, and exploratory random-effects quantitative syntheses were conducted when numerical outcomes were sufficiently compatible. Methodological quality was evaluated using the Quality Assessment Tool for In Vitro Studies (QUIN) for the 22 laboratory investigations and the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) critical appraisal checklist for quasi-experimental studies for the prospective clinical/laboratory investigation. The review was not prospectively registered. Twenty-three studies were included, of which 22 were predominantly in vitro laboratory investigations. PETG, TPU, polyurethane, copolyesters, multilayer polymers, PP/PE-based materials, and direct 3D-printed resins showed substantial variation in modulus, flexural performance, stress relaxation, force decay, aging response, and surface roughness. QUIN assessment classified 18 in-vitro studies as having a medium risk of bias and four as having a high risk of bias; no study met the threshold for low risk of bias. Frequent methodological limitations included absent sample-size calculations, incomplete sampling descriptions, limited reporting of randomization and blinding, and inadequate reporting of operator or assessor calibration. Cytotoxicity findings were generally favorable under standard laboratory conditions, although reduced cell viability occurred with selected materials, concentrated extracts, or prolonged exposure. Evidence regarding BPA was limited, while other chemical leachables and microplastic release remained emerging concerns. Several quantitative outcomes showed high or extreme heterogeneity. Current evidence does not establish a universally superior clear aligner material. Material behavior and safety appear dependent on polymer composition, manufacturing method, thickness, post-processing, aging, and testing conditions. Because the evidence was predominantly laboratory-based, frequently at medium or high risk of bias, and methodologically heterogeneous, pooled estimates should not be translated directly into clinical material-selection or wear-schedule recommendations. Standardized laboratory methods and prospective clinical validation are required.
documents.authors: Altawil Fadi M, Abuzanoona Roba I
documents.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース材料（PETG、TPU、PU、コポリエステル、多層ポリマー、PP/PE系、3Dプリントレジン）の機械的パフォーマンス、老化挙動、細胞毒性、化学物質溶出、マイクロプラスチック放出、表面安定性を評価したシステマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス。2000年1月から2026年6月23日までの英語論文を対象に7データベースを検索し、23研究（22研究がin vitro、1研究が前向き臨床/実験）を含む。QUIN評価では18研究が中等度バイアスリスク、4研究が高度バイアスリスクと分類され、低リスクの基準を満たす研究はなかった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 普遍的に優越した透明マウスピース材料は確立されていない。材料の挙動と安全性はポリマー組成、製造方法、厚さ、後処理、老化、試験条件に依存する。現在の証拠は主に実験室ベースであり、バイアスリスクが中等度〜高度で方法論的に異質であるため、統合推定値を臨床的な材料選択や装着スケジュールの推奨に直接転用すべきではない。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：細胞毒性は標準実験条件下で概ね良好であったが、特定の材料・濃縮抽出液・長時間曝露では細胞生存率の低下が報告された。BPAに関する証拠は限定的であり、他の化学物質溶出やマイクロプラスチック放出は新興の懸念事項。計画品質の基盤：材料の剛性・弾性・力保持・応力緩和は治療計画の精度と予測歯移動の根拠となるが、材料間で大きなばらつきが認められ、材料選択が計画品質に直接影響し得ることを示唆。
documents.study_type_ja: システマティックレビューおよびメタアナリシス
documents.endpoints_ja: 機械的パフォーマンス（弾性率、曲げ性能、応力緩和、力減衰）、老化挙動、細胞毒性、化学物質溶出（BPA、その他溶出性物質）、マイクロプラスチック放出、表面安定性（表面粗さ）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値は記載されていない。定性的な記述のみ：PETG、TPU、PU、コポリエステル、多層ポリマー、PP/PE系、3Dプリントレジン間で弾性率・曲げ性能・応力緩和・力減衰・老化応答・表面粗さに「substantial variation（大きなばらつき）」が認められた。細胞毒性は標準実験条件下で「概ね良好」であったが、特定の材料・濃縮抽出液・長時間曝露では細胞生存率の低下が報告された。BPAに関する証拠は限定的。複数の定量アウトカムで高度または極端な異質性が認められた。

documents.title: Clear aligner therapy for adult anterior open bite: a systematic review, descriptive evidence map, and certainty appraisal of reported dentoskeletal changes.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Clear aligner therapy is increasingly used for adult anterior open-bite correction, but the certainty of evidence, reported dentoskeletal changes, and clinical boundaries of this approach remain unclear. This systematic review aimed to summarize overbite change and descriptively map the dentoskeletal findings reported in the current clinical literature.
METHODS: This systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA. PubMed, EMBASE, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library were searched. Reference lists of included studies and relevant reviews were also checked, but no additional eligible records were identified. Eligible studies evaluated adult or predominantly adult cohorts with anterior open bite treated with clear aligners and reported overbite change or dentoskeletal outcomes. Risk of bias was assessed using ROBINS-I and RoB 2. Reported dentoskeletal findings were classified as direct, indirect, or insufficient evidence for mechanistic interpretation. Exploratory single-arm random-effects meta-analyses were performed when extractable completed-treatment data were available. Certainty of evidence was appraised using GRADE principles.
RESULTS: Ten clinical studies involving 421 aligner-treated participants were included. Most studies were retrospective and nonrandomized, and nine had serious overall risk of bias. The primary exploratory synthesis of five completed-treatment cohorts showed a pooled overbite increase of 3.07 mm, while an extended sensitivity analysis of seven studies yielded 2.89 mm. Heterogeneity was substantial. Reported dentoskeletal changes most commonly involved anterior dentoalveolar changes, variable posterior vertical change, and limited mandibular plane change. Most studies were not designed to test mechanisms directly; therefore, the dentoskeletal findings were interpreted cautiously. The certainty of evidence was very low.
CONCLUSIONS: Very low-certainty evidence suggests that selected adult anterior open-bite cases treated with clear aligners may show overbite improvement. However, the available evidence is insufficient to confirm predictable skeletal correction or to validate a single mechanism of bite closure. Future studies should use prospective comparative designs, standardized anterior open-bite phenotyping, direct component-level outcome assessment, blinded evaluation, and long-term retention endpoints.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: CRD420261376480.
documents.authors: Huang Xinqi, Lei Mengling, Liao Juntong, Huang Zhimao, Zhao Zhihe, Cen Xiao
documents.summary_ja: 成人前歯部オープンバイトに対するクリアアライナー治療のデントスケイシャル変化について、PRISMA準拠のシステマティックレビューを行った。PubMed、EMBASE、Scopus、Cochrane Libraryを検索し、ROBINS-IおよびRoB 2でバイアスリスクを評価、GRADE原則でエビデンスの確実性を評価した。10件の臨床研究（421名）が包含され、5件のcompleted-treatmentコホートに対する探索的メタ分析ではプールオーバーバイト増加3.07 mm、7件の拡張感度分析では2.89 mmであった。異質性は大きく、エビデンスの確実性は非常に低かった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 非常に低確実性のエビデンスでは、選択された成人前歯部オープンバイト症例でオーバーバイトの改善が示唆されるが、予測可能な骨格矯正を確認し、あるいは咬合閉鎖の単一メカニズムを検証するには現在のエビデンスは不十分である。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: オーバーバイト改善の確実性が非常に低く、治療計画で想定される咬合閉鎖の達成が予測可能であるとは言い難い。refinement: 結論で標準化された前歯部オープンバイトのフェノタイピング、コンポーネントレベルの直接アウトカム評価、盲検評価、長期保持エンドポイントの必要性が示されており、治療計画の精緻化に向けた方向性が示唆される。

documents.title: Personalized Pain Management in Orthodontic Treatment: A Narrative Review of Biological, Psychological, and Clinical Determinants.
documents.abstract: Orthodontic pain is a frequent and clinically relevant experience during treatment, particularly after separator placement, bonding, archwire insertion, appliance activation, and elastic use. Although pain is often transient, it may negatively affect comfort, cooperation, diet, oral hygiene, satisfaction, and adherence. Orthodontic pain is not determined solely by mechanical tooth movement; it reflects a complex interaction between inflammatory tissue responses, individual pain sensitivity, psychological status, previous dental experiences, appliance type, and procedure-related factors. This narrative review summarizes the biological, psychological, and clinical determinants of orthodontic pain and discusses current pharmacological and nonpharmacological pain management strategies. Based on the available evidence, a proposed conceptual framework for personalized orthodontic pain management is presented. This framework stratifies patients into low-, moderate-, and high-risk profiles according to biological sensitivity, anxiety, pain expectation, treatment stage, and clinical complexity. Low-risk patients may require reassurance and basic instructions, whereas moderate- and high-risk patients may benefit from closer follow-up, individualized education, short-term analgesic planning, and selected adjunctive strategies. This framework should be interpreted as a conceptual model rather than a validated clinical prediction tool. Future prospective studies are needed to validate practical risk assessment instruments and individualized pain control protocols in orthodontic patients.
documents.authors: Karaoglan Neslihan
documents.summary_ja: 矯正治療中の疼痛は、歯の機械的移動のみではなく、炎症性組織反応、個人差のある疼痛感受性、心理状態、過去の歯科経験、装置の種類、処置関連因子の複雑な相互作用によって決まる。本叙述的レビューは、矯正疼痛の生物学的・心理学的・臨床的決定因子を総括し、薬物療法および非薬物療法の疼痛管理戦略を議論した。さらに、生物学的感受性、不安、疼痛期待、治療段階、臨床的複雑性に基づいて患者を低リスク・中リスク・高リスクに層別化する個別化疼痛管理の概念フレームワークを提案した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 矯正疼痛は多因子であり、リスク層別化に基づく個別化疼痛管理の概念フレームワークが提案されたが、これは検証済み臨床予測ツールではなく、将来の前向き研究による実用的リスク評価ツールおよび個別化疼痛管理プロトコルの検証が必要である。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：疼痛が患者の快適性・協力度・口腔衛生・満足度・アドヒアランスに悪影響を与えることを指摘。教育：中・高リスク患者に対して個別化教育を推奨。ワークフロー：リスク層別に応じたフォローアップ頻度・鎮痛計画・補助戦略の異なる管理パスを提案し、治療計画段階でのリスク評価を組み込む可能性を示唆。

documents.title: Biomechanical analysis of retracting maxillary incisors using clear aligners with palatal mini-implants in extraction cases: a finite-element analysis.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: At present, the clinical orthodontic effects associated with the application of clear aligners to extraction cases featuring retraction of the anterior teeth remain a cause for concern. In the present study, the biomechanical effects of this strategy on the maxillary dentition, periodontal ligament, and clear aligners were analysed when palatal micro-implants were used in combination with different traction methods.
METHODS: Several models, including the maxillary dentition (without first premolars), maxilla, periodontal ligaments (PDLs), and aligners, were constructed and imported to finite element software. Four model groups were created: (1) G1 (pure aligner retraction force), (2) G2 (the combination of aligner retraction force with elastic force applied between the palatal mini-implant and the traction button), (3) G3 (the combination of aligner retraction force with elastic force applied between the palatal mini-implant and the precision cutting), and (4) G4 (the combination of aligner retraction force with passive ligation, i.e., rigid wire ligation between the mini-implant and the lingual button on the second premolar). The magnitude of the elastic traction force was increased from 100 g to 250 g, with a gradient increment of 50 g. Subsequently, finite element analysis was performed to simulate the biomechanical effects.
RESULTS: Compared with G1, the incisors in G2 exhibited a larger incisor retraction distance and better vertical control. Although incisor retraction in G3 was slightly lower than that in G2, this method demonstrated better control of anterior teeth torque and anchorage of the posterior teeth. In G4, there was a tendency for a slight increase in incisor retraction compared to G1, while vertical extrusion and lingual tipping of the incisors were the most severe. In G2 and G3, the magnitude of the palatal elastic retraction force within the range of 100 to 150 g was conducive to the retraction of incisors, torque and vertical control of anterior teeth.
CONCLUSIONS: The combination of aligner retraction force with an appropriate retraction force applied to palatal micro-implants was beneficial for improving the efficiency of incisor retraction, as well as enhancing both vertical control and torque control. However, appropriate overtreatment should be designed to ensure bodily retraction and reduce tipping movement.
documents.authors: Zhao Zixuan, Wang Zhiwei, Liang Lei, Liu Lu, Cao Yuan, Jin Fang
documents.summary_ja: 上顎前歯の抜歯例におけるマウスピース型矯正装置（クリアアライナー）と口蓋ミニインプラントを組み合わせた後退治療の生体力学的効果を、有限要素解析（FEA）で評価した研究。上顎歯列（第一小臼歯欠如）、上顎骨、歯根膜、アライナーのモデルを構築し、4群（G1: アライナー単独後退力、G2: アライナー＋ミニインプラントとトラクションボタンの間の弾性力、G3: アライナー＋ミニインプラントとprecision cuttingの間の弾性力、G4: アライナー＋ミニインプラントと第二小臼歯舌側ボタンの間のrigid wire ligation）を設定し、弾性牽引力を100gから250gまで50g間隔で変化させて解析を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: アライナー後退力に口蓋ミニインプラントを介した弾性後退力（100〜150g）を組み合わせることで、前歯後退効率、垂直方向制御、トルク制御がアライナー単独（G1）と比較して改善した。G2は後退距離と垂直制御が最も優れ、G3は前歯トルク制御と後方歯列のアンカレッジが優れていた。G4は後退距離の増加傾向はあるが、垂直方向の圧出と舌側チッピングが最も顕著であった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療計画の品質（planned-vs-achieved）の観点から、抜歯例におけるアライナー＋TAD後退の力学的設計（牽引力の大きさ、アタッチメントの種類、ligation方式）が後退距離・垂直制御・トルク制御に与える影響を定量的に示しており、治療計画時の力学設計判断の根拠となる。また、bodily retractionを確保するためのovertreatment設計の必要性が示唆されており、refinement戦略の立案に参考となる。
documents.study_type_ja: 有限要素解析（計算機シミュレーション研究）
documents.endpoints_ja: 前歯後退距離、垂直方向制御（圧出）、前歯トルク制御、舌側チッピング、後方歯列のアンカレッジ、歯根膜およびアライナーへの応力分布
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録には具体的な数値結果（mm、度、MPa等）は記載されていない。定性的な比較結果のみ記載：G2はG1より後退距離が大きい且つ垂直制御が良好、G3はG2より後退距離がやや小さいがトルク制御と後方アンカレッジが良好、G4はG1より後退距離の増加傾向があるが垂直圧出と舌側チッピングが最も顕著。弾性牽引力100〜150gの範囲が前歯後退・トルク・垂直制御に有利と報告。

documents.title: Root resorption in Class II malocclusion treatment with various methods.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: To determine the apical root resorption (ARR) associated with three different orthodontic treatment methods for Class II malocclusion.
METHODS: ARR of the upper and lower incisors was evaluated in patients treated with Forsus (FG; n = 20), headgear (CHG; n = 20), and fixed orthodontic appliances involving extraction of the upper first premolars (EG; n = 20). A total of 480 teeth were evaluated using panoramic radiographs obtained at T1 (after active treatment) and T2 (during retention). ARR was assessed using a scoring system ranging from 0 to 4. ANOVA, the Kruskal-Wallis test, and the chi-square test were used for statistical analysis.
RESULTS: ARR of the lower right lateral incisors in the FG was greater than that in the CHG at T1 (P = 0.031). In the EG, greater ARR was observed in the upper right lateral incisors at T1 (P = 0.037) and in the upper left central incisors at T2 (P = 0.038) compared with the FG. The resorption scores of the incisors did not change between T1 and T2 in any group, except for the lower left central incisors.
CONCLUSIONS: Correction of Class II malocclusions using Forsus, headgear, or extraction of the maxillary first premolars followed by fixed appliance treatment results in varying degrees of ARR after active treatment.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Retrospective observational study. This study evaluated data from the years 2015 to 2024.
documents.authors: Zortuk Fundagül Bilgiç, Küçük Eyüp Burak, Yeşildağ Çağrı
documents.summary_ja: Class II不正咬合の3つの矯正治療法（Forsus、ヘッドギア、上顎第一小臼歯抜歯後の固定矯正装置）に伴う根尖部歯根吸収（ARR）を評価した後ろ向き観察研究。上顎・下顎切歯のARRを、T1（能動治療後）とT2（保定中）の全景X線写真を用いて0〜4のスコアリングシステムで評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: Class II不正咬合の矯正治療法によりARRの程度が異なる。Forsus群はT1時点で下顎右側側切歯のARRがヘッドギア群より有意に大きく（P=0.031）、抜歯群はT1時点で上顎右側側切歯（P=0.037）およびT2時点で上顎左側中切歯（P=0.038）のARRがForsus群より有意に大きかった。T1とT2の間でARRスコアが変化しなかったのは下顎左側中切歯のみ。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：Class II不正咬合の異なる治療法（Forsus、ヘッドギア、抜歯＋固定装置）が歯根吸収リスクに与える影響が異なることを示しており、治療計画における安全性評価の参考となる。ただし、本研究はクリアアライナーではなく従来の矯正装置を対象としており、Alignの製品に直接関連するエビデンスではない。

documents.endpoint_results_ja: Forsus群のT1時点で下顎右側側切歯のARRがヘッドギア群より有意に大（P=0.031）。抜歯群はT1時点で上顎右側側切歯（P=0.037）、T2時点で上顎左側中切歯（P=0.038）のARRがForsus群より有意に大。T1とT2の間でARRスコアが変化しなかったのは下顎左側中切歯のみ。

documents.title: Assessment of biofilm resistance, degree of conversion, and mechanical properties of nanomodified 3D-printed orthodontic clear aligner (in-vitro study).
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Three-dimensional (3D)-printed orthodontic clear aligners represent a paradigm shift in malocclusion management; however, they remain susceptible to bacterial biofilm accumulation. Therefore, modification strategies that enhance resistance to biofilm accumulation without compromising mechanical performance are required. This study evaluated biofilm resistance, degree of conversion (DC%), flexural strength (FS), and surface microhardness (VHN) of commercially available 3D-printed clear aligner resin (CR) modified with nanozeolite (NZ) and chitosan nanoparticles (Chs NPs).
METHODS: A total of 432 3D-printed specimens were fabricated and allocated into six groups: Group I (control): CR; Group II: (CR + 0.25 wt% NZ); Group III: (CR + 0.5 wt% NZ); Group IV: (CR + 0.25 wt% Chs NPs); Group V: (CR + 0.5 wt% Chs NPs); and Group VI (hybrid): (CR + 0.25 wt% NZ + 0.25 wt% Chs NPs). Surface topography and chemical characterization were performed using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) for DC%. Biofilm resistance against Streptococcus mutans was assessed using a crystal violet assay by measuring optical density (OD) after 48-hour and 14-day incubation periods. FS and VHN were evaluated using a universal testing machine and a Vickers microhardness tester, respectively. All properties were evaluated before and after 14-day aging. Data were analyzed using two-way ANOVA and independent samples t-test with Bonferroni adjustment (α = 0.05).
RESULTS: Two-way ANOVA indicated that the interaction between nanoparticle content and aging significantly influenced the DC%, OD, FS, and VHN values (p < 0.001). The 0.25 wt% NZ group showed the lowest OD after 48 h, whereas the 0.5 wt% NZ group showed the lowest OD after 14 days. The hybrid group demonstrated the highest FS and VHN values before and after aging. DC% values remained comparable among most groups, except for the 0.5 wt% Chs NPs group, which exhibited significantly lower DC% values before aging. Overall, the 0.5 wt% NZ group demonstrated the most favorable balance between reduced biofilm biomass and mechanical performance.
CONCLUSIONS: Nanoparticle incorporation improves the functional properties of 3D-printed clear aligners. NZ-containing groups reduced Streptococcus mutans biofilm biomass while preserving acceptable mechanical performance, suggesting potential for development of biofilm-resistant aligner materials.
documents.authors: Elnaggar Amal I, Fahmy Amal E, Hanafi Nesrine F, Aboulgheit Salma
documents.summary_ja: 市販の3Dプリント用クリアアライナーレジンにナノゼオライト（NZ）およびキトサンナノ粒子（Chs NPs）を添加し、S. mutansに対するバイオフィルム抵抗性（OD）、重合度（DC%）、曲げ強さ（FS）、表面マイクロ硬さ（VHN）をin-vitroで評価した研究。432個の試作体を6群に割り当て、14日間の老化前後で各特性を測定した。0.5 wt% NZ群がバイオフィルム量減少と機械的物性のバランスにおいて最も良好な結果を示した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: ナノゼオライト（特に0.5 wt%）の添加により、3DプリントクリアアライナーのS. mutansバイオフィルム付着を低減しつつ、許容可能な機械的物性を維持できる可能性が示された。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：アライナー装着中のバイオフィルム蓄積は患者の口腔衛生リスクに関わるため、材料レベルでのバイオフィルム抵抗性向上は臨床的安全性に寄与し得る。また、機械的物性（FS、VHN）が老化後も維持されることは、アライナーが設計通りの力を伝達し続けるための材料要件に関わる。

documents.title: Predicting gingival embrasure risk after invisible orthodontics using multimodal data and machine learning.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To develop and validate a risk prediction model for gingival embrasures after clear aligner therapy using multimodal oral data.
METHODS: A retrospective study of 340 patients (December 2022-June 2025) was randomly divided into training (n = 238) and validation (n = 102) sets (7:3). Univariate analysis, multivariate logistic regression, and least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression were applied to identify independent risk factors. Three machine learning models - random forest (RF), logistic regression, and support vector machine - were constructed based on seven core variables. Model performance was assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), calibration curves, decision curve analysis, and Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) values for interpretability.
RESULTS: No significant baseline differences existed between sets (p > 0.05). Seven indicators were identified (p < 0.05). Multivariate analysis confirmed percentage of bleeding on probing-positive sites, interproximal alveolar bone height, and relative movement of adjacent teeth at target site as independent risk factors, while gingival thickness, proximal contact area, interdental papilla height, and buccal/lingual bone plate thickness were protective factors (p < 0.05). The RF model performed best: training AUC = 0.849 (95% CI: 0.786-0.912), validation AUC = 0.815 (95% CI: 0.720-0.910), with good calibration and net benefit. SHAP analysis highlighted gingival thickness and interproximal alveolar bone height as key predictors.
CONCLUSION: A risk prediction model for post-clear aligner gingival embrasures was successfully developed and validated using multimodal oral data, with RF as the optimal algorithm. The model exhibits good discrimination, calibration, and clinical utility, which can be used as an objective auxiliary tool for individualized risk prediction following clear aligner therapy and supplement traditional clinical empirical judgment.
documents.authors: Wang Haiyan, Shi Hanfei, Fan Liping, Sun Zhang, Xiu Xuelian, Yuan Hui
documents.summary_ja: 透明マウスピース矯正後の歯間乳頭欠損（gingival embrasure）リスクを予測するモデルを、マルチモーダル口腔データを用いて開発・検証した後方視的研究。340例を訓練セット（n=238）と検証セット（n=102）に7:3で分割し、単変量解析・多変量ロジスティック回帰・LASSO回帰で独立リスク因子を同定したのち、ランダムフォレスト（RF）・ロジスティック回帰・サポートベクターマシンの3モデルを構築し、AUC・較正曲線・意思決定曲線解析・SHAP値で性能を評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: RFモデルが最も高性能で、訓練AUC=0.849、検証AUC=0.815を達成。独立リスク因子としてプロービング時出血率（%BOP）、近接歯槽骨高、目標部位隣接歯の相対移動量が、保護因子として歯肉厚、近接接触面積、歯間乳頭高、頬側/舌側骨板厚が同定された。SHAP解析では歯肉厚と近接歯槽骨高が主要予測因子として示された。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：透明マウスピース矯正後の歯間乳頭欠損という治療関連リスクを事前に定量的に予測可能。計画品質：個別化リスク予測の客観的補助ツールとして、従来の臨床経験的判断を補完できると結論されている。ワークフロー：マルチモーダル口腔データ（%BOP、歯槽骨高、歯肉厚、接触面積、乳頭高、骨板厚、隣接歯移動量）を統合した予測モデルであり、治療計画段階でのリスク層別化に活用可能な枠組みを示している。

documents.title: Patient Facing AI Chatbots in Digital Orthodontic Education: A Comparative Evaluation of Understandability, Actionability, Quality, and Safety of Dietary Advice.
documents.abstract: Background/Objectives: Patient-facing artificial intelligence chatbots are increasingly used as informal digital health education tools. In orthodontics, eating and drinking advice may directly affect appliance integrity, oral hygiene, enamel demineralization, caries risk, and clear aligner use. This study compared the understandability, actionability, overall quality, and potential harmfulness of responses generated by free and paid versions of ChatGPT and Gemini to patient-oriented orthodontic dietary questions. Methods: This cross-sectional comparative observational study evaluated 160 responses generated from 40 Turkish patient-oriented orthodontic eating and drinking questions across five clinically relevant categories. Each question was submitted separately to ChatGPT free version, ChatGPT Plus, Gemini free version, and Gemini Pro on 1 May 2026, using newly opened independent chat sessions without prompt engineering, follow-up prompts, response regeneration, or manual editing. Responses were anonymized, randomly coded, and independently evaluated by two specialist dentists. PEMAT-P actionability was defined as the primary outcome. PEMAT-P understandability, Global Quality Score, and potentially harmful advice classification were secondary outcomes. Repeated-measures comparisons were performed using Friedman tests and Bonferroni-adjusted Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Results: PEMAT-P understandability was high across all groups, with median scores of 100.0 in every group. Significant group differences were found for understandability, actionability, and Global Quality Score. ChatGPT Plus achieved the highest actionability score and Global Quality Score and produced no responses classified as potentially harmful. Potentially harmful responses were identified in ChatGPT free version, Gemini free version, and Gemini Pro. For the primary outcome, PEMAT-P actionability, the overall group difference was statistically significant with a small effect size (χ2 = 20.527, p < 0.001, Kendall's W = 0.171), while the largest effect was observed for GQS with a moderate effect size (χ2 = 46.520, p < 0.001, Kendall's W = 0.388). Conclusions: All chatbot groups generated highly understandable responses; however, actionability, overall quality, and safety varied across systems. ChatGPT Plus showed the strongest overall performance under the specific interface, subscription, language, and date conditions tested; however, this finding should be interpreted as a time-specific benchmark rather than evidence that paid chatbot systems are intrinsically safer or more clinically reliable. Structured evaluation, transparent reporting, digital health equity considerations, and professional oversight remain necessary before AI-generated orthodontic dietary advice can be integrated into routine patient education.
documents.authors: Karaoğlan Neslihan, Karaoğlan Hakan
documents.summary_ja: ChatGPT（無料版・Plus）とGemini（無料版・Pro）の4つのAIチャットボットに対し、トルコ語の患者向け矯正歯科食事に関する40の質問を独立したセッションで送信し、160件の回答の理解可能性・実行可能性・全体品質・有害性を評価した横断比較観察研究。PEMAT-PとGlobal Quality Scoreを用い、2名の専門歯科医師が独立に評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 全チャットボット群でPEMAT-P理解可能性の中央値は100.0と高かったが、実行可能性・全体品質・安全性はシステム間で有意に異なり、ChatGPT Plusが最も高い実行可能性と全体品質スコアを示し、有害と分類された回答がゼロであった一方、ChatGPT無料版・Gemini無料版・Gemini Proでは有害と分類された回答が確認された。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性：AI生成の矯正歯科食事アドバイスにはシステム間で有害回答の有無が異なり、患者教育に統合する前に専門的監督が必要であることが示された。教育：患者向けデジタル教育ツールとしてのAIチャットボットの品質がプラットフォーム・料金プラン・時期によって変動するため、構造化評価と透明な報告が不可欠である。
documents.study_type_ja: 横断比較観察研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 主要アウトカム：PEMAT-P実行可能性。副次アウトカム：PEMAT-P理解可能性、Global Quality Score、有害アドバイス分類
documents.endpoint_results_ja: PEMAT-P理解可能性：全群で中央値100.0。PEMAT-P実行可能性：群間差有意（χ2 = 20.527, p < 0.001, Kendall's W = 0.171）。Global Quality Score：最大効果（χ2 = 46.520, p < 0.001, Kendall's W = 0.388）。ChatGPT Plus：最高実行可能性スコア・最高GQS・有害回答ゼロ。有害回答：ChatGPT無料版・Gemini無料版・Gemini Proで確認。

documents.title: Information completeness, sentiment, and engagement of orthodontic patient experience content on Chinese social media: a cross-sectional study.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Social media has become an important source of orthodontic information, yet patient experience content varies in completeness and may shape treatment expectations. This study evaluated information completeness, comment sentiment, and engagement patterns in orthodontic experience content on three major Chinese social media platforms.
METHODS: A cross-sectional sample of 180 eligible posts was collected from Bilibili, Douyin, and Xiaohongshu using two search terms, "orthodontic experience" and "braces diary." Information completeness was assessed using a modified 6-point Information Completeness Score (ICS). Comment sentiment and title sentiment were quantified using sentiment analysis scores (SAS). Engagement metrics, including likes, favorites, shares, and comments, were recorded. Platform differences and subgroup differences by appliance type, treatment population, video duration, and video age were analyzed.
RESULTS: Inter-rater reliability for total ICS was excellent (ICC (3,1) = 0.954). The automated SAS classifications showed strong agreement with the human consensus gold standard, with an overall accuracy of 91.6% (κ = 0.848). ICS differed significantly across platforms (H = 40.70, p < 0.001), with Bilibili showing the highest score (3.53 ± 1.46) and Xiaohongshu the lowest (1.78 ± 1.24). Treatment details and treatment duration were the most frequently mentioned dimensions, whereas clinician or institution credentials and cost were least frequently covered. Title sentiment showed a statistically significant but weak positive correlation with comment sentiment in the full sample (rho = 0.247, p < 0.001), with platform-specific variation. Engagement indicators were strongly intercorrelated (rho = 0.69-0.87), but ICS showed no meaningful correlation with engagement. Longer videos, clear aligner content, adult orthodontic content, and older videos had higher ICS, whereas SAS varied only slightly across groups.
CONCLUSIONS: Orthodontic patient experience content on Chinese social media shows substantial variation in information completeness. High engagement does not necessarily indicate high information quality. Professional orthodontic content should provide balanced information on treatment benefits, risks, costs, duration, and professional sources to support informed patient decision-making.
documents.authors: Jin Zehua, Zhang Jin'e, Zhang Zhijue, Xiong Xueyan, Zhang Fan
documents.summary_ja: 中国の3つの主要ソーシャルメディアプラットフォーム（Bilibili、Douyin、Xiaohongshu）から収集した180件の矯正治療体験投稿を対象に、情報完全性（ICS）、コメント感情（SAS）、エンゲージメント指標を横断的に評価した研究。ICSはプラットフォーム間で有意差があり、Bilibiliが最高（3.53±1.46）、Xiaohongshuが最低（1.78±1.24）。治療詳細と治療期間が最も頻繁に言及され、臨床医・機関の資格や費用は最も少なかった。エンゲージメント指標は相互に強く相関したが、ICSとエンゲージメントには有意な相関は認められなかった。クリアアライナー関連コンテンツ、成人矯正コンテンツ、長い動画、古い動画ほどICSが高かった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: ソーシャルメディア上の矯正治療体験コンテンツは情報完全性に大きなばらつきがあり、高エンゲージメントは必ずしも高品質な情報とは限らない。臨床医・機関の資格や費用に関する情報は最も不足しており、患者のインフォームド・コンセントを支援するためには治療の利益・リスク・費用・期間・専門的出所に関するバランスの取れた情報提供が求められる。
documents.why_matters_ja: 教育：臨床医・機関の資格や費用が最も頻繁に言及されない次元であり、結論では治療の利益・リスク・費用・期間・専門的出所に関するバランスの取れた情報提供がインフォームド・コンセントの支援に必要とされている。また、クリアアライナー関連コンテンツがICSの高いグループに含まれている点は、Align製品の患者教育コンテンツの質的向上が患者の意思決定支援に寄与しうることを示唆する。
documents.study_type_ja: 横断研究（cross-sectional study）
documents.endpoints_ja: 情報完全性スコア（ICS）、感情分析スコア（SAS：タイトル感情・コメント感情）、エンゲージメント指標（いいね、お気に入り、シェア、コメント数）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: ICSの評価者間信頼性：ICC(3,1)=0.954。SASの自動分類精度：91.6%（κ=0.848）。ICSのプラットフォーム間差：H=40.70, p<0.001。Bilibili ICS：3.53±1.46、Xiaohongshu ICS：1.78±1.24。タイトル感情とコメント感情の相関：rho=0.247, p<0.001。エンゲージメント指標間の相関：rho=0.69-0.87。ICSとエンゲージメントの相関：有意な相関なし。

documents.title: Adverse effects of removable orthodontic aligners: A systematic review with single-arm meta-analysis.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Removable orthodontic aligners are widely used due to their aesthetic appeal, removability, and perceived comfort. However, evidence regarding their potential adverse effects remains limited.
OBJECTIVE: To identify and synthesize the adverse effects associated with removable orthodontic aligner therapy.
METHODS: This systematic review with single-arm meta-analysis evaluated adverse effects related to removable orthodontic aligner therapy. Seven electronic databases (Cochrane, Embase, LILACS, Livivo, MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science) and gray literature sources (ProQuest Dissertations and Google Scholar) were searched without language or date restrictions. Two calibrated reviewers independently selected studies. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 for randomized trials and ROBINS-I for non-randomized studies. Due to clinical and methodological heterogeneity, most outcomes were synthesized narratively; meta-analyses were conducted only for pain/discomfort, apical root resorption, and plaque.
RESULTS: Thirty-four studies met the inclusion criteria, including 10 randomized controlled trials, 6 non-randomized clinical studies, and 18 cohort studies. Randomized trials were predominantly at low risk of bias, whereas most non-randomized and cohort studies were at moderate to high risk. Pain and apical root resorption were the most frequently reported adverse effects. Pain peaked within 24 hours, decreased by day 3, and was minimal by 1 week. Apical root resorption was generally small, with a mean linear loss of -0.33 mm (95% CI -0.55 to -0.11) and a volumetric loss of -4.37 mm³ (95% CI -5.51 to -3.24). Findings on plaque at 3 months were inconclusive. Other reported outcomes included periodontal changes, enamel demineralization, white spot lesions, speech alterations, halitosis, open gingival embrasures, temporomandibular symptoms, and awake bruxism.
CONCLUSION: Short-term pain and minor apical root resorption appear to be the most frequently reported adverse effects of removable orthodontic aligners, although the certainty of evidence varies across outcomes. Speech alterations, discomfort, and white spot lesions have also been reported.
documents.authors: Ronchi Lemos Cintia, Aguilar Ventura Fadel Marianella, Polmann Helena, de Oliveira Júlia Meller Dias, Pauletto Patrícia, Miron Stefani Cristine, Flores-Mir Carlos, De Luca Canto Graziela
documents.summary_ja: 取り外し可能な矯正アライナー治療に伴う有害事象を特定・統合することを目的としたシステマティックレビューと単一腕メタアナリシス。7つの電子データベースとグレー文献を検索し、34件の研究（RCT 10件、非ランダム化臨床研究6件、コホート研究18件）が包含基準を満たした。疼痛と根尖部歯根吸収が最も頻繁に報告された有害事象であり、疼痛は24時間以内にピーク、3日目で減少、1週間で最小となった。根尖部歯根吸収は一般的に軽度であった。プラーク（3ヶ月時）については結論が得られなかった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 取り外し可能な矯正アライナーの最も頻繁に報告される有害事象は短期的な疼痛と軽度の根尖部歯根吸収であり、証拠の確実性はアウトカムによって異なる。発音変化、不快感、白斑病変も報告されている。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点から、アライナー治療に伴う疼痛の時間経過（24時間ピーク→3日減少→1週最小）、根尖部歯根吸収の程度（平均線形損失-0.33 mm）、エナメル質脱灰・白斑病変・プラークなどの有害事象の頻度と程度を把握することは、治療計画時のリスクコミュニケーションや患者教育に直接関連する。
documents.study_type_ja: システマティックレビュー（単一腕メタアナリシス付き）
documents.endpoints_ja: 疼痛/不快感、根尖部歯根吸収、プラーク、歯周変化、エナメル質脱灰、白斑病変、発音変化、口臭、開放性歯間乳頭、顎関節症状、覚醒時歯ぎしり
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 根尖部歯根吸収：平均線形損失 -0.33 mm（95% CI -0.55 to -0.11）、体積損失 -4.37 mm³（95% CI -5.51 to -3.24）。疼痛は24時間以内にピーク、3日目で減少、1週間で最小。プラーク（3ヶ月時）は結論が得られなかった。

documents.title: Maxillary anterior retraction with clear aligner: a retrospective comparative cohort study of efficiency between periodontally healthy and stable periodontitis patients.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: This retrospective comparative cohort study aimed to evaluate the efficiency of maxillary anterior tooth retraction using clear aligners in patients with stable periodontitis compared to periodontally healthy individuals, addressing clinical concerns regarding the efficacy of aligner therapy in this population.
METHODS: This retrospective study included 33 patients with stable periodontitis (SP) and 33 periodontally healthy (PH) individuals who underwent clear aligner treatment. Pre-treatment virtual setups and post-treatment actual models were superimposed in three dimensions using Geomagic Wrap 2021 software. Anterior tooth retraction efficiency was calculated as (actual tooth movement / predicted tooth movement) × 100%. Univariate analyses were performed, followed by multivariable analyses using Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE) to identify predictors influencing efficiency.
RESULTS: No significant difference was detected in maxillary anterior retraction efficiency between the two groups (SP: 56.6%, PH: 52.0%, P = 0.245). However, the factors influencing efficiency differed significantly. In the SP group, efficiency was significantly correlated with treatment design parameters, including the number of aligner steps, amount of predicted tooth movement and auxiliary traction. In contrast, efficiency in the PH group was mainly associated with patient-related physiological factors, such as age and tooth type.
CONCLUSION: Within the limitations of this retrospective study (crown-level measurement), anterior tooth retraction efficiency with clear aligners did not differ significantly between patients with stable periodontitis and periodontally healthy individuals under strict periodontal maintenance. Clinical planning should be individualized: precise biomechanical design is essential for patients with stable periodontitis, whereas physiological factors warrant greater consideration in periodontally healthy patients. These findings support the feasibility of clear aligner therapy in well-maintained periodontitis patients and highlight the need for differentiated treatment planning.
documents.authors: Liu Xiaofang, Li Wewen, Li Dongna, Xu Ke, Zhang Liming, Liu Yang, Qi Xia, Liu Ye
documents.summary_ja: 安定型歯周炎患者（SP, n=33）と歯周健康者（PH, n=33）におけるクリアアライナーによる上顎前歯後退の効率を比較した後ろ向きコホート研究。治療前バーチャルセットアップと治療後実測モデルをGeomagic Wrap 2021で3次元重ね合わせし、効率を（実測歯移動量/予測歯移動量）×100%として算出。両群間で有意差は認められなかった（SP: 56.6%, PH: 52.0%, P=0.245）。ただし効率に影響する因子は異なり、SP群ではアライナーステップ数・予測歯移動量・補助牽引などの治療設計パラメータと有意相関し、PH群では年齢・歯種などの患者関連生理学的因子と主に関連した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 安定型歯周炎患者と歯周健康者でクリアアライナー前歯後退の効率は同等であるが、効率を左右する因子が異なる。SP群では治療設計パラメータ（ステップ数、予測移動量、補助牽引）が、PH群では生理学的因子（年齢、歯種）が主要な予測因子となる。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 効率をactual/predicted比として定量化し、両群で約52〜57%と計画達成率が中程度であることを示した。refinement: SP群ではアライナーステップ数・予測移動量・補助牽引が効率と有意相関しており、治療設計の精緻化（ステップ分割、補助装置の活用）が計画達成率向上に寄与し得ることを示唆。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き比較コホート研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 上顎前歯後退効率（実測歯移動量/予測歯移動量×100%）

documents.title: Photobiomodulation therapy for accelerating clear aligner tooth movement: A literature review.
documents.abstract: Clear aligner therapy (CAT) is widely used in adult orthodontic treatment, but prolonged treatment duration remains a major limitation. Photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) has been proposed as a noninvasive adjunct to accelerate tooth movement by modulating cellular activity and bone remodeling. This narrative review summarizes the literature on PBMT in orthodontic tooth movement, with particular attention to its application in CAT, effects on treatment efficiency, and safety considerations. Published clinical studies generally suggest that PBMT may be associated with faster alignment and shorter treatment duration. In one historical prospective study of 170 Invisalign patients, the crowding resolution rate was 0.33 mm/week in the PBMT group versus 0.21 mm/week in controls, with a 57.5-week reduction in treatment time. A retrospective study of 84 clear aligner patients found mean treatment durations of 528 ± 323 days with PBMT compared with 719 ± 220 days in controls, representing a 26.6% reduction. The reviewed literature also suggests that wavelengths in the 780 to 830 nm range are commonly used and that PBMT may increase tooth movement speed by approximately 24%, although findings remain heterogeneous across protocols. CBCT-based studies found no statistically significant difference in root volume change between PBMT and control groups. Overall, PBMT appears promising as an adjunct for accelerating tooth movement during CAT, particularly in adult patients treated with near-infrared protocols, although current evidence remains limited and heterogeneous. Safety data are reassuring but still limited. Further standardized randomized clinical trials are needed to define optimal dosing and confirm long-term clinical benefits and safety.
documents.authors: Bahrami Rashin, Pourhajibagher Maryam, Bahador Abbas
documents.summary_ja: クリアアライナー治療（CAT）における光生物学的刺激療法（PBMT）の応用に関するナラティブレビュー。PBMTが歯の移動を加速し、治療期間を短縮する可能性について、臨床研究の文献を総括し、治療効率・安全性・波長パラメータ（780〜830 nm）を整理している。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: PBMTはCAT中の歯の移動を加速し治療期間を短縮する可能性を示唆するが、現在のエビデンスは限定的かつ異質であり、最適な照射条件の確立には標準化されたランダム化比較試験が必要である。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療効率（治療期間の短縮）と安全性の観点から、CATの治療計画における期間予測の精度向上や、planned-vs-achievedの乖離を縮小する補完的介入として関連する。安全性データは安心感を与えるが依然限定的であり、臨床導入時のリスク評価に留意が必要。
documents.study_type_ja: ナラティブレビュー（文献レビュー）
documents.endpoints_ja: 叢生解決率（mm/週）、治療期間（日数・週数）、歯の移動速度増加率、根体体積変化（CBCT）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 叢生解決率：PBMT群 0.33 mm/週 vs 対照群 0.21 mm/週。治療期間の短縮：57.5週。平均治療期間：PBMT群 528 ± 323日 vs 対照群 719 ± 220日（26.6%短縮）。歯の移動速度増加：約24%。根体体積変化：PBMT群と対照群間に統計的に有意な差なし。
documents.sample_size_ja: レビュー自体のサンプルサイズは記載なし。引用された個別研究：前向き研究170例（Invisalign患者）、後向き研究84例（クリアアライナー患者）

documents.title: Fractal Analysis-Based Comparison of Mandibular Bone Remodeling in Clear Aligner and Fixed Orthodontic Therapies.
documents.abstract: Background: To quantitatively compare treatment-related changes in mandibular trabecular bone between patients undergoing clear aligner therapy (CAT) and fixed orthodontic treatment (FOT) by means of fractal dimension analysis of panoramic radiographs. Methods: This retrospective investigation evaluated 76 patients who underwent orthodontic treatment with either clear aligner therapy (CAT; n = 34) or fixed orthodontic treatment (FOT; n = 42). Fractal dimension analysis was performed on panoramic radiographs obtained before treatment (T0) and after treatment completion (T1). Fractal dimension (FD) values were calculated for the mandibular molar, angulus, and condylar regions using ImageJ software based on the box-counting algorithm. Changes in FD were compared within and between groups using appropriate statistical tests, with statistical significance established at p < 0.05. Results: No statistically significant differences were observed between CAT and FOT groups regarding FD changes in the mandibular molar and angulus regions at T0 or T1 (p > 0.05). Within-group comparisons also revealed no significant FD changes in these regions following treatment in either group. In the condylar region, although FD values demonstrated a tendency toward change after treatment, intra-group differences were not statistically significant (p > 0.05). However, inter-group comparison revealed a statistically significant difference between CAT and FOT groups in condylar FD values (p ≤ 0.05), without evidence of destructive bone remodeling. Conclusions: CAT and FOT induce comparable adaptive responses in mandibular trabecular bone structure. FA findings suggest that both treatment modalities induce comparable adaptive remodeling patterns in mandibular trabecular bone without radiographic evidence of destructive bone changes, supporting the view that CAT could be considered a comparable alternative to FOT with respect to mandibular trabecular bone remodeling when appropriate patient selection and controlled force application are ensured.
documents.authors: Sari Ömer Faruk, Büyükçavuş Muhammed Hilmi, Albayrak Elif, İncebeyaz Burak
documents.summary_ja: CT（CAT）と固定式矯正治療（FOT）における下顎海綿骨の治療関連変化を、パノラマX線写真のフラクタル次元解析を用いて定量的に比較した後ろ向き研究。76例（CAT群34例、FOT群42例）を対象に、治療前（T0）と治療完了後（T1）のパノラマX線写真から下顎大臼歯部、角部、関節頭部のフラクタル次元（FD）値をImageJのボックスカウント法で算出し、群間・群内比較を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: CATとFOTは下顎海綿骨構造に同程度の適応性応答を引き起こし、破壊的な骨変化の画像所見は認められなかった。適切な患者選択と制御された力学的応用が確保される限り、CATはFOTと比較可能な代替手段となり得る。
documents.why_matters_ja: 安全性の観点：CATはFOTと比較して破壊的な骨リモデリングを引き起こさないことを示し、CAT治療の生物学的安全性を支持する。治療法比較の観点：CATとFOTの骨リモデリングパターンが同等であることを示し、CATの臨床的正当性を裏付ける。
documents.study_type_ja: 後ろ向き研究（retrospective investigation）
documents.endpoints_ja: パノラマX線写真における下顎大臼歯部、角部、関節頭部のフラクタル次元（FD）値の変化（T0 vs T1）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 下顎大臼歯部：T0・T1いずれにおいてもCAT群とFOT群間に有意差なし（p > 0.05）、群内比較でも有意なFD変化なし。角部：T0・T1いずれにおいてもCAT群とFOT群間に有意差なし（p > 0.05）、群内比較でも有意なFD変化なし。関節頭部：群内比較では有意差なし（p > 0.05）だが、群間比較ではCAT群とFOT群間に統計的に有意な差を認めた（p ≤ 0.05）。破壊的な骨リモデリングの所見は認められなかった。

documents.title: Functionalization of a Shape-Memory 3D-Printed Clear Aligner Resin with Silanized Chitosan Nanoparticles: Antibacterial, Optical, Polymerization, and Mechanical Evaluation.
documents.abstract: Directly 3D-printed clear aligners are increasingly adopted for orthodontic treatment, but lack intrinsic antibacterial properties. This study investigates the integration of silanized chitosan nanoparticles (CSNPs) into 3D-printed clear aligner resin to improve antibacterial activity while preserving optical, polymerization, and mechanical performance. Commercial CSNPs were surface modified with 3-(trimethoxysilyl)propyl methacrylate and characterized using FTIR, UV-Vis, TEM, EDS, XRD, DLS and zeta-potential analysis. The silanized CSNPs were incorporated into TA-28 clear aligner resin at 0.01, 0.05, and 0.1 wt%. Antibacterial activity against Streptococcus mutans (S. mutans) and Porphyromonas gingivalis (P. gingivalis) was assessed using bacterial adherence and biofilm assay. Transparency, degree of conversion, tensile and flexural properties were evaluated. Successful silanization was confirmed by characterization analyses. The incorporation of silanized CSNPs reduced bacterial adherence and biofilm formation significantly in comparison with the control group (p < 0.001). The transparency was maintained at 0.01 and 0.05 wt% but reduced significantly at 0.1 wt% (p < 0.001). While all nano-modified groups had a lower DC% than the control group, values remained above 75%. Mechanical performance showed improvements, particularly in stiffness and flexural properties, following nanoparticle incorporation. Among the tested concentrations, the 0.05 wt% CSNPs provided the most favorable overall performance, highlighting their potential for the development of next-generation bioactive clear aligners.
documents.authors: Azeez Saya Mustafa, Mudhir Anees Mahmood
documents.summary_ja: 3Dプリント型マウス（クリアアライナー）レジンにシラニル化キトサンナノ粒子（CSNPs）を0.01、0.05、0.1 wt%で添加し、抗菌活性の向上と光学特性・重合度・機械的特性の維持を評価した。Streptococcus mutansおよびPorphyromonas gingivalisに対する細菌付着・バイオフィルム形成を指標に抗菌活性を評価し、透明度、重合度（DC%）、引張・曲げ特性を測定した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 0.05 wt%のシラニル化CSNPs添加が、抗菌活性の有意な向上（p < 0.001）と透明度・機械的特性の維持を同時に実現し、次世代バイオアクティブクリアアライナー開発において最も好ましい総合性能を示した。
documents.why_matters_ja: 3Dプリントアライナーの材料品質と安全性の観点から、抗菌機能の付与が光学特性・重合度・機械的特性を損なわずに可能であることが示された。特に0.05 wt%でDC%が75%以上を維持しつつ抗菌効果が得られることは、アライナーの成形品質と患者安全性の両立に寄与する。
documents.study_type_ja: 材料評価（in vitro）研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 細菌付着量、バイオフィルム形成量（S. mutans、P. gingivalis）、透明度、重合度（DC%）、引張特性、曲げ特性
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 細菌付着・バイオフィルム形成：対照群と比較して有意に減少（p < 0.001）。透明度：0.01および0.05 wt%では維持、0.1 wt%では有意に低下（p < 0.001）。DC%：全ナノ改質群で対照群より低値だが75%以上を維持。機械的特性：剛性及び曲げ特性が改善。

documents.title: The Impact of Malocclusion Severity on the Number of Prescribed, Used Aligners and Treatment Duration; A Retrospective, Singe-Centre, Cohort Study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To assess the impact of baseline malocclusion severity on the number of prescribed, used aligners and treatment duration.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: An unrestricted, independent search was conducted on the Invisalign ClinCheck database of a private practice for patients without any missing anterior teeth and whose treatment was finished between April 2021 and December 2024. Descriptive statistics were generated, and the feature selection Boruta algorithm (random forest algorithm) was implemented to identify important predictors for the number of aligners (prescribed, used) and treatment duration.
RESULTS: A total of 404 patients were included (age: 29.57 [10.7] years). Mean numbers of prescribed, used and unused aligners were 72.21 (37.52), 65.63 (30.40) and 6.57 (14.09), respectively. Important predictors of the numbers of the prescribed and used aligners were relatively similar and included molar and canine relationships, maxillary crowding, overjet, presence and number of missing or extracted posterior teeth, overbite, presence and number of teeth in posterior crossbite and midline discrepancies. Treatment duration was associated with baseline maxillary crowding, molar and canine relationships, overjet, overbite, midline discrepancies and the presence and number of missing or extracted posterior teeth.
CONCLUSIONS: Factors related to the baseline malocclusion severity significantly affect the number of prescribed, used aligners and treatment duration. This information could be used for informed practice and patient communication, including future evaluation of the biological and environmental footprint of aligners.
documents.authors: Gkinosati Angeliki Anna, Durgnat Candice, Koumpia Effimia, Pandis Nikolaos, Laspos Christodoulos, Papadopoulou Alexandra K
documents.summary_ja: 2021年4月から2024年12月に治療が完了したInvisalign患者404例を対象とした後方視的単一施設コホート研究。ベースラインの不正咬合重症度が、処方アライナー数・使用アライナー数・治療期間に与える影響を評価した。Borutaアルゴリズム（ランダムフォレスト）を用いて予測因子の選定を行った。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: ベースラインの不正咬合重症度に関連する因子（臼歯・犬歯関係、上顎叢生、オーバージェット、後方歯の欠如・抜歯の有数、オーバーバイト、後方クロスバイト、中线不一致）が、処方・使用アライナー数および治療期間に有意に影響する。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved: 処方アライナー数（平均72.21）と使用アライナー数（平均65.63）の差（平均6.57未使用）が定量的に示され、計画と実績の乖離を不正咬合重症度の観点から説明可能。教育: 結論で「informed practice and patient communication」が言及され、患者説明やインフォームドコンセントに活用可能。ワークフロー: どの不正咬合特徴がアライナー数・治療期間を駆動するかを特定することで、治療計画段階での予測精度向上に寄与。
documents.study_type_ja: 後方視的単一施設コホート研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 処方アライナー数、使用アライナー数、治療期間
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 処方アライナー数平均 72.21（SD 37.52）、使用アライナー数平均 65.63（SD 30.40）、未使用アライナー数平均 6.57（SD 14.09）。処方・使用アライナー数の重要な予測因子：臼歯・犬歯関係、上顎叢生、オーバージェット、後方歯の欠如・抜歯の有数、オーバーバイト、後方クロスバイトの歯の有数、中线不一致。治療期間の関連因子：ベースライン上顎叢生、臼歯・犬歯関係、オーバージェット、オーバーバイト、中线不一致、後方歯の欠如・抜歯の有数。

documents.title: The effects of headgear treatment timing on costs and orthodontic outcome: a follow-up study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To analyze the effects of cervical headgear (CHG) timing on costs and orthodontic outcome.
MATERIAL AND METHODS: Sixty-seven participants with Class II malocclusion were randomized into two groups. In the early group (EG, n = 33), CHG treatment began after the eruption of first upper molars. In the later-timed group (LG, n = 34), CHG treatment began nearly 2 years later. Orthodontic outcome was evaluated when CHG ended and at the end of follow-up using the Peer Assessment Rating (PAR) index and Little's Irregularity Index (LII). Costs were calculated using medical records, estimated chairside times and average personnel and material costs.
RESULTS: The mean total costs including personnel and material costs during the follow-up were higher in the EG (€416) compared with the LG (€364) (p = 0.043). No statistically significant differences between the groups were found in the PAR and in the LII scores at the end of follow-up. The number of visits during CHG treatment was higher in the EG (13.3) compared with the LG (10.4) (p = 0.01).
CONCLUSIONS: Earlier initiation of CHG treatment increased the personnel and material costs, number of appointments, and chairside time. Based on the PAR and in the LII scores, the orthodontic outcome of CHG treatment was equal regardless of the timing of the treatment. If orthodontic treatment during mixed-dentition stage is considered, it would be justified from an economic perspective to favor treatment during late mixed-dentition.
documents.authors: Hannula Matti, Tolvanen Mimmi, Pirttiniemi Pertti, Pirilä-Parkkinen Kirsi, Silvola Anna-Sofia, Julku Johanna
documents.summary_ja: Class II不正咬合の67名を対象に、頚部ヘッドギア（CHG）の開始時期（早期群：上顎第一大臼歯萌出後 vs 遅延群：約2年後開始）がコストと矯正治療結果に与える影響を分析したランダム化比較試験のフォローアップ研究。PAR指数とLittle's Irregularity Index（LII）で治療結果を評価し、医療記録・診療時間・人件費・材料費からコストを算出した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: CHGの早期開始は人件費・材料費・通院回数・診療時間を増加させたが、フォローアップ終了時のPAR指数とLIIスコアには群間差が認められず、治療時期にかかわらず矯正結果は同等であった。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療計画のタイミング決定（早期 vs 遅延混合歯列期）がワークフロー（通院回数・診療時間）とコストに直接影響を与える一方、治療結果には差がないことを示しており、治療計画の立案時に介入時期の最適化を検討する根拠となる。
documents.study_type_ja: ランダム化比較試験（フォローアップ研究）
documents.endpoints_ja: PAR指数、Little's Irregularity Index（LII）、総コスト（人件費・材料費）、CHG治療中の通院回数
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 総コスト：早期群 €416 vs 遅延群 €364（p = 0.043）。PAR指数：群間に統計的有意差なし。LIIスコア：群間に統計的有意差なし。CHG治療中の通院回数：早期群 13.3回 vs 遅延群 10.4回（p = 0.01）。

documents.title: Assessment of the Effectiveness and Predictability of Maxillary Molar Distalization with Clear Aligner Systems: A Systematic Review of the Literature.
documents.abstract: Background/Objectives: Maxillary molar distalization is a commonly used orthodontic approach for correcting dentoalveolar Class II malocclusions. However, the predictability of such movements when performed with clear aligners remains uncertain. This systematic review aimed to identify the effectiveness and most predictable protocol for achieving maxillary molar distalization using clear aligner systems. In this review, effectiveness was defined as the amount of distal movement achieved (mm), while predictability was defined as the ratio between achieved and planned movement (%). Methods: A systematic review was conducted following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) statement across PubMed-Medline, Scopus, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane Handbook databases, with no restrictions on language or publication date. The search was performed up to April 2026. Studies evaluating maxillary molar distalization with clear aligners were screened based on predefined eligibility criteria. Results: Of the 1388 articles initially identified, 16 met the inclusion criteria (11 retrospective cohort studies and 5 prospective experimental studies), comprising a total of 461 patients. Reported distalization effectiveness varied widely, ranging from 31.1% to 88.4%. A meta-analysis could not be performed owing to substantial clinical and methodological heterogeneity. Conclusions: Clear aligners can achieve maxillary molar distalization; however, the effectiveness decreases as greater distal movement is prescribed, making it unlikely that the clinician's ideal plan will be fully realized. The use of auxiliary elements, such as Class II elastics, attachments, or skeletal anchorage devices, may reduce anterior proclination and enhance posterior anchorage. Longer aligner-wear intervals (e.g., 14 days) were associated with higher predictability in several of the included studies, although the current evidence is insufficient to establish this interval as definitively superior.
documents.authors: Badía I Martí Pau, Bellot-Arcís Carlos, Tarazona-Álvarez Beatriz, Paredes-Gallardo Vanessa, Zamora-Martínez Natalia
documents.summary_ja: マキシラモラー遠心移動のクリアアライナー治療における有効性と予測可能性を評価したシステマティックレビュー。PRISMA準拠でPubMed-Medline、Scopus、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Handbookを2026年4月まで検索し、1388件中16件（後方視コホート11件、前方視実験5件）が基準を満たし、合計461例を包含した。有効性は達成された遠心移動量（mm）、予測可能性は計画移動量に対する達成移動量の比率（%）として定義された。臨床的・方法論的異質性が大きくメタ分析は実施できなかった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: クリアアライナーによるマキシラモラー遠心移動は可能であるが、処方される遠心移動量が増えるほど有効性が低下し、臨床医の理想計画が完全に実現される可能性は低い。Class IIエラстик、アタッチメント、骨性アンカリング装置などの補助要素は前歯部傾斜を軽減し後方アンカリングを強化する可能性がある。長いアライナー装着間隔（例：14日）は複数の研究で高い予測可能性と関連したが、決定的に優越するとは結論できない。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved：予測可能性（計画対達成比率）が31.1%〜88.4%と幅が広く、処方量が増えるほど乖離が拡大する点は治療計画の品質管理に直接関連する。refinement：補助要素（エラстик、アタッチメント、骨性アンカリング）の併用が前歯部傾斜の軽減と後方アンカリング強化に寄与する可能性が示唆され、計画段階での補助要素選択の根拠となる。
documents.study_type_ja: システマティックレビュー（メタ分析は異質性の高さにより実施不可）
documents.endpoints_ja: 有効性（達成された遠心移動量、mm）、予測可能性（計画移動量に対する達成移動量の比率、%）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: Reported distalization effectiveness varied widely, ranging from 31.1% to 88.4%.
documents.sample_size_ja: 461例（16研究：後方視コホート11件、前方視実験5件）

documents.title: Dimensional accuracy of clear aligners fabricated using different LCD 3D printer resolutions: an in-vitro study.
documents.abstract:
PURPOSE: The aim of this study is to compare trueness and precision of dental models from three LCD 3D printers with different horizontal resolutions (2K, 4K, 8K) and to evaluate their clinical suitability for orthodontic use.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: Thirty models were printed using Creality Halot One (2K), Phrozen Mighty 4K, and Phrozen Mighty 8K printers, with ten models each using manufacturer-recommended resins. Master digital models from intraoral scans were compared to re-scanned printed models through surface superimposition using Geomagic Control X software. Trueness and precision were evaluated by point deviation and Root-Mean-Square (RMS) analysis, with differences assessed by one-way ANOVA (p = 0.05).
RESULTS: Mean RMS values for 2K, 4K, and 8K printers were 0.266 ± 0.015 mm, 0.223 ± 0.017 mm, and 0.121 ± 0.012 mm, respectively (p < 0.001). The 8K printer showed highest trueness and precision, with deviations mainly in occlusal and gingival regions. The 0.25 mm error limit was within acceptable range for 4K and 8K models, while 2K models exceeded this value (p < 0.05).
CONCLUSION: Printer resolution significantly affects dimensional accuracy. The 8K LCD printer demonstrated superior accuracy and reproducibility, proving reliable for orthodontic models and clear aligners.
documents.authors: Ravi Jayaraj, Krishnakumaran Mahalakshmi, Krishnan Balaji, Gerald Annie Shirly Priyanka
documents.summary_ja: LCD 3Dプリンター3機種（2K、4K、8K）で印刷した歯科模型の真度（trueness）と精度（precision）を比較し、矯正治療における臨床的適性を評価したin-vitro研究。口腔内スキャン由来のマスターデジタル模型と再スキャンした印刷模型をGeomagic Control Xで表面重ね合わせし、点偏差とRMS分析により評価した。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 8K LCDプリンターが最も高い真度と精度を示し（RMS 0.121 mm）、矯正模型・クリアアライナー用に信頼できることが示された。2Kは0.25 mmの許容誤差を超過した。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achievedの観点：3D印刷模型の寸法精度はクリアアライナーの設計意図と実物との一致に直接影響する。8Kが0.25 mm以内、2Kが超過した結果は、治療計画の忠実な再現（refinement）にプリンター解像度が重要な変数であることを示す。ワークフローの観点：模型製造工程の品質管理基準（0.25 mm閾値）の妥当性を裏付ける。
documents.study_type_ja: In-vitro研究
documents.endpoints_ja: 真度（trueness）と精度（precision）：点偏差およびRMS分析

documents.title: Mucogingival Treatment of a Gingival Invagination After Tooth Extraction: A 3-Year Follow-Up After a Perio-Ortho Multidisciplinary Approach.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Gingival invagination is a relatively common occurrence following orthodontic closure of extraction sites. The present paper reports a combined periodontal and orthodontic treatment in a patient after lower incisor tooth extraction, in which periodontal plastic surgery was performed prior to the orthodontic space closure.
CASE REPORT: A 28-year-old female patient was treated for orthodontic concerns. The comprehensive treatment plan encompassed periodontal supportive therapy, tooth extraction, and periodontal plastic surgery utilizing the "connective tissue platform technique." Postsurgery, orthodontic treatment was administered with Invisalign aligners.
RESULTS: Radiographs and clinical examinations conducted 3 years after treatment completion confirm the long-term stability of the outcomes, both in terms of function and esthetics.
CONCLUSION: Gingival invagination after mandible incisor extraction could be successfully treated by an additional application of a periodontal plastic surgery technique, which, combined with a posterior orthodontic treatment, solved a multidisciplinary treatment challenge.
documents.authors: Alberichi Jennifer, Rojas Mariana, Cometti Juan Carlos, Pilloni Andrea
documents.summary_ja: 下顎切歯抜歯後に生じた歯肉陥凹に対し、歯周形成外科（結合組織プラットフォーム法）を正畸的スペースクローズ前に施行し、その後Invisalignアライナーによる正畸治療を行った28歳女性患者の症例報告。治療完了後3年間のフォローアップで、機能・審美的な長期安定性が確認された。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 下顎切歯抜歯後の歯肉陥凹は、正畸的スペースクローズ前に歯周形成外科（結合組織プラットフォーム法）を施行し、その後Invisalignアライナーによる正畸治療を組み合わせることで、3年間の長期安定性を達成できる。
documents.why_matters_ja: 治療計画のワークフローにおいて、歯周形成外科を正畸的スペースクローズの前に位置づけることで、抜歯後の歯肉陥凹を事前に処理し、その後の正畸治療の安定性を確保できる。3年間のフォローアップで計画された結果（機能・審美的安定性）が達成されたことを示しており、planned-vs-achievedの観点でも意義がある。
documents.study_type_ja: 症例報告
documents.endpoints_ja: 治療完了後3年時点での機能・審美的な長期安定性（レントゲン写真および臨床検査による評価）
documents.endpoint_results_ja: 抄録に具体的な数値は記載されていない。3年時点のレントゲン写真および臨床検査により、機能・審美的な長期安定性が確認されたと記載。

documents.title: Multisite Mini-Implant Anchorage for Maxillary Intrusion With Clear Aligners: A Finite Element Analysis.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the biomechanical effects of various mini-implant anchorage configurations on maxillary full-arch intrusion with clear aligners and to propose an optimized protocol for vertical control in clinical orthodontics.
METHODS: Based on cone-beam computed tomography data from an adult patient with Angle Class II high-angle malocclusion, three-dimensional finite element models of the maxillary arch, periodontal ligament (PDL), maxilla, clear aligner, mini-implants, and traction buttons were constructed. Simulations were performed for three anchorage categories: (1) intrusion without auxiliary anchorage (control group); (2) intrusion with posterior-only anchorage, comprising three groups - buccal-only, palatal-only, and bilateral - with mini-implants placed between the second premolar and first molar (#5/#6); and (3) intrusion with combined anterior-posterior anchorage, including a central incisor-posterior anchorage group (five implants) and a lateral incisor-posterior anchorage group (six implants). Outcomes included tooth displacement and PDL hydrostatic pressure distribution.
RESULTS: Among the control group and the three posterior anchorage groups, bilateral posterior anchorage produced the most bodily posterior intrusion. Lateral incisor-posterior anchorage achieved the most optimal intrusion of the arch and mitigated the sagittal inclination of the anterior teeth. Posterior teeth in the second quadrant exhibited significantly smaller displacement and PDL hydrostatic pressure than those in the first quadrant, attributable to the fused, significantly thicker root morphology of the second-quadrant second molar (#27).
CONCLUSION: Bilateral posterior anchorage effectively balances the buccal and palatal moments and is recommended for posterior intrusion. Strategic placement of mini-implants in the anterior region can prevent anterior tooth inclination and facilitate posterior intrusion, thereby achieving coordinated vertical control, although this approach carries an increased risk of root resorption. Individual anatomical features, particularly root morphology, should be considered in clinical vertical control protocols.

documents.title: Volumetric analysis of external root resorption after clear aligner treatment of open bite cases: a CBCT study.
documents.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Orthodontically induced external root resorption (OIERR) is a recognized adverse effect of orthodontic treatment. Limited literature exists that reported on volumetric root changes in anterior open bite patients treated with clear aligners. This study aimed to evaluate three-dimensional volumetric changes in anterior teeth roots using cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) in open-bite patients treated with clear aligners.
METHODS: Fifty CBCT scans [pre-treatment (T1) and post-treatment (T2)] obtained from 25 adult patients (11 males,14 females; mean age: 32.67 ± 10.67 years) with anterior open bite (1-4 mm) treated using clear aligners were retrospectively analyzed. Semi-automated segmentation of the twelve anterior teeth was performed using Blue Sky Plan software, followed by three-dimensional superimposition in 3-matic software. A reference line at the cementoenamel junction was used to trim the crown, and root volumes were measured at both time points. Percentage changes in root volume between pre-treatment and post-treatment were calculated. The level of significance was set at p ≤ 0.05. Skeletal and dental parameters were assessed before and after treatment. The reproducibility of the measurements was assessed using the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC).
RESULTS: Both intra-examiner and inter-examiner reliability were excellent (ICC: 0.90-0.94 and 0.92-0.96, respectively; p < 0.001). All anterior teeth demonstrated significant reduction in root volume. Maxillary canines showed the greatest percentage decrease (- 6.33 ± 2.58%), followed by the central (- 5.91 ± 4.93%) and lateral incisors (- 5.50 ± 3.24%). Mandibular canines again showed the largest reduction (- 6.75 ± 2.33%), followed by lateral (- 5.58 ± 3.20%) and central incisors (- 4.86 ± 2.54%). Males exhibited significantly greater root volume reduction across all anterior teeth (p < 0.05), while no significant correlation was found with age.
CONCLUSION: Patients with anterior open bite who were treated with clear aligners showed mild root volume reduction in all anterior teeth with canines being most affected. This reduction is generally considered to be clinically insignificant. Male patients showed greater volumetric reduction, whereas age and magnitude of incisor movement were not significantly correlated with root volume changes.

documents.summary_ja: 前歯部開咬（1〜4mm）をクリアアライナーで治療した25名の成人患者（男性11名、女性14名、平均年齢32.67±10.67歳）を対象に、治療前（T1）と治療後（T2）のCBCTスキャン計50枚を後向きに解析した研究。Blue Sky Planソフトウェアによる半自動セグメンテーションと3-maticソフトウェアによる3次元重ね合わせを行い、12本の前歯の根体体積を測定し、体積変化率を算出した。

documents.title: Clinical, biomechanical, and digital factors associated with refinement after the first series of clear aligners: A systematic review.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To systematically identify, appraise, and synthesize the evidence on clinical, biomechanical, and digital factors associated with refinement-related outcomes after the first series of clear aligners.
METHODS: This systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 and followed the Synthesis Without Meta-analysis (SWiM) guidance. Electronic searches were performed in PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and Google Scholar. Clinical studies involving patients treated with clear aligners were included when they reported refinement, additional aligners, finishing aligners, midcourse correction, refinement plans, planned-versus-achieved discrepancies, or treatment-continuation outcomes after the first aligner series. Risk of bias was assessed using design-specific tools according to study design. Owing to heterogeneity in definitions, outcomes, units of analysis, and measurement methods, a structured narrative synthesis was performed.
RESULTS: Twenty studies were included. Refinement-related outcomes were heterogeneously defined, including refinement aligners, additional aligners, finishing phases, refinement plans, midcourse correction, and first-refinement scans. The evidence suggested that refinement burden may be associated with malocclusion complexity, extraction treatment, interproximal reduction strategies, severe spacing, larger correction sequences, and movement-specific limitations. Rotations, intrusion, vertical correction, transverse expansion, and selected anterior movements showed reduced predictability. Remote monitoring appeared to reduce appointment burden but did not consistently reduce refinement need. Evidence for adjunctive technologies and machine-learning prediction remained preliminary.
CONCLUSIONS: Refinement after the first aligner series should be interpreted as a multifactorial clinical outcome rather than a uniform finishing procedure. Standardized definitions and prospective studies are needed to clarify patient-, tooth-, movement-, and treatment-plan-level predictors.
PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD420261416896.
documents.authors: Nogueira Matos Karla, Belline da Silva Tainá, Matos de Faria Almeida Leonardo, de Faria Almeida Marcos, Dos Santos Dantas Guimarães Hugo Henrique
documents.summary_ja: PRISMA 2020およびSWiMガイドラインに従い実施されたシステマティックレビュー。透明マウスピース矯正の第1シリーズ後のリファインメント関連アウトカムに関連する臨床的・生力学的・デジタル的因子を体系的に同定・評価・統合した。PubMed/MEDLINE、Embase、Scopus、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、Google Scholarを検索し、20件の研究を含む。リファインメント関連アウトカムは定義が異質であり、リファインメントアライナー、追加アライナー、フィニッシングフェーズ、リファインメントプラン、ミッドコース補正、第1リファインメントスキャンが含まれた。リファインメント負荷は不正咬合の複雑性、抜歯治療、IPR戦略、重度のスペース、大きな補正シーケンス、移動特異的な限界と関連する可能性が示された。遠隔モニタリングは通院負担を軽減したが、リファインメントの必要性を一貫して減少させなかった。
documents.key_takeaway_ja: 第1アライナーシリーズ後のリファインメントは、均一なフィニッシング手順ではなく、多因子の臨床的アウトカムとして解釈すべきである。患者・歯・移動・治療計画レベルの予測因子を明確にするために、標準化された定義と前向き研究が必要である。
documents.why_matters_ja: planned-vs-achieved：計画と達成の乖離（planned-versus-achieved discrepancies）を明示的に包含するアウトカムとして位置づけ、リファインメントの多因子性を示した。リファインメント：リファインメント負荷に関連する臨床的・生力学的因子を体系的に統合し、回転・圧入・垂直補正・横方向拡大・選択的前歯移動の予測可能性の低さを示した。計画品質：治療計画レベルの予測因子の必要性を結論として提示した。ワークフロー：遠隔モニタリングが通院負担を軽減するがリファインメント必要性を一貫して減少させないという知見を報告した。

documents.title: Dentoskeletal and soft tissue effects of clear aligner mandibular advancement appliances versus Activator for skeletal Class II malocclusion: a retrospective clinical study.
documents.abstract:
OBJECTIVES: To compare soft tissue changes and improvements in facial esthetics between Activator and mandibular advancement (MA) treatment using three-dimensional (3D) facial images and two-dimensional (2D) cephalometric analysis. Second, to assess dentoskeletal effects of Activator and MA through 2D cephalometric evaluation.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A total of 70 growing patients with skeletal Class II malocclusion (Activator: n = 37; MA: n = 33) were included. Lateral cephalograms and 3D facial images (3dMD face system, Atlanta, Georgia, USA) were analyzed to assess dentoskeletal and soft tissue changes before and after treatment. Point-to-point registration followed by a precision best-fit approach was applied to superimpose the 3D photographs, focusing on 3D analysis of the whole face and seven soft tissue regions. Cephalometric analysis was conducted to quantify dentoskeletal and soft tissue effects. The multivariate Hotelling's T2 test was applied to compare the composite treatment outcomes between MA and Activator groups.
RESULTS: All soft tissue regions except the upper lip significantly increased from pre- to post-treatment. MA produced greater correction of soft tissue convexity (2.57°) and chin with sl-VL increasing 0.97 mm more than the Activator. Skeletal and dental parameters improved over time in both treatments. U1-SN and overjet significantly decreased more in MA (5.57° and 3.49 mm) than Activator (3.51° and 2.25 mm).
CONCLUSIONS: Activator and MA effectively advanced the mandible, retracted upper incisors, reduced overjet, and improved soft tissue profile. MA is more effective in improving upper incisor proclination and facial profile esthetics than the Activator.
